listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: With its forbidden blend of white flowers and a dark accord, L'Interdit Eau de Parfum is a resolutely underground flower. It unveils a sensual bouquet of orange blossom, jasmine, and tuberose. In contrast, earthy dark tones emanate from vetiver and patchouli to create a daringly addictive and sensual fragrance. In homage to the design of Hubert de Givenchy's first perfume, the bottle is truly timeless and terribly modern. With a round squareness and a soft strength, it dares you to break the rules with abandon. Defy conventions with L'Interdit Eau de Parfum in a new 100ml format. This fragrance is now part of an eco-responsible approach, with a refillable format. Experience the thrill of the forbidden with L'Interdit, a fragrance that invites you to defy convention and embrace your singularity.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co. & Love for Him Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Cardamom, Ginger, Mandarin. Heart Notes: Juniper-Cypress, Geranium, Lavender. Base Notes: Blue Sequoia, Sandalwood, Vetiver. Created as part of a romantic pair, the Tiffany & Co. Tiffany & Love for Him Eau de Toilette intertwines with its feminine counterpart through the common note of Blue Sequoia. Embodying the human connections that make up the love story of modern relationships, the scent is a timeless yet contemporary blend that has been masterfully crafted by revered perfumers Sophie Labbé and Nicolas Beaulieu. A sparkling citrus surface of Mandarin melts into aromatic complexity through spicy Ginger and Cardamom’s fresh warmth. At its heart, the fragrance takes on a solidity that’s simultaneously powerful and understanding thanks to the Juniper-Cypress blend that’s undergone co-distillation, a process unique to Tiffany, adding a splash of unique intrigue. The eau de toilette rests on a woody base of familiar Vetiver and Sandalwood blended with the distinctive presence of Blue Sequoia, making the aroma stand out as a masterful contemporary creation.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Elevate your scent profile with Estée Lauder's Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum, a sophisticated cologne with a warm, seductive bouquet. First conceived back in 1964 by Bernard Chant, the fragrance was inspired by the classic chypre structure: a combination of fresh, citrusy top notes with a rich, woody base. This breakthrough olfactory mix has cemented itself as a staple in grooming routines, and is updated here with a modern, lavender-topped flourish. Retaining the exclusive Leathery Cuirissima LXR essence, it's cut through with notes of grapefruit, Orris and patchouli – adding a punchy drive to the grounded aroma. Conjuring images of New York City, the scent is associated with the dynamic, forthright energy of the metropolis.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Bois Pacifique Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bois Pacifique, an olfactive expedition to freedom. Tom Ford’s Eau de Parfum draws inspiration from nature, bringing to mind images of a blossoming woodland bathed in the sun’s warming rays. The fragrance expresses its majestic character through a sensuous blend of woods and spices, including turmeric, sandalwood and oakwood. A perfect balance of fresh and warm, every spritz invites its wearers on a journey to self-discovery. Like the scent itself, the flacon is bursting with vitality, featuring a luminous gold tint, metallic detailing and a ribbed silhouette.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Love Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Set free your inner romantic with the Coach Love Eau de Parfum, a floral fruity scent that exudes feelings of passion and tenderness. Inspired by the universal experience of love, the sweet fragrance accords mingle together to create a hypnotic love potion. Beginning with a passionate, fruity burst, wild strawberry opens this scent with a flirty feminine start. The ultimate symbol of romance, the red rose conquers the fragrance's heart with its rich, velvet petals. Warming cedarwood captures the ending of this love story, with a seductive and alluring finish. The fragrance was created in collaboration with director and photographer Juergen Teller to celebrate love in all its forms. Held captive in a vibrant red glass flacon, even the perfume’s bottle exudes passion and romance waiting to be unleashed. Adorned with an adorable gold heart charm, the bottle is embossed with the iconic carriage logo.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Elixir de Parfum for Women 30ml
listings.description: Capturing the essence of fearless and fierce femininity, Burberry’s Her Elixir de Parfum bottles a bold fruity fragrance with a sensual and adventurous olfactive story. A daring burst of dark berries opens the scent trail, immersing the senses in an addictive air from the very first spritz. A soft floral heart of jasmine pairs perfectly with the luscious fruit facets, emboldened by a golden creamy base of vanilla and amber. Housed in a pastel pink bottle with the brand name embossed, the parfum brings a confident charm to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Silky Woods Perfume 10ml
listings.description: Nestled within a vessel of molten gold, Goldfield & Banks unveils Silky Woods, a captivating debut in their Botanical Series. The fragrance, a harmonious blend of organic ingredients, showcases sustainably sourced precious woods, used for the first time in perfume history, harvested from the Daintree Rainforest in Queensland. The modern scent offers a symphony of suede, vanilla, and tobacco leaves, unwinding into nuanced layers of saffron, incense, and native sandalwood. It's a celebration of Australia's organic treasures, housed inside a glass bottle lacquered in gold, paying homage to the nation's Gold Rush history.

listings.rawTitle: BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum for Him 50ml
listings.description: Memorably bold and long-lasting, amplify your presence with BOSS' Beyond Eau de Parfum for Him. Fronted by global ambassador Bradley Cooper, this standout scent makes a confident entrance into your aftershave collection. The composition opens with a vibrant burst of ginger, delivering a zesty, peppery freshness that awakens the senses. As it settles, smooth leather emerges, adding a smoky, resinous depth that’s equal parts refined and magnetic. Lending itself to evenings that demand impact, the Beyond EDP is for leaving your mark in olfactory form.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Sunflower Pop Perfume Mist 125ml
listings.description: Inspired by Van Gogh’s iconic artwork, the Floral Street Sunflower Pop Perfume Mist brightens your scent trail with its citrus aroma. Made with rose water, this perfume mist nourishes the skin and hair as you spritz, offering light hydration. Meanwhile, notes of juicy mandarin, bergamot and bellini uplift the senses to leave you smelling sumptuous, capturing the essence of a vibrant, sunshine-filled morning. Power up your perfume layering routine with the brand’s Sunflower Pop Eau de Parfum for enhanced intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Pushing the boundaries of sensory perception, Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum showcases an Artificial Intelligence augmented floral signature as an ode to jasmine. Crafted with a luminous blend of vert de bergamot and neroli, the floral-musky fragrance opens with Paradoxe’s iconic zesty top notes. An AI-refined jasmine accord captures the flower’s airy, uplifting aroma as perceived in nature, allowing perfumers to explore its olfactive possibilities and rethink florality thanks to modern technology. To close the trail, notes of musk and ambrette melt together to create a warm, second skin-like sensation that supports the eau de parfum’s impressive longevity. The entire Prada Paradoxe range is refillable. A 50ml pack and a 100ml refill contains 38% less packaging in total compared to three 50ml packs of Prada Paradoxe.* *Reductions vary depending on original bottle size, between 20-31% for glass, 17-58% for plastic and 21-44% for cardboard.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Fleur de Blonde Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Elevated and effortlessly elegant, Le Monde Gourmand’s Fleur de Blonde Eau de Parfum balances the soft and sweet, creating a familiar, warm fragrance that comforts the senses as you spritz. Brightened by airy pear blossom, the perfume lends uplifting benefits, as multi-tonal ambrette cocoons the trail in a velvety, musky veil. White amber and cashmere woods complement the second skin-like serenity of cashmere musk, closing the scent with a cosy glow.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Dreamt up in collaboration with renowned perfumer Sonia Constant, For Her Eau de Parfum Intense offers a new twist on Narciso Rodriguez’s quintessential heart of musc accord, layering fresh fruits and florals with addictive vanilla for a sensuous olfactory experience. The vegan fragrance starts with a juicy trail, invigorating the senses with a bite of peach and bergamot. Solar white flowers amplify the scent’s musk signature, before giving way to earthy, woody nuances of vetiver. The iconic For Her perfume bottle is reimagined to reflect the intensity of the perfume within. Wrapped in a deep shade of pink, the flacon encapsulates the fragrance’s bold character.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Pushing the boundaries of sensory perception, Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum showcases an Artificial Intelligence augmented floral signature as an ode to jasmine. Crafted with a luminous blend of vert de bergamot and neroli, the floral-musky fragrance opens with Paradoxe’s iconic zesty top notes. An AI-refined jasmine accord captures the flower’s airy, uplifting aroma as perceived in nature, allowing perfumers to explore its olfactive possibilities and rethink florality thanks to modern technology. To close the trail, notes of musk and ambrette melt together to create a warm, second skin-like sensation that supports the eau de parfum’s impressive longevity. The entire Prada Paradoxe range is refillable. A 50ml pack and a 100ml refill contains 38% less packaging in total compared to three 50ml packs of Prada Paradoxe.* *Reductions vary depending on original bottle size, between 20-31% for glass, 17-58% for plastic and 21-44% for cardboard.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Banane Délice Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The Le Monde Gourmand Banane Délice Eau de Parfum 30ml captures the feeling of sun-warmed skin and sweet, tropical air in a playful, creamy scent that lingers close. The Eau de Parfum opens with a bright twist of banana, pineapple and orange, softening into coconut and sugared florals. As it settles, whipped vanilla, tonka bean and soft musks leave a smooth, warming trail that wears like a summer memory.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum for Men 150ml
listings.description: Sincere, courageous and ever-evolving, Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum for men embodies the spirit of the modern man. Leading with fresh nuances of pine needles, the instinctive scent captures the essence of a forest by the English coastline. Offset by the rich warmth of benzoin and incense, it boasts a soulful olfactive trail that lingers long after its first impression. Descending into its signature base, a trio of warm cedarwood oils represents hero strength to add depth and power. Housed in an elegant oak-coloured bottle with gold accents, Burberry Hero invites you to surpass limits and embrace the extraordinary within.

listings.rawTitle: LF Exclusive NEOM Blush Wellbeing Pod Bundle
listings.description: Elevate your space with this Exclusive NEOM Blush Wellbeing Pod Bundle, featuring the brand's electric diffuser in a limited-edition rosy hue and an essential oil discovery set. Designed with touch-sensitive buttons to control the light and misting, a diffusion timer and breathing mode, the diffuser releases a fine, aromatic mist for the optimal amount of your favourite scent. Pair with your chosen essential oil blend to infuse your interior with the atmosphere you’re craving. Set Contents: Wellbeing Pod Essential Oil Diffuser with Blush Cover Perfect Night’s Sleep Essential Oil Blend 3ml Bedtime Hero Essential Oil Blend 3ml Real Luxury Essential Oil Blend 3ml Complete Bliss Essential Oil Blend 3ml Happiness Essential Oil Blend 3ml Feel Refreshed Essential Oil Blend 3ml

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER A*MEN Eau de Toilette Rubber Natural Spray Refillable - 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Peppermint, Lavender, Patchouli. Base Notes: Coffee, Tonka Beans, Musk. Adorn yourself with the sumptuous notes within MUGLER's A*MEN Eau de Toilette. Potent and intoxicating, the fragrance opens with top notes of invigorating Peppermint, contrasting pleasantly with soothing Lavender and tantalising Patchouli. Visions of a dense, mysterious forest are conjured, enticing you into its core to explore and experience new beginnings. Notes of Atlas Cedar allow you to envision your hands brushing the bark of the trees, as their branches wind and dance, the sky above you melting into inky evening. Woody and floral, the fragrance effortlessly plays with the ideas of dominance and vulnerability, reminding us that fiercely embodying both is what makes us human. Delve into base notes of creamy Coffee, alluring Tonka Bean and decadent Musk, allowing the perfume to caress your senses and linger on your skin. Packed with many dimensions, the fragrance represents a powerful yet versatile cocktail that is perfect for everyday use. Fiery and unignorable, the amalgamation of scents is ideal for the person that knows exactly who they are. Housed in a lusciously tactile rubber casing, which is totally refillable.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Code Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Naturally captivating, the Armani Code Eau de Parfum is an ambery woody fragrance that equips wearers with the ability to master the everyday, pursuing life challenges with a magnetising grace. Opening with zesty notes of mandarin and bergamot, the cologne effortlessly blends elegant rosemary and lavender to form a sensual, aromatic accord. Rich and velvety tonka bean and cedar unfurl to envelop the senses in a heady and irresistible scent, an ode to the endless reverie Armani commands. Fusing fresh citruses and an exotic base, the fragrance inspires and empowers wearers to be unapologetically authentic.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Purple Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Intimate yet expressive, the Valentino Born In Roma Donna Purple Eau de Parfum unfolds slowly on the skin, leaving a warm, smooth finish that lingers long after the first spritz. The scent opens with a blend of succulent plum, softened by floral osmanthus and a hint of creamy vanilla. As part of the Born in Roma fragrance collection, the fragrance is housed in the label's iconic studded bottle, tinted in a rich violet hue.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Green Stravaganza Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the culture of Italy’s capital city with the Born In Roma Donna Green by Valentino. Inspired by the extravagance and beauty of the eternal city, the fragrance unleashes luscious floral notes to transport your mind to the gardens of Rome. The scent opens with a smoky aroma of lapsang souchong tea accord, mingling with jasmine absolute to create heat and passion reminiscent of the Roman sun. A base of lavish vanilla takes over to add a luxurious but enchanting finish to the scent. Reinventing the iconic pyramidal structure, the bottle captures the spirit of Valentino with its distinctive studded design and leather accents as a symbol of fearlessness.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Wild Vanilla Orchid Perfume Mist 125ml
listings.description: A gourmand scent but not as you know it, Floral Street’s Wild Vanilla Orchid Perfume Mist envelops the skin in a cloud of sweetened floral accords with a creamy twist. Opening with a burst of zest, the scent introduces notes of cassis and citrus to awaken the senses. A comforting blend of vanilla beans wraps the skin in a blanket-like cosiness, while a bouquet of vanilla blossom, jasmine and bamboo blooms at the heart. Enriched with skin-loving actives and refreshing rose water, the perfume mist leaves skin feeling soft and nourishes with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Ghost Sweetheart Always Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Garner compliments wherever you go with the Ghost Sweetheart Always Eau de Parfum, a sweet, warm fragrance that can be applied day and night. With an essence that's reminiscent of evening sunsets, the scent features an alluring spectrum of notes, from bright pink pepper to golden, sumptuous caramel. The fruity top layer gives way to a floral-gourmand heart, a powdery, luxurious combination that's dynamic yet well-balanced. Lending comfort in the base, sandalwood and vanilla are cradled by amber and musk, cocooning the crowd-pleasing trail in softness.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Red Eau de Toilette Spray 125ml
listings.description: A crisp yet comforting cologne by Lacoste that exudes woody notes with an energising undertone. The Red eau de Toilette Spray is a fiercely fresh fragrance powered by green apple and pine tree, paired with the earthiness of patchouli for a full-bodied fougere scent. Developed by perfumer Annick Menardo, the eau de toilette features a harmonious blend of jasmine, thuya wood and vetiver, capturing the dynamic character of the contemporary Lacoste man. Housed in a quadratic flacon embossed with the brand’s signature crocodile mascot and topped with a red cap, the spray stands proud on any dresser.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Men Pure Platinum Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Your gateway to compliments, the Coach Men Pure Platinum Parfum distils strength and expression into a magnetic elixir, boasting an ambery aromatic profile. An evolution of the 2018 opus created by perfumer Bruno Jovanovic, the fragrance weaves an olfactory web of intrigue and sophistication. In the top layer, vibrant lavender oil establishes a bold, herbaceous prelude that enters the room before you do. The fragrance evolves slowly into the boozy warmth of rum as it dries on the skin, offsetting the powdery element above with a molasses-like depth. Extending the trail from day into night, ambrox resides in the base, anchoring the composition with an addictive edge. The result is an unspoken assertion of confidence that's harnessed and reflected in the platinum-toned bottle housing it.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau des Merveilles Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: An enchanting perfume, warm and sparkling. A fragrance composed of smooth, vanilla toned benzoin and ambergris woody notes, a wonderful stroll in the refreshing cool of wild orange trees. Since 2004, Eau des Merveilles has been a key that opens the door to the wonders of Hermès. From innocence to fantasy, from childhood dreams to femininity, it is a world where the extraordinary is brought into the light. Year after year, we are transported on an air of poetic enchantment. Captured in their round bottles resembling a magnifying glass, the fragrances have the magical power to see the world from new and marvellous angles. It is the key to wonders, the origin of stars in broad day light.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Crispy. Luminous. Pure. Reveal your light through OMNIA. Evoking the purity and clarity of crystal, the iconic BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline is a luminous Eau de Toilette signed by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas. A fragrance inspired by the aquatic transparency of the lotus flower, sublimated by the airy generosity of a white peony. Omnia Crystalline is a delicate scent evolving through watery crispy notes of nashi pear, the vegetal freshness of bamboo and ending on the warmth of balsa wood softened by an accord of crystal musks. The new flacon design pays tribute to Omnia's iconic shape while staying true to its inimitable original scent, which remains untouched. Like a frame of light, an invitation to rediscover the iconic fascination of Omnia from a new, more precious perspective. Two rings smoothly flowing into each other through two detachable elements, unveiling the fragrance's atomizer and introducing a new concept for this iconic flacon. Like a shining secret at the heart, an elegant rose gold colored frame on the cap brings Bulgari's DNA as a jeweler to the core of one of its most iconic feminine fragrance collections. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, the new flacon captures every single drop of light. Top Notes: The fragrance opens with a duo bathed in light. The crispness of nashi pear accord is enhanced by the freshness of a bamboo accord. Heart Notes: A delicate alliance transports the heart of the fragrance towards floral and resolutely feminine tones. The aquatic transparency of lotus accord is tinged with the purity of a white peony note. Dry Down Notes: At dry-down, the warm balsa wood accord reveals a tender woody trail combined with the soft sensuality of a crystal musks accord.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, Terre d'Hermès eau de parfum intense reveals a deeper, more intimate facet of the inner fire that animates the Earth and man. Terre d'Hermès eau de parfum intense is a deep, woody fragrance that combines fiery bergamot with burning wood and the mineral notes of intense lava stone. The bottle, created by designer Philippe Mouquet, has a molten look, its lacquered sides are enveloped in a reddish-brown varnish that extends to cover the base with its emblematic H. The matte black metal cap is reminiscent of lava stone. The 100ml and 50ml bottles can be replenished using the 200ml refill sold separately, a gesture that is integral to an object created to last.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ombre Leather Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Wrap yourself in the tactile sensuality of Tom Ford’s Ombré Leather Parfum, a deeper, more intoxicating interpretation of the original Eau de Parfum. Opening with the crisp freshness of violet leaf absolute, the scent unfolds with a green vibrancy that gives way to an elegant touch of cedarwood. A luminous heart of jasmine sambac absolute, harvested before the monsoon season, reveals a delicate fruity-floral nuance reminiscent of honeysuckle. Hints of green tobacco weave through the composition, adding depth and character, while a double concentration of orris heart leaves an irresistibly smooth, lingering trail.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Café Rose Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Tom Ford Café Rose Eau de Parfum captures the untamed sensuality of a refined rose spiked with an unexpected twist of dark coffee. Luxurious and sensual, the fragrance is enriched with the essence of Turkish and Bulgarian rose, while ylang-ylang adds an opulent floralcy. The enchanting fragrance is infused with rich, aromatic notes of cardamom, coriander and patchouli at the base, adding a touch of spice to incense resin and sandalwood accords. Embodying the opulence of the warm floral elixir, the Café Rose bottle features a semi-transparent rosy pink hue with a violet bronze-toned cap and plaque.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Costa Azzurra Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Cloaking you in sprightly citrus hues, Tom Ford’s Costa Azzura Eau de Parfum perfectly captures the aroma of a Mediterranean getaway. Wafts of sparkling Sicilian lemon float atop warm gusts from nearby groves, intertwining with fragrant evergreens to create a truly unforgettable fougère scent. Whisking your senses to shimmering coastlines, the EDP settles to an enveloping woody dry-down of cypress and oak. In true Tom Ford fashion, the luminous fragrance shines through a luxe bottle made from ribbed-effect glass with sleek gold accents.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male In Blue Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier's Le Male In Blue Eau de Parfum delivers a deep, spicy aromatic signature with a fresh twist. Opening with an intense anise accord softened by sweet lavender, the scent unfolds into a warm base of benzoin and vanilla for a smooth, long-lasting finish. Balancing crisp freshness with comforting warmth, the fragrance lingers throughout the day. Housed in the iconic torso bottle, reimagined in metallic blue with sheer black stripes, it offers a bold, limited-edition design.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum Intense Refill 200ml
listings.description: A fragrance fit for a goddess, Jean Paul Gaultier’s Divine Eau de Parfum Intense Refill radiates cosmic sensuality with its heavenly amber floral elixir. The luminous scent draws inspiration from the fearless queens of Gaultier’s catwalks, encapsulating their dazzling aura with every spritz. The solar energy of the perfume can be attributed to an uplifting lily and frangipani blend. The warmth of benzoin contrasts with a whisper of saltiness to grant the scent an opulent aroma, wrapped in irresistible meringue for an angelic finish.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Bold Elixir Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the mystical aura of the orchid flower, the Calvin Klein Euphoria Bold Elixir Eau de Parfum explores the mystery and sensuality of womanhood. Opening with a juicy burst of pomegranate and persimmon, its succulent beginning energises the senses within the first spritz. An intoxicating bouquet of decadent orchid and radiant lotus blossoms for a radiant, floral heart. Its dry down leaves a lingering impression as unforgettable amber and rich mahogany woods are paired with gourmand cream and skin-like musk.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Absolute Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A balance of earthy depth and sweet warmth, Carolina Herrera’s Bad Boy Cobalt Absolute is a compelling choice for evening wear. Defined by its bold woody-vanilla profile, the scent is favoured for its smoothness and intensity. It opens with fresh, aromatic notes of blue lavender and blue sage, creating a clean yet subtly earthy introduction. At the heart, geranium meets white truffle – an unexpected pairing that blends green, slightly minty facets with a rich, musky edge. As it dries down, golden vanilla and oakwood emerge, wrapping the skin in creamy, almost marshmallow-like warmth, grounded by a smoky, earthy finish.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Rose de Soie Eau de Toilette 10ml
listings.description: Silky rose water drifting into rich roasted tonka beans, emboldening the floral scent with candied-rose sweetness. Florals surge instantly: vivid rose water sparked by piquant baies roses. At the heart, sunlit orange blossoms illuminate all the facets of fresh pink roses. Rich roasted tonka unfolds, releasing sweet undertones of caramel. Its warmth sweeps into a creamy, musky, candied-rose trail, soft as silk. A new olfactive elegance emerges – bold and resolutely Balmain. The clear glass bottle features a rose-candy cap and label evocative of soft, silky hues. The design takes inspiration from the 1946 Balmain Élysées 64-83. It retains the unique striated gilded collar and angled label, while adding dimension to the new lozenge shape with the signature Balmain rayure and PB monogram.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Bois Pacifique Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Bois Pacifique, an olfactive expedition to freedom. Tom Ford’s Eau de Parfum draws inspiration from nature, bringing to mind images of a blossoming woodland bathed in the sun’s warming rays. The fragrance expresses its majestic character through a sensuous blend of woods and spices, including turmeric, sandalwood and oakwood. A perfect balance of fresh and warm, every spritz invites its wearers on a journey to self-discovery. Like the scent itself, the flacon is bursting with vitality, featuring a luminous gold tint, metallic detailing and a ribbed silhouette.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Elixir Eau de Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Making another glamorous addition to the Good Girl collection, Carolina Herrera’s Very Good Girl Elixir Eau de Parfum Elixir is more intense and sensual than ever. More addictive but just as bold, the amber scent opens with gourmand cherry and almond nuances to tempt the senses and leave you wanting more. At its heart, a bouquet of red rose and white tuberose makes a romantic display of intertwining florals. Vanilla and cocoa linger on the skin for a lasting impression that reflects the multifaceted nature of modern femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Elixir Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A tribute to impactful masculinity, Montblanc's Legend Elixir Parfum is an opulent and modern fougere ambery fragrance. The most powerful concentration in the Legenc collection, the scent opens with an aromatic, sharp blend of lavender and bergamot, creating an energising introduction to the scent. The fragrance unfolds into a heart of punchy pink peppercorn, balanced by the florality of iris germanica and Pomarose™. As it settles, a smooth, buttery base of vanilla and the woody, amber notes of Ambrofix™ create a sensual, addictive trail, complemented by cistus and benzoin. It's presented in the iconic Montblanc Legend perfume bottle, featuring mirrored silver lacquering to reflect the elegance and intensity of the elixir inside.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Invigorate your scent ritual with Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum, a fragrance that unfolds like a story on the skin. Opening with a bright zing of mandarin and orange flower petals, the perfume's bouquet begins on an invigorating sensory note. As the formula settles, florals bloom at its heart, with hibiscus flower complementing delicate freesia. Relish in the seductive dry-down as vanilla and moody musks feature at the perfume's creamy core.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Raspberry, Grapefruit and Pear. Heart Notes: Wild Rose, Violet and Apple Blossom. Base Notes: Plum, Cedarwood and Musk. Exude pure passion and free-spiritedness with the Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette. Feel confident and empowered enough to express who you truly are each and every time the perfume is sprayed, as the cocktail of notes evoke images of sun-kissed adventures and alluring first meetings. Playful top notes of Raspberry, Grapefruit and Pear mingle deliciously, lingering on the skin and conjuring visions of exotic orchards, bursting with fresh fruit daring you to take a bite. A tantalising heart of Wild Rose, Violet and Apple Blossom awakens the senses, encouraging you to embrace your bohemian, eccentric side. Finished with base notes of tangy Plum, rich Cedarwood and opulent Musk, the perfume is bursting with contrasting layers, highlighting the complexities and depth that make up the modern woman. The perfume is encased in a charming, curvaceous bottle, showcasing the powder-pink liquid within. The pastel-coloured daises, embellished with gold-toned hardware that adorn the lid, add a retro element that is destined to add a splash of excitement wherever the bottle is placed.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Rosea Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Unveil Jean Paul Gaultier's La Belle Rosea, a floral, aquatic and amber Eau de Parfum that radiates like a precious stone. A crystalline aquatic accord opens with freshness, followed by a blooming heart of peony. At the base, vanilla unleashes its sensual notes for an embrace that lingers on the skin. Embodying a sublime Garden of Eden adorned with gold and crystals, the classic sculptural torso perfume bottle is illuminated by the orange-pink fragrance within, complemented by a golden floral jewel set within a garnet. Spritz the perfume as your final accessory to captivate everyone's gaze.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A signature in the making, the Burberry Her Eau de Parfum elevates the art of fragrance to daring new heights. Crafted with a bold trifecta of notes, this feminine scent elevates your collection with precision and poise. Opening with a delicate cherry overture, it teases with a sweet, gourmand whisper rather than an overpowering fruity punch. Beneath this, amber lends a sensual, sun-warmed glow, wrapping the skin in a sentiment of freedom and expression. Vanilla absolute grounds the fragrance and establishes a time-old, lasting decadence. Far from a fleeting mist, the EDP offers a sultry take on amber, flirting with freedom while remaining sophisticated. As inspired as the woman who wears it, the fragrance is housed in an opaque pink bottle, then accented with ribbons for a feminine flourish.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne 1 Million Elixir Parfum Intense 200ml
listings.description: Sensual and absolute, Rabanne 1M Elixir 22 Parfum Intense amplifies the opulence of the original best-selling Eau de Parfum. An opening of crisp apple and davana entices the senses, revealing a heart of hand-picked Turkish Damascena rose, its intoxicating, liquorous quality complementing nuances of elegant osmanthus and enduring cedar. Seduction meets unrivalled lasting power as the fragrance warms on the skin, lingering with a base of creamy vanilla absolute, wild-grown tonka bean and earthy patchouli. Capturing the thrill of excess, this truly hedonistic scent draws its power from the extreme quality of its raw materials, creating a masterpiece composition worthy of any millionaire.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Pod and Oil Set
listings.description: Equipping you with everything needed to create a personal sanctuary, the NEOM Pod and Oil bundle features the brand’s iconic electric diffuser and two essential oil blends. The ceramic-coated diffuser pod blends in with any interior to transform your home and inspire an atmosphere of tranquillity. Set Contents: NEOM Wellbeing Pod Transform your living space at the touch of a button as this electronic diffuser instantly scents your home. The iconic pod expertly diffuses an optimal amount of fragrance to enrich your home and inspire self-care. NEOM Scent to Sleep Essential Oil Blend 10ml A blend of 19 essential oils including English lavender, sweet basil and jasmine combined in a pure and potent concoction. Formerly known as Tranquillity, the essential oil blend promotes an atmosphere of peace. NEOM Scent to Make You Happy Essential Oil Blend 10ml An uplifting blend of neroli, mimosa and lemon interlace to encourage an uplifting and restorative atmosphere.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Femme Sunrise Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Moncler Pour Femme Sunrise Eau de Parfum captivates with a delicate blend of woody and floral notes, effortlessly juxtaposing softness with underlying strength. Powdery tones of violet leaf lead the way, amplified by juicy pear and refreshing grapefruit. At the centre, a posy of peony, lily of the valley, Egyptian jasmine and freesia add an elegant touch. The scent transcends onto a rich sandalwood base and cedar, topped with warming ambergris accords. Reminiscent of the sun's golden hues rising over the mountains, the fragrance is encased inside a gold-toned bottle, delicately detailed with signature branding.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Couture Eau de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Evoking a confident, feminine feel, the Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Couture Eau de Parfum 100ml juxtaposes fruity notes with warming accords. A couture fruity amber fragrance, it blends juicy raspberry, sugary meringue, intense benzoin and whipped vanilla to create a scent that feels soft, addictive and powerful. Encased in the iconic corset-contoured, refillable bottle, sculpted in pink lacquer with a braided gold corset and piercing detail, Divine Couture is more than a fragrance; it’s a statement worn on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Re-Charge Black Pepper Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Invigorate your senses with the Molton Brown Re-Charge Black Pepper Eau de Parfum. The earthy fragrance is inspired by the vibrant landscapes of Madagascar, where off-road treks lead to powerful mountains and vast savannah canyons across spice-toned earth amidst a warm breeze. It opens with energetic top notes of black pepper, lemon and ginger. A herbal heart of coriander, basil and violet leaf adds a luscious botanical accord that descends into a woody base of vetiver, oakmoss and ambergris. Embark on an adventure with this confident fragrance, and give in to your wanderlust.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Reimagining gourmand as you know it, the Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum explores the boundaries between sweet and salty in this sophisticated display of floral amber nuances. Opening with a bouquet of neroli and orange flower, the scent transcends the floral realm with its zesty aura. At its heart, salted pistachio adds an unexpected twist with an addictive roasted note. Sophisticated sandalwood grounds the scent at the base to leave a modern, sensual trail.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Her 50ml
listings.description: Experience the power of seduction with the BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Her. Hugo Boss captures the dichotomy of femininity with a floral-amber blend of fiery, yet anchoring notes that reveal an intoxicating trail. Sweet but energising, nuances of juicy peach open the scent, honeyed by a bouquet of osmanthus at the heart. White musk lingers at the base with a hint of sensuality and wanting that compels the sense to desire more. Housed in a refillable bottle, the flacon features the BOSS logo on translucent, golden glass and a BOSS Double-B monogram icy-gold cap.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Intense 80ml
listings.description: Causing a scene once again, Jean Paul Gaultier makes a provocative return with Scandal Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Intense, an addictive aroma that diffuses an irresistible floral trail. As the night unwinds, captivating spiced cardamom is met by a bouquet of ylang ylang to uncover a rich decadence that combines pleasure and desire. Creamy vanilla unveils a tempting, gourmand twist as sensuality and passion ripple through the scent to leave behind an unforgettable aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Les Infusions de Gingembre Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Imparting a second skin-like scent with a citrus twist, Prada’s Les Infusions de Gingembre Eau de Parfum celebrates the multi-faceted charm of ginger. Warming to your body, the fragrance unfurls into a woody medley that mingles with the vibrant nuances of zesty fruit and the lively spice, granting a personalised musk finish that’s fresh yet complex. Enriched with green mandarin for its enlivening composition, alongside ginger and geranium, the eau de parfum imbues an uplifting aroma, before vetiver adds an authentic edge. This cheerful olfactive character is reflected by the fragrance’s glass flacon, a yellow-tinted bottle with a saffiano cap to symbolise its luminosity.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne 10ml
listings.description: The Jo Malone London Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne will breathe oceanic life into your perfume collection. Grounded with earthy sage, the fragrance is topped with a textural accord of ambrette seeds for a subtle woody overtone. Cut through by a wave of sea salt at the heart, the scene dries down to leave an aromatic, pure scent that lifts you up in freshness and whisks you away to the shoreline. Best-selling and based on the elements, bask in the London label’s energising scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Velvet Rose & Oud All Over Body Spray 125ml
listings.description: Jo Malone London's Velvet Rose & Oud All Over Body Spray arrives in a lightweight, mist-on format, designed to layer effortlessly while leaving a bold olfactive mark. Spice-laced florals meet a dark, woody centre. Romantic in mood, the composition rests on a richly resinous oud base that intrigues the senses long after the fragrance is first sprayed. A heart of damask rose, picked and distilled at dawn for a stronger profile, is suffused with honey facets that inject warmth into your aroma. Topping the mist is a sharp and presence-affirming hit of clove. Layer this spray over the label's cologne in the same scent for double the intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Silver Birch & Lavender Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Top Note: Grapefruit. Heart Note: English Lavender. Base Note: Silver Birch. Embark on an enchanting scent trail through Lavenderland, a world of violet visions. This limited-edition collection captures English lavender, meandering in purple pathways across the countryside. Morning light illuminates a rambling garden, framed by silver birch trees. The coolness of the crisp air cuts through the unmistakeable scent of English lavender. A squeeze of grapefruit invigorates the senses, grounded by a charismatic, woody base of silver birch and roasted oak.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Florabloom Absolu by Guerlain is an enchanting floral bouquet by moonlight. Tuberose becomes more sensual and hypnotic, accompanied by an enigmatic Four O’Clock Flower accord. The warm depth of sandalwood and the woody refinement of patchouli beautifully enhance this powerful and addictive composition, inspired by the fascinating spectacle of desert superblooms at nightfall. Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts in the moonlight.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau De Parfum Rose Velvet 80ml
listings.description: Givenchy’s Irresistible Eau de Parfum Rose Velvet is a romantic scent that embraces tenderness as the new bold. Forming a part of the quintessential Irresistible collection, the fragrance offers an elegant olfactory experience with a new iris accord. The scent opens with succulent top notes of blackcurrant, invigorated by sharp, spicy nuances of pink pepper essence. Rose, Givenchy’s signature Irresistible note, lends the scent a sensual floral aroma, before settling onto a bed of white patchouli and wood for an irresistible finish.

listings.rawTitle: The Body Shop White Musk Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Feel empowered with The Body Shop's most iconic scent, White Musk Eau de Parfum. The fragrance brings together fresh, airy notes with sensual musk for a timeless perfume that uplifts its wearer. Clean aldehydic notes blend with floral lily of the valley, powdery jasmine and comforting white musk for a signature scent that endures. Layer with the White Musk Body Lotion for even more intensity and longevity.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Built around the same signature accords of the eau de toilette, the BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum is an intense interpretation of the woody-floral fragrance. Pushing the boundaries of olfactive craftmanship, perfumer Alberto Morillas takes inspiration from precious gemstones, infusing the scent with sparkling, striking nuances. Expressing its radiant florality is a blend of jasmine, sourced from the “Flower Gems of India” program, and green tea lotus, pairing perfectly with the sweetly sophisticated scents of nashi pear and green mandarin essence. Underpinning the eau de parfum is a refined sandalwood base, laced with luminous musks for a second skin-like finish. Committing to its original design, the fragrance arrives in a curved interlocked flacon with a warmed rose gold touch.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Introducing Elizabeth Arden's timeless White Tea fragrance, now in an Eau de Parfum. Classic and pure, the fragrance captures graceful femininity in a bottle. Luxurious Italian mandarin and sea breeze accords blend with clary sage to evoke a herbaceous freshness. A floral sweetness enters at the heart with elegant rose and sensual jasmine, blending with the star of the scent, heavenly white tea extract. Allow yourself to be transported to a blissful escape with a trio of tranquil musks and deeply aromatic tonka bean absolute. Clean, elegant, and uncomplicated, Elizabeth Arden’s White Tea scent is for the sophisticated woman.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Magnetic Elixir Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Spritz your pulse points with the warm, comforting allure of Calvin Klein’s Euphoria Magnetic Elixir, an irresistible Eau de Parfum infused with floral and earthy notes. Wrapped in softness and sweetness, it unveils creamy vanilla tones balanced by the clean warmth of musk, creating a cosy yet elevated scent that lingers close to the skin. Smooth and captivating, this fragrance transitions from day to evening, featuring a 28% ultra-concentrated formula for amplified intensity and long-lasting depth.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Eau Rosee Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Find a chic companion in the Miu Miu L’Eau Rosée Eau de Toilette, a chypre fragrance that captures the multifacetedness of femininity. Dewy and luminous, it opens with the delicate freshness of lily of the valley, sharpened by a punchy lychee top note. This floral-fruity pairing shares a deep rosiness, conjuring shades of pink in the fruity-floral bouquet. Grounded in musk and wrapped in woody notes of musk, the scent settles into a mysterious, textured base – a nod to the signature trails of Miu Miu fragrances. Presented in a pink-hued matelassé glass flacon that catches the light with every turn, the bottle is topped off with a contrasting navy collar and crisp white disc.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Perfume Stand for 100ml
listings.description: Elevate your vanity or bedside table with the Orebella Perfume Stand, designed exclusively for 100ml fragrances by the brand. Inspired by the raw beauty of geodes, its sculptural form mirrors the architectural elegance of Orebella’s signature bottles. Thoughtfully debossed with the brand’s iconic logo, this gold-toned metal stand cradles your favourite scent from the olfactory range – bringing ritual and visual finesse to your space.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Red Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: A crisp yet comforting cologne by Lacoste that exudes woody notes with an energising undertone. The Red eau de Toilette Spray is a fiercely fresh fragrance powered by green apple and pine tree, paired with the earthiness of patchouli for a full-bodied fougere scent. Developed by perfumer Annick Menardo, the eau de toilette features a harmonious blend of jasmine, thuya wood and vetiver, capturing the dynamic character of the contemporary Lacoste man. Housed in a quadratic flacon embossed with the brand’s signature crocodile mascot and topped with a red cap, the spray stands proud on any dresser.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme, Idôle Peach’N Roses Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Evolved from the 2019 Idôle, Lancôme’s Idôle Peach ’N Roses arrives with a brighter, more fruit-driven expression, reimagined for effortless daytime wear. Building on the house’s signature rose DNA, the fragrance introduces a softer, juicier dimension to your collection. A lively burst of red currant opens the composition, lending a crisp, lightly tart sparkle that sets a feel-good tone from the first spritz. At the heart, succulent peach takes centre stage, wrapping the florals in a velvety sweetness that feels contemporary and inviting. Beneath it all, the iconic Idôle rose base anchors the scent, adding a smooth, petal-rich familiarity.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rich, deep, and addictive, the Aramis Intuition Intense Eau de Parfum reveals a darker, more powerful expression. Cool juniper berry and sharp black pepper ignite the senses, leading into aromatic lavender softened by honeyed osmanthus. As it settles, creamy vanilla and rich oakwood unfold, wrapped in Cuirissima LXR, Aramis’ exclusive leather essence.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Blooming Fire Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Ignite your senses with Orebella Blooming Fire Eau De Parfum, a warm floral fragrance that captures the heat of sun-drenched skin. Sparkling bergamot and spiced cardamom open into a luminous heart of Tahitian monoi and jasmine, before settling into the sensual depth of patchouli and cedarwood. The result is a radiant, tropical warmth that feels both fiery and serene.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Drops Love for Her - 30 Capsules
listings.description: A new way to enjoy the iconic scent, Marc Jacobs introduces the Daisy Drops, a collection of single-dose fragrance capsules designed to conveniently fit in your bag or pocket for any-time touch-ups. Each tiny capsule is filled with a gel-like composition, infused with a playful celebration of the classic Marc Jacobs perfume. Formulated to be long-lasting, the travel-friendly floral fragrance for women opens with a pop of crystallised cloudberries, balanced by delicate daisy tree petals. At the base, driftwoods lend a vibrant freshness for an addictive olfactive experience. Decorated with a halo of signature daisy icons, the aluminium tin holds 30 capsules. Simply twist, squeeze and apply to unleash an olfactive experience wherever you go.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau De Parfum Concrete 2.7g
listings.description: A pocket-sized fragrance solid that enhances your trail with Givenchy’s iconic Irresistible Eau De Parfum scent. Made to swipe on fruity-floral notes, this perfume concrete lends longevity, layering seamlessly with your favourite spray. Encapsulating a rose bouquet, each glide of this fragrant stick releases sparkling notes of pear, rose, iris and blonde woods. Brimming with freshness, the formula also helps to hydrate the skin with wear, leaving no sticky residue thanks to its light, velvety texture. Keeping it couture, this travel-friendly fragrance arrives in the brand’s signature 4G embossed packaging.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Fleur De Lait Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Emulate the Miu Miu girl with the French label's Fleur De Lait Eau de Parfum. Whipped up with a considered contrast of accords, the fragrance will lend your aroma the sweetness and depth it was missing. Topped with a burst of mango, the blend doesn't shy away from leaving a fruity first impression. Conjuring a beachside cocktail or a tropical sorbet, this first layer leads naturally into osmanthus, an exotic flower laced with delicate apricot facets. Think visceral orange and yellow hues distilled into a feminine sillage. As the dry-down unfolds, a creamy whisper of coconut emerges, softening the edges with its calming, skin-like warmth. The luxe design comes packaged in a pink-tinged matelassé glass bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Million Gold For Her Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Another core favourite from the pioneering brand, the Rabanne Million Gold For Her Parfum offers an intensely floral, golden bouquet. Enveloping the senses in a floral surge to begin with, solar ylang ylang is caressed by sweet jasmine in the top layer. Sandalwood and a floral woody accord add grounding elements to the olfactive pyramid, infusing the ultra-feminine fragrance with a sophisticated impulse. The luminous result is inspired by one of the brand's archival scents, dialled up in intensity for a perfume that lights up your presence. The scent is outfitted in a gradient bottle, with a faceted exterior, XL chain-link motif, and debossed logo cap.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum Atomizer 10ml
listings.description: ‘Vibrant, effervescent and transportive’ is Tom Ford’s description of the Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum from the Private Blend collection. Inspired by the sensory delights of the Italian Riviera, the fragrance sparkles with the fresh zing of citrus fruit, evoking the perfumed breeze that sweeps from the verdant groves over the rugged cliffs. The fragrance introduces a floral heart of Neroli, Orange Flower and Lavender, before delving into a deep dry down of Amber and aromatic Rosemary. Housed in a blue and gold-tone atomizer with magnetic closure.

listings.rawTitle: LF Exclusive NEOM Blush Wellbeing Pod Bundle
listings.description: The LF Exclusive NEOM Blush Wellbeing Pod Bundle pairs a fan-favourite diffuser with a collection of essential oil blends, allowing you to curate your space with uplifting aromas. Set Contents: NEOM Wellbeing Pod Essential Oil Diffuser with Blush Cover A limited-edition blush-toned diffuser that releases an aromatic mist, creating a softly scented ambience when paired with your chosen NEOM Wellbeing Essential Oil. Scent to Sleep Essential Oil 10ml Blended with the Neom Tranquillity™ fragrance, this scent features a mix of 19 essential oils, including English lavender, sweet basil and jasmine. Scent to De-Stress Essential Oil 10ml Infused with the brand’s Real Luxury™ fragrance, this soothing blend combines essential oils of lavender, jasmine and Brazilian rosewood. Scent to Make You Happy Essential Oil 10ml The Happiness™ fragrance pairs neroli, mimosa and lemon essential oils to create a bright, uplifting aroma. Scent to Boost Your Energy Essential Oil 10ml The Feel Refreshed™ fragrance brings together Sicilian lemon and fresh basil essential oils for a crisp scent.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances relaunches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men presents an aromatic Fougère, that inspires a fresh take on blending sensuality with living authentically. Suggestive and unexpected, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men is a woody, aromatic and spicy aftershave fragrance created to provoke self-confidence and acceptance from within. Rose and Chili Pepper present an unexpected and invigorating retro vibe, while Patchouli and Cedarwood accentuate this Eau de Parfum for men’s richness and sensuality. Encapsulated in a fully metallised bottle, the seductive scent is dressed in dark anthracite, with a matching cap. The design is finished with the house’s emblematic Interlocking G logo.

listings.rawTitle: Aromatherapy Associates Deep Relax Pure Essential Oil Blend 10ml
listings.description: Experience the tranquil aromas of Aromatherapy Associates’ Deep Relax Pure Essential Oil Blend. A comforting fusion of vetivert, camomile and sandalwood offer a soothing scent, designed to help prepare you for an evening of relaxation or sleep. The 100% natural oil blend can be welcomed into your chosen room when paired with The Atomiser for diffusion, or inhaled by adding drops to your wrists or to a warm bath.

listings.rawTitle: Rituals The Ritual of Jing Lotus Flower & Jujube Home Perfume 400ml
listings.description: A relaxing room spray that fills your home with delicate lotus blooms and the comforting warmth of sun-kissed jujube. Each spritz transforms your space into a nurturing sanctuary, where airy lotus petals bring clarity and peacefulness, gently intertwined with the sweet, cosy embrace of jujube. A harmonious, calming aroma that elevates your home with effortless sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Million Gold For Her Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Another core favourite from the pioneering brand, the Rabanne Million Gold For Her Parfum offers an intensely floral, golden bouquet. Enveloping the senses in a floral surge to begin with, solar ylang ylang is caressed by sweet jasmine in the top layer. Sandalwood and a floral woody accord add grounding elements to the olfactive pyramid, infusing the ultra-feminine fragrance with a sophisticated impulse. The luminous result is inspired by one of the brand's archival scents, dialled up in intensity for a perfume that lights up your presence. The scent is outfitted in a gradient bottle, with a faceted exterior, XL chain-link motif, and debossed logo cap.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Lilac Path Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: The spirit of spring, perfectly encapsulated in a fragrance. The Lilac Path Eau de Parfum is a rich scent offering inspired by Aerin Lauder’s morning ritual of gathering flowers for the house, featuring a blooming bouquet of notes that transport the senses to a garden of serenity. Featuring fresh, delicate nuances of orange flower, privet and lilac, the perfume draws to mind images of a garden path lined with beautiful plants that dance in the breeze, imparting a delicate aroma that lingers in the air.

listings.rawTitle: OUAI North Bondi Eau de Parfum Travel Size
listings.description: Floral; Aromatic Top Notes: Bergamot, Apple Blossom, Raspberry, Italian Lemon. Heart Notes: Rose de Mai, Jasmine, Violet. Base Notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, White Musk. Soak up the seductive scent of Australia’s beaches with OUAI’s North Bondi Eau de Parfum; a nuanced blend of rich florals and sheer white musk, inspired by the meeting of the city and the sea at Sydney’s Bondi Beach. Bursting open with a citrusy wave of crisp and tangy fruit notes that expertly blends Bergamot and Apple Blossom with Sicilian Lemon and Raspberry, the fragrance bleeds into a heart of rich floral blossoms. Hints of Rose, Jasmine and Violet are engulfed by a musky-earthy backdrop of Patchouli, Sandalwood and White Musk, leaving behind an intoxicating sillage. Presented in a travel-friendly mini size.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Elixir de Parfum for Women 100ml
listings.description: Capturing the essence of fearless and fierce femininity, Burberry’s Her Elixir de Parfum bottles a bold fruity fragrance with a sensual and adventurous olfactive story. A daring burst of dark berries opens the scent trail, immersing the senses in an addictive air from the very first spritz. A soft floral heart of jasmine pairs perfectly with the luscious fruit facets, emboldened by a golden creamy base of vanilla and amber. Housed in a pastel pink bottle with the brand name embossed, the parfum brings a confident charm to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Beyond Intense Eau de Toilette 150ml
listings.description: The Hugo Boss Bottled Beyond Intense Eau de Toilette is a bold fragrance where luminous freshness meets warm, textured depth. Fresh yet commanding, the long-lasting scent leaves a confident trail, making it an effortless choice for evenings and occasions that call for a bolder signature. Created by perfumers Daphne Bugey, Frank Voelkl and Bruno Jovanovic, the scent opens with orange blossom absolute, releasing a vibrant surge of floral brightness that feels powerful and energising before settling into rich leather for a smooth, sensual warmth that balances the radiant opening with deeper intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Amber Labdanum Cologne Intense 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the sun-drenched hills of Andalusia, Jo Malone London’s Amber Labdanum Cologne Intense balances a citrus breeze with warm amber facets. At its heart, resinous labdanum takes centre stage, leading the fragrance trail with a sweet, musky aroma. Enhanced by creamy vanilla and roasted oak, the scent lingers on the skin with a sensuous allure, lasting long after the very first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Boss The Unlimited Eau de Toilette (Various Sizes)
listings.description: Inspired by the BOSS Man’s drive to succeed in all areas of life, The Unlimited Eau de Toilette encapsulates a burst of motivating energy through an aromatic, energising combination. The thrill when reaching personal goals and achievements is translated into this modern fragrance for men. The scent opens with a burst of iced violet leaves, mingling with refreshing mint and juicy pineapple for an exhilarating confidence boost. An enduring evergreen cistus celebrates the boundless energy of surpassing goals, alongside a rich base of sandalwood and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Filled with full-bodied fruit nuances, the Jo Malone London English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne uplifts the senses with its fresh, tempting accords. Juicy Williams pear buds at the opening of the fragrance, warmed by the mellow accents of pastel sweet peas, evoking the sentiment of strolling through a crisp green garden on a spring afternoon. Powdered white musk enhances the scent trail, cocooning the cologne in an airy softness that lingers long after the very first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez All of Me Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml Gift Set
listings.description: The Narciso Rodriguez All Of Me Eau de Parfum Intense Gift Set unites three scented luxuries, perfect for layering the brand’s bold floral fragrance. The multi-faceted perfume is built upon a signature heart of musk, layered with a bouquet of black iris and tuberose. A base of Australian sandalwood and warm vanilla provides a rich, lasting warmth. Set Contents: Eau de Parfum Intense All Of Me 50ml The Eau de Parfum Intense envelops the skin in a vibrant floral scent, blending notes of black iris, tuberose and a signature heart of musk. Body Lotion All Of Me 50ml A lightweight body lotion that helps to soften and smooth the skin, leaving it lightly scented with the All Of Me fragrance. Shower Gel All Of Me 50ml The luxurious shower gel gently cleanses the skin, creating a rich lather that imparts the signature floral and musky notes.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Fiery Pink Pepper Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Discover the vibrant scent of a tropical location with the Molton Brown Fiery Pink Pepper Eau de Parfum. The heat of pepper is enriched with the zesty bite of tangerine and aromatic warmth of ginger, transporting the senses to a volcanic island bursting with luscious wildlife. The fragrance is entranced by the sweetness of lily of the valley while offering a botanical fusion of jasmine and ciste. Patchouli, cedarwood and musk form the earthy base notes while blossoming osmanthus radiates through the fragrance for an exotic escape.

listings.rawTitle: K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Intense is a strong and charismatic masculine fragrance that combines a seductive leathery woody accord with notes of saffron and fig.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Delve into the mysterious aura of Molton Brown's Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Eau de Parfum, a precious, heady perfume inspired by aromas from the East. The scent opens with notes of davana, cardamom and bergamot, heightened by a strong heart of saffron, black tea and creamy vanilla. Conjuring visions of the sun-kissed roads of Assam, base notes of tobacco, oudh and styrax resin lead you on an intensely captivating journey.

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Eau Des Jardins Treatment Fragrance 100ml
listings.description: Refresh your body and mind with the Clarins Eau Des Jardins Natural Spray. Combining fragrance with skincare benefits, the botanical, aromatherapy-inspired mist is made with 92% natural origin ingredients to help hydrate, tone and soothe skin. Inspired by a garden at daybreak, the uplifting floral fragrance opens with grapefruit, bergamot and orange, layered with aromatic mint and bay leaf. Rose, cedar and blackcurrant bud add floral and woody depth, while organic beech and rowan bud extracts care for skin. The result is a bright, energising scent designed to inspire a feel-good moment with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Eau de Grey Vetiver Eau de Toilette 10ml
listings.description: Tap into your dynamic side with Tom Ford’s Grey Vetiver Eau de Toilette, a woody-spicy elixir that elevates any scent collection. The fragrance embodies what the designer calls  the essence o f  debonair, charismatic, and provocative masculinity . Vetiver makes up its core, that textured, earthy treasure revered by master perfumers for centuries. In Ford’s hands, this note is remixed and reborn: sharpened by crisp citrus and livened up by colourful nuances. Orange flower and grapefruit introduce an invigorating brightness, while nutmeg and pimento weave a subtle, seductive spice. Woody oakmoss adds a grounding element to the scent pyramid, forging a depth that lingers when you exit the room. The fragrance is housed in a clean, minimalist bottle with matte silver-tone accents and a debossed logo.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Eau de Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Starts each day with a taste of the Mediterranean with Acqua Di Parma’s signature citrus blend, Colonia Eau de Cologne. The zesty aroma bottles up metropolitan life as an awakening aroma. Effortlessly elegant and radiantly refined, the fragrance opens with a cocktail of lemon, orange and bergamot. At its core, a bouquet of lavender, rose and verbena flourishes at the heart for a subtle reminder of the natural world. Vetiver, sandalwood and patchouli bring the scent to life with decadence and sophistication. Crafted with luxury in mind, the fragrance’s flacon celebrates the Art Deco movement with its transparent glass and classic black cap.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense - 100ml
listings.description: Floral Top Notes : Italian Mandarin, Crispy Green Apple, Neroli Essence. Heart Notes : Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Coconut. Base Notes : Dark Vanilla, Cedarwood, Cashmere. Mysterious and enticing, The Only One Intense Eau de Parfum from Dolce & Gabbana captures the room’s attention. Housed in a sleek black bottle, elegant yet understated, this fragrance seduces the senses, symbolizing the indefinable allure of a confident woman. Drawing you in, the fragrance opens with the fresh notes of Mandarin and Apple, enhancing the cologne with an exhilarating aroma. Diving into the heart, a seamless blend of Orange Blossom, Coconut and Jasmine intensifies the perfume, creamy and comforting. Finally, the enigmatic base of Dark Vanilla and Cedarwood creates a captivating aura, enveloping the skin with its mesmerizing scent.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana L'Imperatrice Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Lavish in the flamboyant energy of Dolce & Gabbana L'Imperatrice Eau de Toilette. For charismatic women who desire to live as movie stars, the striking EDT blends exotic fruits with bright pink florals, all balanced on a musky base. Opening with vibrant notes of rhubarb and juicy kiwi, the magnetic fragrance dives into a fresh heart of watermelon, before succumbing to a deep base centered around musk and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A solar floral fragrance, wrapped in coco de mer accords, to evoke the warm sparkling scent of the hot summer’s sun melting into the crystalline sea. Tom Ford’s Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum Spray exudes sensuality and luxury, with paradisal notes reminiscent of sunny tropical islands. A masterful blend of crisp citrus nuances evolves into a warmer, richer heart, featuring creamy pistachio and cardamom. Exotic ylang-ylang relaxes on a sumptuous base of coco de mer for a tantalising allure. Housed in a minimalistic white bottle with a splash of gold, the eau de parfum crowns any dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Looking for an elevated vanilla scent? This TOM FORD Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum isn't your typical gourmand, layered with an inimitable blend of notes to distinguish your every entrance. On the first spritz, a velvety ribbon of vanilla tincture from India comes through, complemented by a comforting layer of vanilla absolute. As the fragrance settles, sandalwood essence glides in like polished mahogany, adding a quietly powerful dimension to the pyramid: picture a dimly lit room filled with antique wood and gently flickering shadows. True to the label's signature edge, an animalis accord in the base disrupts the softness of vanilla, leaving behind a complex, musky trail that naturally turns heads. Encased in a gold-tone flacon, the bottle itself is a statement of luxury. It's framed by a sleek clear border and finished with signature branding.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Collection Neroli Letters EdP 125ml
listings.description: Drawn inspiration from handwritten travel notes and the sunlit setting of the Mediterranean, the Montblanc Collection Neroli Letters Eau de Parfum opens with bergamot, bright and bitter, before moving into airy neroli blossom. Patchouli brings a dry, earthy nuance, while ambery woods settle on the skin for a warm, woody finish. Housed in a glass bottle inspired by Montblanc’s heritage ink design, the fragrance reflects the Maison’s writing legacy through clean lines and distinct detail.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Lumière d'Égypte Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An olfactive expedition awaits with the Chloé Nomade Lumière D'Égypte Eau De Parfum 50ml. Drawing inspiration from the birthplace of founder Gaby Aghion, the fragrance transports the senses to the beautiful landscapes of Egypt. The opening takes its wearer on a journey along the Nile. Featuring fresh, aquatic nuances of blue lotus and a sensuous jasmine accord, the scent evokes images of the river and its beautiful surrounding vegetation. As the fragrance unfurls, a kyphi accord unveils itself, paying homage to ancient Egyptian perfumery with a warming blend of sandalwood, cinnamon bark and myrrh. The luxurious flacon takes sunlight as its muse, featuring a luminous gold colour and glowing accents. Tied with a dusky blue knot, Chloé Nomade Lumière D'Égypte is an eye-catching addition to your scent collection.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Inviting you on a olfactive journey of decadence and pleasure, Jean Paul Gaultier's Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Intense touches the skin with an aromatic, woody trail that leads to desire. The intensified fragrance opens with enlivening clary sage for an earthy nuance that tempts the senses. A heart of leather is intensified by sensual vetiver for a seductive ending to an unforgettable scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Elixir Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier captures the warmth of golden skin and sunlit shores, encased in a reimagined corset glistening in molten gold. It’s a showstopper before you’ve even sprayed. Demanding attention from the first spritz, Divine Elixir Parfum blends salty floral notes with bold tuberose and sensual tonka bean, wrapped in an unapologetically feminine amber accord. Intensely radiant, irresistibly commanding—where creamy warmth and marine freshness collide.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Million Gold Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Million Gold Eau de Parfum encapsulates the thrill of success. The intense 100ml fragrance from Rabanne offers a powerful, sensuous take on the Million man, thrilling the senses with its addictive woody blend. Finding the perfect balance between warm and fresh, the scent marries juicy mandarin with creamy sandalwood and cedarwood accords. Wrapped in an elixir of spices, the perfume creates an exhilarating sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana’s Light Blue Eau de Parfum releases a bright, sun-kissed medley, reminiscent of the Amalfi coast. Opening with the sparkling aroma of Sicilian lemon, the fragrance unveils creamy, floral frangipani at the heart, before settling into an woody base. Together, these notes leave a luminous trail that works to awaken the senses and transform your routine into a radiant, vibrant experience. The essence arrives in a transparent glass bottle with subtle gold-toned details, revealing the golden hues of the juice. The blue enameled cap, inspired by Amalfi ceramics, is completed by an iconic Dolce & Gabbana monogram.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin Sur Le Nil Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: A garden full of life, generous and sparkling, where the scents of green mango, lotus blossom and rush blend with incense and sycamore wood. "A new and rather unusual concept of freshness; green and vegetal scents; the smell of water and sand." Jean-Claude Ellena Un Jardin sur le Nil is an impressionistic stroll through the island-gardens on the Nile at Aswan, the starting point for a new olfactory adventure. Green mango, lotus, calamus and sycamore wood all lie at the heart of this refreshing ode.

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons Gold Fair in Mayfair Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Imbuing a fresh amber scent with each spritz, the Gold Fair in Mayfair Eau de Parfum by Atkinsons captures the essence of one of London’s most coveted neighbourhoods. Crafted by perfumer Philippine Courtiére, the cologne opens with a mesmerising cocktail of absinthe and nutmeg, melting into the warmth of iris and cocoa beans. The earthiness of sage laces with the velvetiness of ambrox and vetiver, emboldened by a seductive smokiness of incense to give the fragrance longevity. The refined perfume is housed in a striking gold, glass-etched bottle designed by Christopher Jenner to capture the elegance of the Maison in Burlington Arcade.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Elixir Parfum Intense for Him 50ml
listings.description: A portrayal of raw intensity, BOSS The Scent Elixir Parfum Intense for Him takes the original BOSS The Scent fragrance to unparalleled levels of depth and magnetism. This rich, ambery-leathery-woody composition fuses fiery contrasts, creating an irresistible, captivating force. The fragrance ignites with the red-hot spice of pimento, leading into a heart of vibrant lavandin absolute, harvested from the sun-drenched fields of Provence. As tension reaches its peak, a warm, woody base of Caledonian sandalwood smoulders on the skin, leaving a long lasting masculine scent that boasts confidence and allure. Housed in a striking ruby-toned flacon, the multi-faceted design reflects the sensorial showdown within this charismatic scent. The deep-red lacquered glass, emblazoned with the BOSS logo, is crowned by a double-B monogrammed warm-gold cap as a symbol of strength and power. More than a fragrance, BOSS The Scent Elixir for Him captures the undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple, embodying bold sensuality and unwavering intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Iced Cologne Eau De Toilette Intense 60ml
listings.description: Step into the world of YSL with the Y Iced Cologne Eau De Toilette Intense, where freshness meets depth in a fragrance that captures pure confidence. The journey begins with a spark of spicy juniper berries, bringing an instant rush of cool, aromatic energy. As the scent unfolds, vibrant lavender from Provence takes centre stage, smooth, sophisticated, and effortlessly fresh. A touch of crisp geranium adds a green, floral brightness that feels both clean and contemporary. As the day deepens, the fragrance settles into elegant patchouli, wrapping the senses in warm, sensual woods. The result is a powerful scent that amplifies your individuality and lingers with bold intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum 50ml
listings.description: YSL’s signature scent of freedom, now at its most intense, Libre Le Parfum inspires and empowers its wearer to live life authentically and unapologetically. Reinvented with a spicy saffron accord, the floral fragrance pays tribute to the fierce, bold and untamed YSL woman, embodied by ambassador and British singer-songwriter Dua Lipa. The fragrance makes an olfactive statement by opening with spicy notes of ginger and saffron accord, harvested from YSL’s Ourika Gardens in Morocco. A floral heart of orange blossom and lavender is set against a smooth, ambery base, fusing vanilla, honey and vetiver for added depth and intensity. Housed in the signature Libre bottle, the perfume arrives in a fiery shade to reflect the key saffron notes of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Blooming Fire Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Ignite your senses with Orebella Blooming Fire Eau De Parfum, a warm floral fragrance that captures the heat of sun-drenched skin. Sparkling bergamot and spiced cardamom open into a luminous heart of Tahitian monoi and jasmine, before settling into the sensual depth of patchouli and cedarwood. The result is a radiant, tropical warmth that feels both fiery and serene.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Granting a charismatic olfactive charm with its quietly confident character, BVLGARI’s Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a musk cologne with an inviting woody warmth. The luxurious fragrance opens with an invigorating air of Darjeeling tea accord and ginger essence, emboldened by Ceylan tea and guaiac wood to entice the senses with a refined, superior scent. Adding a touch of sophisticated sensuality are nuances of ambrette seed and white musk, providing a multi-dimensional elegance that captures the allure of the contemporary BVLGARI man.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom Elixir Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Experience the excitement of the Rabanne Phantom Elixir Parfum Intense, an exhilarating scent that transports the senses to the most electrifying parties of Paris in just a spritz. Made for the rock and roll night owls, the fragrance reveals the contrast between night and day as the Phantom returns. Refreshing marine accord opens the scent with a vibrant burst of mineral oud, grounded by warming vanilla to embrace the duality of Rabanne masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: K by Dolce&Gabbana EDP Trio Gift Set
listings.description: The K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Gift Set offers a complete fragrance ritual for the modern man. Inspired by the rugged landscapes of Tuscany, the charismatic scent layers vibrant citrus with warm, earthy notes. This three-piece collection combines the iconic EDP with complementary body care essentials, perfect for layering the signature aroma. Set Contents: K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum 50ml The Eau de Parfum opens with a fusion of sicilian lemon and fig, leading to a warm heart and a sensual virginia cedarwood base. Housed in a regal blue flacon topped with a silver-patina crown. K by Dolce&Gabbana Deodorant Stick 75ml A deodorant stick designed to glide on smoothly, offering long-lasting freshness and effective protection against odour. The formula leaves the skin lightly scented with the signature K fragrance. K by Dolce&Gabbana Shower Gel 50ml This luxurious shower gel cleanses the skin while imparting the charismatic K by Dolce&Gabbana scent. The body wash creates a rich lather, leaving you feeling refreshed and ready for the day.
