listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Drops Signature for Her - 30 Capsules
listings.description: A new way to enjoy your favourite scent, Marc Jacobs introduces the Daisy Drops, a collection of single-dose fragrance capsules designed to conveniently fit in your bag or pocket for any-time touch-ups. Each tiny capsule is filled with a gel-like composition, infused with the signature scent for her. Juicy notes of wild berries unite with a powdery floral heart of violets for added sweetness. A base note of sandalwood adds a warm, earthy hint to balance the elegant feminine fragrance. Decorated with a halo of signature daisy icons, the aluminium tin holds 30 capsules for you to enjoy. Simply twist, squeeze and apply to unleash an olfactive experience wherever you go.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: Causing a scene once again, Jean Paul Gaultier makes a provocative return with Scandal Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Intense, an addictive aroma that diffuses an irresistible floral trail. As the night unwinds, captivating spiced cardamom is met by a bouquet of ylang ylang to uncover a rich decadence that combines pleasure and desire. Creamy vanilla unveils a tempting, gourmand twist as sensuality and passion ripple through the scent to leave behind an unforgettable aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Window2Soul Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Step into a luminous garden with the Orebella Window2Soul Eau De Parfum, a floral fragrance where a delicate bouquet of faceted rose and jasmine unfurls on the skin, kissed with fresh lemon for a natural, green brightness. Beneath the airy florals, warm tonka bean lingers softly, adding depth and a subtle sweetness. Light, elegant, and effortlessly radiant, this fragrance evokes sunlit mornings and gentle breezes.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Refill 150ml
listings.description: Breathe in the crisp scent of unexplored mountains and listen close to the crunching of fresh snow, as Moncler’s Pour Femme Eau de Parfum transcends the senses to an unexplored terrain. Cultivated with exclusive fragrance accords, the floral, woody, musky perfume is the female iteration of Moncler’s first scent. Enchanting bergamot, jasmine and heliotrope intertwine with a custom Powdery Snow accord to ignite a passion for adventure, equipping wearers with the desire to embrace the unknown. Achieving the impossible, the perfume obtains a Mountain Wood accord, embodying the magnificence of freedom and celebrating the beauty of nature. A velvety base of vanillin seeks to amplify the fresh and exclusive scents, capturing an impossibly nuanced yet familiar aroma. An ode to nature itself, this sparkling Eau de Parfum is testament to the intrinsic connection between Moncler and the outdoors. Revered globally, the refill perfume is designed to replenish your full-sized bottle for an endless sensorial experience.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Million Gold For Her Eau de Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: Making a grand floral entrance, Rabanne’s Million Gold for Her Eau de Parfum Refill oozes glittering confidence and sensuality thanks to its symphony of white flowers. The multi-faceted fragrance is opened by vibrant rose nuances, before melting into the soft, alluring bouquet of suede-like white florals. At its dry-down, mineral musk contrasts the gentle medley with a sea-kissed coolness, lingering on the skin to showcase the perfume’s versatility. Housed in a refill flacon to top up your existing 50ml 0r 90ml bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana's Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a luminous, fresh fragrance inspired by the Mediterranean. Opening with a crisp mandarin accord, the scent unfolds into a heart of seawater and cypress, creating a clean, aromatic depth. Salty, mineral nuances linger at the base, evoking sun-warmed skin and coastal air. Housed in a refined glass bottle with golden tones and a deep blue cap, it reflects the essence of the Amalfi Coast.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Aspen Woods Luxury Fragrance Oil 15ml
listings.description: The White Company Aspen Fragrance Oil blends aspen wood bark, birchwood, and vetiver perfectly. With just a few drops, the room is instantly filled with a breath of fresh clarity. Crisp and dry, the aspen wood bark rises like cool mountain air just after sunrise. As the scent begins to settle, smoky birchwood emerges while vetiver hums softly in the background for a grounding and meditative touch. Centred and serene, this fragrance oil evokes the feeling of a cool forest walk or a quiet campfire at dusk, infusing your home with the stillness of nature.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Strawberry, Pear. Heart Notes: Honey, Rosebud. Base Notes: Vanilla, Green Moss. Marc Jacobs’ Daisy Eau So Intense is a captivating fragrance filled with vibrant, sparkling notes. Bringing a deeper, more intense dimension to the beloved Daisy scent, the perfume is brimming with all of perfumer Alberto Morillas’ expertise in this bright yet sophisticated blend. Marrying playfulness with sprightly youth, the perfume opens with fruity Strawberry and fresh Pear, sinking into the sweetness of Honey. A heart of Rosebud adds a softer floral touch while smooth Vanilla creates a creamy, indulgent base. This is offset by Green Moss’ crisp presence for a balanced, fresher feel. Embodying warm springtime charm, the fragrance captures the ephemeral glow of the sunset.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Parfum for Women 100ml
listings.description: A new chapter of self-discovery, Burberry Goddess Parfum for Women radiates an intense magnetism that captivates those nearby. The ambery fragrance opens with a vibrant raspberry accord complemented by lavender essence from the original Eau de Parfum. The signature trio of vanilla extracts is unveiled at the heart, before a suede leather accord at the base conjures warmth and sensuality. Reminiscent of the shades of a radiant sunset, the refillable bronzed square bottle is housed in elegant light brown packaging adorned with a gold label inspired by Burberry’s signature gabardine fabric.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Le Parfum for Him 50ml
listings.description: BOSS The Scent Parfum for Him 50ml is inspired by the chemistry of a power couple. Intense and addictive, the fragrance offers an exhilarating olfactory experience. The perfume offers a full-bodied take on the iconic BOSS The Scent. Marrying juicy Maninka fruit with musky iris flower, the fragrance exudes sensuality. As it wears on the skin, leather accords begin to unfurl, wrapping the scent in a warm, rich embrace. The bottle features a sculptural silhouette and taupe lacquered glass. Topped with a rose-gold cap, the flacon exudes strength.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Elixir 60ml
listings.description: Emulating enigmatic allure, the Yves Saint Laurent Y Elixir is a powerful iteration of the signature scent that boasts the highest intensity. Its deep, spiced wood take on Y captures the olfactive attention in the most mesmeric manner, imbuing a majestic aroma that warms on the skin with wear. The fragrance’s singular white note, lavender, lends its fresh facets to open the trail, before Moroccan geranium makes way for the heady, resinous base. Sumptuously dark and desirable, notes of smoky incense and precious oud mingle to create a leather-like impression, draping the wearer with the same sensual effect.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Glitter Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent’s iconic floral fragrance, now reimagined with a sultry gourmand twist. Black Opium Glitter is utterly irresistible, inviting its wearer on an olfactive exploration of pleasure. The Eau de Parfum stars a marshmallow musk accord that adds a sexy sweetness to the fragrance. Electrified with the scent’s quintessential black coffee accord, juicy fruits and a luminous bouquet of orange blossoms, the fragrance intoxicates the senses with every spritz. The 50ml bottle takes on a new dazzling form. Featuring a sparkling silver colour and a pink glass window, the gem-like flacon is unapologetically provocative.

listings.rawTitle: NUXE Reve de Miel Delectable Fragrant Water 100ml
listings.description: Experience an olfactory journey into the universe of Rêve de Miel. The Delectable Fragrant Water portrays indulgent top notes of honey, fused into a citrus centre of orange blossom accords. The fragrance lands on a rich base of tonka bean and sandalwood, immersing the senses in a fiery amber aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette for Men 50ml
listings.description: Captivating with woody fresh notes, Burberry’s Hero Eau de Toilette for Men 50ml portrays a modern man who surpasses himself in all of life's challenges. The EDT features a trio of captivating cedarwood oils, brightened with bergamot for vibrancy and freshness. At the base, juniper and black pepper add an invigorating edge capturing the scent of a forest growing by the English coastline. Featuring an angular glass design, the bottle embodies strength and modernity like the fragrance it holds.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Crafted in France, Rabanne’s FAME Eau de Parfum captures Parisian magnetism, sophisticated yet playful, intriguing and sensual. Exuding an amber fragrance laced with sparkling fruits and soft florals, the eau de parfum is the scent of the contemporary woman. Mango and bergamot begin the olfactory adventure with juicy nuances, tantalising the senses with a sumptuous, slightly citrusy, aroma. A jasmine and incense heart warms the fragrance, followed by a rich base of sandalwood and creamy vanilla that scents the skin with addictive notes, creating an unforgettable allure. The fragrance arrives in a one-of-a-kind bottle, a feminine figurine dressed in couture, making the eau de parfum the perfect centrepiece on any dresser. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Le Parfum for Him 100ml
listings.description: BOSS The Scent Parfum for Him 100ml is inspired by the chemistry of a power couple. Intense and addictive, the fragrance offers an exhilarating olfactory experience. The perfume offers a full-bodied take on the iconic BOSS The Scent. Marrying juicy Maninka fruit with musky iris flower, the fragrance exudes sensuality. As it wears on the skin, leather accords begin to unfurl, wrapping the scent in a warm, rich embrace. The bottle features a sculptural silhouette and taupe lacquered glass. Topped with a rose-gold cap, the flacon exudes strength.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua Di Gio Profondo Parfum Spray 200ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the oceanic realm with the Armani Acqua Di Gio Profondo Parfum Spray. Capturing the allure of the deep marine mystery, aquatic accords crash into amber nuances to explore new depths and intensities. Opening with marine accords, the scent allows you to dive headfirst into the icy hues of deep freshness. Zesty bergamot and green mandarin create an olfactive contrast with lively, effervescent notes of citrus, replicating the unpredictable, tumultuous nature of the sea. At its core, an everlasting heart of lavender and rosemary displays a breathtaking dive into the natural world. Finishing with masculine character, a fusion of patchouli, vetiver and musk conveys a newfound richness with an unforgettable, bewitching trail. Imitating the ocean’s depth, the fragrance is contained within a deep blue flacon that fades from rich navy at its top to translucent turquoise.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Fraise Fouettée Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Le Monde Gourmand’s debut strawberry scent, Fraise Fouettée is the perfect balance between sweet and tart, whipping up a delicious recipe filled with fruity and floral accords. The Eau de Parfum mixes its star ingredient with nuances of orange and banana, melted by a mouth-watering drizzle of butter, sugar and vanilla cream. Freshened with a light and airy coconut water accord, the fragrance tantalises the senses with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Pulp Fruity Floral Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: With every spritz, Mugler's Alien Pulp Fruity Floral Eau de Parfum ignites a powerful, lasting impression. A vibrant, feminine burst of raspberry lands on the skin, enhanced by a zesty touch of orange and green mandarin, before melting into the creamy embrace of jasmine. A lily of the valley accord enhances the white flower’s petals, while temptation ultimately lingers in a woody allure, infused with Alien’s signature cashmeran.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Parfum 150ml Refill
listings.description: Refill your signature scent with the Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Parfum 150ml Refill. Embodying strength and technical innovation inspired by the power of carbon, the dark gourmand scent offers a modern olfactory experience. Opening with a fresh, airy burst of lavender, the fragrance feels instantly clean and calming. It evolves into a heart of addictive liquorice, before settling into a refined base of cypress. Contrasting fresh and woody notes, the scent lingers with a resinous depth that feels modern and effortlessly enduring.

listings.rawTitle: Khloé Kardashian Almost Always Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Embrace each spritz of Khloé Kardashian's Almost Always Eau de Parfum, a floral amber woody fragrance inspired by moments that matter the most. The scent blooms with lavender and magnolia, revealing a heart of star jasmine and orange blossom petals. Like a warming embrace, the base of Palo Santo, sensual woods, musks and vanilla add a sensual, addictive edge.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Showcasing a sparkling olfactive profile, the Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum by Juliette Has a Gun evokes the freshness of a crisp spring day, paired with the eternal sunshine of sweet musks for a well-rounded fruit fragrance. Succulent with a slight creaminess, the glazed green pear accord glistens amongst notes of ambroxan and cetalox, delivering a radiant, long-lasting dry down. Musk encourages a mellow softness, enhancing the clean composition while granting a multi-dimensional edge.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flower Bomb Pretty Peony Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Fans of all things feminine – reach for this Viktor & Rolf Flower Bomb Pretty Peony Eau de Parfum. The fruity fragrance by the luxe brand is hallmarked by gently provocative, mouth-watering notes. With a sweet vanilla and musk core, the blossoming aroma is centred around a comforting base, lingering on the skin. Building on this are enveloping traces of fresh peony, caressed by a burst of good-enough-to-eat strawberries in the very top layer. These add a moreish overtone to your presence as you drift from A to B, navigating dusk 'til dawn. The fragrance is housed in a faceted bottle with a deep pink hue, topped by a silver-tone cap and a designer moniker plaque.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Chypre Sublime Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Incense, Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Wild Geranium, Damask Rose Absolute, Midnight Violet. Base Notes: Patchouli, Labdanum, Benzoin, Olibanum. A muse to your inner creativity, the FloralStreet Chypre Sublime Eau de Parfum captivates the senses with an exotic and mesmerising fragrance. Wrapped in a vibrant floral design, the perfume bottle itself is a work of art. This modern and glamorous Chypre opens with notes of smoky incense and sharp pink pepper, shrouding a rich, intense bouquet of florals. Feel inspired by a blend of purified damask rose absolute, violets and geranium, soaring into spirit-awakening olibanum for a captivating finale. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Your Turn II Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Featuring multiple complex layers, Billie Eilish Your Turn II Eau de Parfum lends itself to both daytime and evening wear, offering a woody, fresh scent with a subtly spiced edge. It opens with the vibrant contrast of pimento berry, mirabelle plum and cassis leaves, creating a bright yet gently warming introduction. As the fragrance develops, notes of fig nectar, black tea and vanilla orchid emerge, adding a mellow, softly gourmand depth. Grounding the scent, a base of natural vetiver, olibanum resin and Virginia cedarwood lingers on the skin, leaving behind an earthy, smoky trail with lasting warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Sunflower Pop Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Passion Fruit. Heart Notes: Plum Blossom, Bellini Accord, Blue Orris. Base Notes: Crystallized Musk, Raw Honey, Crisp Amber. Inspired by the yellow-tipped sunflowers from the brush of Van Gogh, the FloralStreet Sunflower Pop Eau de Parfum imparts an effervescent, citrus fragrance. Bursting with sun-soaked fruits, this sumptuous citrus blend exudes the beauty and optimism of Van Gogh’s ‘Sunflowers’. This travel-sized fragrance opens with a union of refreshingly sweet mandarin and zesty bergamot, before revealing a pop of sparkling bellini accord. Raw vegan honey accord, musk and amber add a rich warmth to the base of this captivating scent trail. Adorned with vibrant sunflowers, the perfume vial itself is a masterpiece.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Toilette 150ml Refill (Worth £125)
listings.description: Prada interprets the exhilarating contemporary scent of carbon to create a sports-inspired scent. Strong and defiant, The Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Sport Refill blends steam-distilled botanicals and synthetics to combine both feats of nature and engineering. The mineral and amber fougere embodies the high-tech nature of the modern Prada man. The fragrance opens with revitalising top notes of Italian bergamot and pepper. At the heart, elegant masculine notes of lavender and soil tincture are contrasted with a metallic accord, evoking innovation and speed. Woody notes of patchouli and ambroxan add warmth at the base.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Not a Perfume Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A fragrance like no other, Not A Perfume offers a scent that is uniquely you. The pioneering formula by Juliette Has A Gun is made entirely out an element called Cetalox. Starting off with a clean and fresh aroma, the ingredient adapts to the skin’s chemistry as the scent wears, transforming into a fragrance that is one of a kind.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Him! Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Built up with a Parisian-inspired olfactory pyramid, this Zadig & Voltaire This Is Him! Eau de Toilette is confidence and creativity combined. Before displaying its woody-spicy character, the profile opens up with a vibrational layer of grapefruit. Progressing into vanilla, the fragrance becomes increasingly complex as it unfurls on the skin, inviting notions of rebellion and luxury. A refined trail is achieved thanks to a signature base layer of sandalwood. "I like when it leaves a trail, asserts a personality," says founder and art collector Thierry Gillier – a sentiment that carries through in the confident breakdown.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Purple Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Intimate yet expressive, the Valentino Born In Roma Donna Purple Eau de Parfum unfolds slowly on the skin, leaving a warm, smooth finish that lingers long after the first spritz. The scent opens with a blend of succulent plum, softened by floral osmanthus and a hint of creamy vanilla. As part of the Born in Roma fragrance collection, the fragrance is housed in the label's iconic studded bottle, tinted in a rich violet hue.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Sweet Almond Blossom Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: In collaboration with Van Gogh Museum®, Floral Street’s Sweet Almond Blossom Eau de Parfum offers a fragrance for the enchanting and ethereal. The fruity, floral, gourmand perfume showcases natural pomelo and juicy passionfruit floating over a cloud of warming, delicate apple blossom. Creamy vanilla, sandalwood and nutty tonka bean are balanced with bursts of crisp green matcha tea. Adorned with Van Gogh’s Almond Blossom of large blossom branches against a blue sky, the bottle unites the worlds of fine fragrance and fine art.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Parfum for Men 100ml
listings.description: Connecting courage and contemporary values, the Burberry Hero Parfum for Men embodies the modern man, strong yet sincere, through the means of an intense woody scent. Encouraging you to embrace your individuality and unlock its superpowers, the fragrance is led by a blend of cypriol oil and Amyris to make an intense olfactive statement, before warming on a base of cedarwood nuances. Smoky, balsamic and slightly sweet, the medley of notes mingle to imbue a rich, complex charm with an inspiring allure. Housed in a refillable quadratic glass flacon detailed with the Burberry logo.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie est Belle L'Elixir Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Follow your inner desires with the Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Elixir, a feminine fragrance that inspires confidence and true self-love. The gourmand-floral fusion honours the longest commitment you will ever make: the one to yourself. Taking you on a journey of self-discovery, ripening raspberry opens the scent to refresh the palette of all other aromas. At its heart, blooming violet emboldens the senses to defy expectations and spark courage. A creamy, yet irresistible, addition of cocoa butter adds a touch of comfort and reassurance to be confident in your true self. More than just a perfume bottle, the flacon makes a crystalised statement with its sleek silhouette and darkened accents. Reimagined by famed glass designer Suzanne Dalton, the bottle reinvents La Vie Est Belle's iconic curvature smile with the addition of unique engravings that can be felt under the fingers of the person holding it.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Cuir Élysées Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: It doesn’t get more decadent than Balmain’s CUIR ÉLYSÉES Eau de Parfum, presented in a rosy, gold-toned bottle made for any vanity. The blend opens with a supple leather impression, lifted by wild raspberry and the soft warmth of spicy baie rose. These notes unfold into a luminous, fruity-floral heart of petalia and green jasmine, creating a vivid, textured bouquet. As it settles, the fragrance melts into a creamy trail of sandalwood, imparting a smooth, lasting scent on the skin. The bottle itself dazzles in a rosy metallic shade, complete with gold-toned accents for a truly elevated touch.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Ego Stratis Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: A modern-day interpretation of feminine fragrance, the Ego Stratis Eau de Parfum by Juliette Has a Gun is underpinned by typically masculine facets to unearth a fresh, citrus musk masterpiece. This olfactive invitation welcomes you to embrace your inner alter-ego, represented by its confident blend of lemon, bergamot and neroli nuances that demand the sensory attention. Blueberry interlaces with the aquatic character of calone to grant a cool marine freshness, before notes of ambroxan, cedar and musk embolden the unisex scent with a spiced warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Absolu de Parfum Pour Femme 60ml
listings.description: Envelop yourself in the Gucci Guilty Absolu de Parfum Pour Femme, an intense floral-ambery fragrance with an irresistible breakdown of notes. The for-her fragrance is layered with moreish elements like almond, rose and tonka bean, suffusing it with a creamy botanical charge. Coffee amaretto introduces a toasted, nutty edge with a hint of liqueur-like smoothness, creating a warm base that’s both opulent and addictive. Perfect for evening wear, this fragrance leaves behind a silken, smouldering trail that naturally invites compliments.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Original Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Channelling an air of elegance and power, the Lacoste Original Eau de Parfum reinvents the meaning of modern masculinity. The scent is powered by an enigmatic fusion of dazzling spices and enlivening fougère accords. Bursting with freshness, zesty bergamot opens the scent with an energising kick, spiked with the fire of pink pepper and cardamom. Its aromatic core reveals a tone of sophistication with an earthy duo of French raw materials, lavender and clary sage. The intensity of patchouli and the sensuality of sandalwood combine at the base to create a finish that stands out.

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 106 Damascena Rose, Davana, Vanilla Eau de Parfum 15ml
listings.description: Delve into a floral realm with the Bon Parfumeur 106 Damascena Rose, Davana, Vanilla Eau de Parfum, a luxurious fragrance infused with the essence of the most opulent petals. Sophisticated but sensual, Damascena rose powers the fragrance with vibrant pink pepper and a hint of ambrette seed. At its heart, davana and papyrus evoke an evergreen imitation of nature while rose essential interrupts with a soft, velvety sweetness. Vanilla and sandalwood add a smooth richness to the scent, exuding opulence and elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Idôle Power L'Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The first woody floral fragrance in Lancôme’s beloved Idôle collection, Power L’Eau de Parfum 100ml is an empowering scent that inspires you to be your most true and authentic self. The fragrance is perfectly balanced with scent dualities that reflect the multi-faceted character of its wearer. A molecular Pomarose accord introduces the perfume, its juicy floral nuances heightened with a sensuous rose bouquet at the heart. As the fragrance wears on the skin, a creamy sandalwood accord begins to unfurl, closing the sillage with warmth and richness. The Idôle perfume bottle takes on a new form. Its iconic, ultra-thin silhouette is reimagined with an ombré pink colourway, complete with a metallic topper.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances relaunches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Toilette for Women presents an ambery floral scent, that inspires a fresh take on blending sensuality with living authentically. The Eau de Toilette is defined by the light, fresh femininity of lilac petals, immersed with a sparkling citrus twist on a trail of rich and sensual amber notes and Patchouli. Opening in the mood of this Gucci scent’s signature, the luminous citrus top notes of Mandarin are blended with Pink Pepper for a bright and vibrant freshness. At the heart of this citrus perfume, the lilac floral quality combines with the fruity blend of Peach and Raspberry and with notes of Egyptian Geranium to create a delicate and harmonious contrast. Finally, Patchouli and amber notes reveal the warmth and creaminess of the dry down, echoing the base notes of the women's Eau de Toilette to bring strength and sensuality to the juice. This perfume for women is presented in a shade of metallic rose gold. The bottle is partly wrapped in the coloured metal with a matching cap, that features the brand's iconic interlocking Gs, mirroring the fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela REPLICA Celestial Whispers Eau de Parfum 100ml
Giorgio Armani My Way Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani’s My Way Le Parfum is a feminine fragrance that invites you to explore new horizons. Refreshing and romantic, the scent is characterized by a powdery bouquet at its heart, perfect for springtime wear. A radiant bergamot accord introduces the perfume, intertwining with bright, floral nuances of tuberose. The fragrance dries down onto a bed of cedarwood, adding an earthy twist to the scent for an intoxicating finish. Adventure into the unknown with My Way Le Parfum.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Fir Tree Mini Home Scenting Set
listings.description: The White Company Fir Tree Mini Home Scenting Set features a home fragrance trio with a woody, fresh aroma that captures the magic of Winter. Inspired by a faraway forest thick with snow-topped pine trees, the Fir Tree scent features crisp notes of fresh eucalyptus and pine needles, warmed by cedar and earthy moss. Perfect for gifting or treating yourself, the set is beautifully presented in a luxury gift box. Set Contents: Fir Tree Votive Candle 70g Fir Tree Mini Home Spray 15ml Fir Tree Mini Diffuser 50ml

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Tabac Sahara Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts in the moonlight. Discover Tabac Sahara, a captivating nocturnal journey to the heart of the desert. Mysterious and smoky wreaths of tobacco meet the sensual addiction of a raspberry accord, beautifully enhanced by the warmth of an ambergris accord. Through its tangy freshness, the red berry creates a vibrant contrast with tobacco’s golden nuances, suggesting the pink halo that surrounds the dunes at nightfall. "Tabac Sahara is the perfume of a desert of pink dunes by starlight. The encounter of tobacco’s golden nuances with a pink raspberry note.” - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfume Creation Director & Perfumer. A powerful symbol of Guerlain’s commitment to the planet, the Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain more than 90% natural-origin* ingredients. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Tabac Sahara comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle which is made in France and crafted from 15% recycled glass. It takes on an enigmatic purple shade, reminiscent of the dunes by starlight. Its unscrewable spray and transparent lacquer allow it to be recycled more easily. *in accordance with ISO 16128, calculation includes water.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom For Her Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Blended by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, the addictive deep floral perfume smells divine, weaving the charming signature of Jasmine and Tuberose into an embodied essence. The Eau de Parfum Intense naturally expands into its full vital and mesmerising expression, blooming like the individual who wears it. Its inspired fragrance intensifies the Gucci Bloom white floral blend with added sensuality, a go-to perfume for any occasion. A radiant top note of Orange Blossom Absolute opens the incantation while its floral heart of Jasmine and Tuberose unfurls with Lady of the Night – a night-blooming flower that heightens the heady bouquet. Grounded in a base of Patchouli Essence and Crystal Moss Accord, the essence of this Gucci scent invokes deep perception and echoes with a sensuous fragrance. The distinctive square bottle that holds this tempting Eau de Parfum for women is embellished with a red Toile de Jouy Herbarium Gucci print, radiating creative power and bold luminosity.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Eau De Parfum
listings.description: The Molton Brown Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Eau de Parfum transports the senses to an uncharted peninsula with an aroma reminiscent of rolling waves and sea spray. The zest of bergamot and heat of ginger is infused with cardamom and the crisp marine notes at the heart of this invigorating fragrance. Sweet jasmine, aromatic frankincense and the bracing aroma of cypress embody the flourishing wilderness of sea cliffs. A tempting blend of leather, vetiver and musk offer harmonious, smoky undertones, completing this refreshingly thrilling fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Rose Dunes Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Capturing an eternal desert heat, the Molton Brown Rose Dunes Eau de Parfum embodies the mysterious beauty of silent dusk settling over the sand. Opening with golden, warm notes of saffron and cassis, the fragrance transcends the senses to exotic, unexplored terrains and the shimmering sunset over towering dunes. Luxuriously sweet notes of rose and geranium ebb and flow throughout the fragrance, intertwining with earthy patchouli to bring an unexpected note of luxury to the EDP. Exuding a spellbinding fragrance, the perfume inspires a sense of wanderlust, and a desire to explore the wild beauty of the desert night.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Dark Amber & Ginger Lily Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: Warm and magnetic, the Jo Malone London Dark Amber and Ginger Lily Cologne Intense fuses sensual floral notes with fresh, distinctive nuances for a well-rounded olfactory adventure. Black cardamom opens the cologne with an aromatic crispness, paired with ginger to create an unforgettable allure. A heart of black orchid, water lily and jasmine bloom in a floral bouquet, emboldened by the contrast of smoky kyara incense and earthy amber. Spritz onto the pulse points for a long-lasting, addictive scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Men's Cologne Collection 5x9ml
listings.description: Starring five signature scents, the Jo Malone London Cologne Intense Collection sweeps up the senses on a path to self-discovery. The fragrance collection appeals to a range of occasions, tastes and moods, equipping the wearer with an artillery of impressive signature fragrances. Set Contents: Wood Sage and Sea Salt Cologne 9ml Capturing oceanic freshness every day, the sophisticated fragrance blends ambrette seeds, sea salt and sage to create an uplifting atmosphere. The award-winning cologne captures the scene of waves crashing against powerful cliffs and the smell of salt on the horizon. Lime Basil and Mandarin Cologne 9ml A modern classic in the world of luxury fragrance, the zesty cologne blends mandarin, basil and amberwood to form a bright, sparkling perfume. Herbaceous basil intertwines with zesty mandarin to create an unexpected allure and a delightful scent that transports the senses to distant citrus groves. Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense 9ml Hand-harvested with the finest ingredients, the perfume is infused with lavender, omumbri myrrh and tonka bean to create a rich and exotic perfume. The luxury cologne adds a velvety depth that sweeps up the senses in a warm embrace. Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense 9ml Romantic and archaic, the aromatic perfume is infused with cypress, grapevine and moss to accompany the senses to a world of sensuality and unrivalled magnificence. The bold fragrance empowers the wearer to discover new depths. Silver Birch & Lavender Cologne 9ml Cooling and crisp, the fresh fragrance embodies the scent of pre-dawn dew. Infused with English lavender, grapefruit and silver birch, the luminous fragrance is distinctively charismatic, creating an uplifting atmosphere that captures the stillness before the world awakens.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Ylang Ylang Espresso Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Tangerine, Sichuan pepper. Heart Notes: Fresh Rose, Jasmine, Tiramisu Accord, Patchouli. Base Notes: Ylang Ylang, Espresso Beans, Cocoa Beans, Guaiacwood. A spirited gourmand scent inspired by leaders and thinkers. Harvested from the foothills of the Himalayas, Sichuan pepper electrifies the creamy accords or tiramisu and patchouli. The warm steam from freshly brewed coffee drifts into a soothing aroma of ylang-ylang, creating a rich aromatic experience.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Boisee 60ml
listings.description: An unexpected contrast between noble strength and smouldering seduction, Givenchy’s Gentleman Eau de Parfum Boisée embodies masculine magnificence in all its glory. Translating to wooded, Boisée begins with a spiced scent as black pepper and coriander open the trail with captivating intensity. Rich cacao pod warms the heart, while iris emerges from the signature burning wood base of patchouli and sandalwood. Housed in a black ombre-effect bottle, the eau de parfum exudes timeless sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine For Her Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Enter a new dimension of unbound freedom with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau de Parfum for women. Bursting with sensual Grandiflorum Jasmine, this is the second Gucci fragrance to join the cheery world of #FloraFantasy. Its energy of inner joy is further enhanced by the elongated turquoise bottle, while the House’s distinctive Flora by Gucci pattern seals the design with a magical touch. Once again fronted by multi-platinum selling recording artist, songwriter and trailblazer Miley Cyrus, the latest #FloraFantasy campaign continues into a luminous bedroom, while scenes tinted in pastel hues create the film’s surreal spirit and draw the viewer into an anime dream.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Mitsouko Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Mitsouko is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Jacques Guerlain named his creation “Mitsouko” after the name of the heroine in the bestselling novel of that time called La Bataille. Mitsouko, a beautiful married Japanese woman, secretly loves a British officer. In 1905, the Russo-Japanese war breaks out. Mitsouko awaits with dignity the outcome of the battle, nobly dominating her feelings. Jacques Guerlain had the incredible and daring idea of combining a chypre with a very fruity peach note, giving this fragrance all of its modernity. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Pacific Rock Flower Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dive into crystalline waters with Goldfield & Banks’ Pacific Rock Moss Perfume Concentrate, an aquatic scent inspired by the freshness of waves meeting the sun-kissed earth. Perfumed by François Merle-Baudoin and Carine Certain Boin, the unisex fragrance features an enlivening citrus aroma, powered by Italian lemon and zesty geranium. Australian coastal moss adds a botanical greenness, reminiscent of invigorating sea spray and summer gardens at the same time. Cedar and sage round the olfactive trail off with an earthy depth, joining land and water in an aromatic union.

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Pacific Rock Flower Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Dive into crystalline waters with Goldfield & Banks’ Pacific Rock Moss Perfume Concentrate, an aquatic scent inspired by the freshness of waves meeting the sun-kissed earth. Perfumed by François Merle-Baudoin and Carine Certain Boin, the unisex fragrance features an enlivening citrus aroma, powered by Italian lemon and zesty geranium. Australian coastal moss adds a botanical greenness, reminiscent of invigorating sea spray and summer gardens at the same time. Cedar and sage round the olfactive trail off with an earthy depth, joining land and water in an aromatic union.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Velvet Rose & Oud Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: An alluring scent that celebrates the beauty of the damask rose. Jo Malone London’s Velvet Rose and Oud Cologne Intense exudes decadence, enveloping the skin in a floral aroma laced with praline nuances and a resinous wood. The scent opens with a sharp clove accord, diffusing into a heart of rose. Picked and distilled at dawn for optimum fragrance, the damask rose features spicy, honey facets, offering a sensuous olfactory experience. A base of oud offers a rich contrast, lending new intensity to the aroma that intrigues the senses.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom For Her Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Bloom into your true self with the irresistible Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette. Inspiring a journey of self-discovery built on the empowering notion of connecting through difference, the floral fragrance stays true to the original Bloom signature. This addition to the Bloom floral bouquet is a lighter, more luminous interpretation of the Bloom signature scent that gently encourages women to Bloom into the truest version of themselves. Characterised by a mesmerising trio of Jasmine, Tuberose and Rangoon Creeper accord, it is now enlightened by a sweetened Neroli accord. Just like the perfume unfurls as its name suggests, Gucci Bloom women flourish in a natural, expressive and individual way, without conventional limitations. This tempting Gucci scent is presented in a frosted and luminous square-shaped pink glass bottle to bring freshness and vitality. Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette for women celebrates the vitality and diversity of those who identify with the House’s modern philosophy.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine For Her Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Enter a new dimension of unbound freedom with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau de Parfum for women. Bursting with sensual Grandiflorum Jasmine, this is the second Gucci fragrance to join the cheery world of #FloraFantasy. Its energy of inner joy is further enhanced by the elongated turquoise bottle, while the House’s distinctive Flora by Gucci pattern seals the design with a magical touch. Once again fronted by multi-platinum selling recording artist, songwriter and trailblazer Miley Cyrus, the latest #FloraFantasy campaign continues into a luminous bedroom, while scenes tinted in pastel hues create the film’s surreal spirit and draw the viewer into an anime dream.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Nude Velvet Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: A sublime floral scent that radiates self-confidence, Givenchy’s Irresistible Eau de Parfum Nude Velvet portrays an enhanced version of the fragrance’s emblematic rose-wood signature, faceted with a compelling musk finish. Blended between the fresh neroli and crisp florals, a gourmand almond milk note envelops the skin upon first spritz. A textured trail of cedarwood and musk cocoons the floral bouquet of rose and iris in a warm embrace, striking the perfect balance between sweet and sensual. Housed in a new couture flacon, the perfume is dressed in nude pink lacquer for a luxury finish.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Givenchy overhauls your aroma with L'Interdit Parfum, a rich and multifaceted olfactory treat for the senses. Layered with an inimitable blend of notes, the perfume opens intriguingly with sharp-sweet almond essence. Just beneath, several traces marry at the heart: think floral, fresh orange blossom, intoxicating tuberose, and heady jasmine. The core is a deep, warm blend with impressive longevity, suffused with vetiver, patchouli, vanilla-like benzoin, and more. Multi-dimensional and sophisticated, Givenchy's signature scent takes cues from French fragrance profiles.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum Refill 150ml (Worth £216)
listings.description: A radicalisation of the original scent, Yves Saint Laurent's MYSLF Le Parfum offers a more intense and sensual olfactive experience. The refillable fragrance layers lavish orange blossom with textured woods, embodying an expression of modern masculinity and the statement of embracing all your facets and emotions. The floral-wood fusion opens with a fresh burst of bergamot, warmed by a medley of spices including black pepper, cardamom and cinnamon. Beating at the heart, orange blossom absolute creates a rich, honeyed facet that dries down to reveal woods and a silky vanilla bourbon infusion. Sleek, timeless and expertly crafted, the perfume bottle is adorned with matte black lacquering and the iconic YSL Cassandre logo sculpted into the glass.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Cristal Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: A tribute to radiant femininity, the Narciso Cristal Eau de Parfum is a fresh, luminous fragrance reminiscent of a crystal’s incandescence. The scent marries delicate florals with sensuous woods, reflecting the inner light of the Narciso woman. Sparkling bergamot awakens the fragrance, intertwining with a luscious bouquet of rose and white floral accords. The scent diffuses into a heart of musc, lending an earthy, intoxicating aroma. Wrapped in a creamy elixir of cedarwood and cashmeran, the scent settles on the skin with a serene finish. Arriving in its purest form, the transparent glass bottle is tinted in a delicate pink hue, revealing the vivid scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Salted Muse Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Where the sea meets the skin, Orebella’s Salted Muse Eau De Parfum is a clean yet sensual fragrance that channels the raw energy of ocean tides and forest air. It’s a scent that awakens the senses, bestowing freshness in full force while grounding you in earthy fashion. This EDP is layered with a dynamic interplay of marine and woodland notes, creating a vivacious, elemental character. At the top, sea salt and pink pepper collide – mineral-rich and spicy, like a piquant coastal breeze. The heart reveals an olive tree accord, adding a Mediterranean depth that feels irresistibly sun-kissed. Anchoring the fragrance is a cedar and sandalwood core, softened by a veil of amber that lends warmth and modernity. The result is a pyramid that feels both wild and refined, with essential oils adding a nourishing skin touch.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Sweet Almond Blossom Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: In collaboration with Van Gogh Museum®, Floral Street’s Sweet Almond Blossom Eau de Parfum offers a fragrance for the enchanting and ethereal. The fruity, floral, gourmand perfume showcases natural pomelo and juicy passionfruit floating over a cloud of warming, delicate apple blossom. Creamy vanilla, sandalwood and nutty tonka bean are balanced with bursts of crisp green matcha tea. Adorned with Van Gogh’s Almond Blossom of large blossom branches against a blue sky, the bottle unites the worlds of fine fragrance and fine art.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Ode To Dullness Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Celebrating the comfort of monotony, an Ode to Dullness Eau de Parfum by Juliette Has a Gun puts a light, inviting spin on an often pejorative narrative. Composed to convey a gentle, poetic scent story, the fragrance unites star anise and freesia in an unexpected blend, wrapping the wearer in a floral halo spiked with spicy facets. Creamy sandalwood, tonka bean and musks grant a calming, centering effect, reminding you to enjoy the small moments in life like soft cashmere on the skin or the warmth of a blanket on a rainy day. Housed in a minimalistic ombre flacon, wear an Ode to Dullness to indulge in olfactive serenity and reflection.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The essence of a summer escape, perfectly encapsulated in a fragrance. The Juliette Has A Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum is a sensual and powerful scent, transporting the senses to paradise with its intoxicating aroma. The salty undertones of the perfume can be attributed to fleur de sel, a natural ingredient found in the coastal regions of France. Paired with vanilla, alongside warm sandalwood, tonka bean and musk, the fragrance’s juxtaposition of warmth and freshness creates a captivating scent trail that lingers on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Black Lotus Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody. Top Notes: Black Cherry, Red Peppercorn, Saffron. Heart Notes: Centifolia Rose, Black Violet Accord, Narcotic Musk Flower. Base Notes: Patchouli Fraction, Labdanum, Black Leather. A rebellious scent to inspire your wild side, FloralStreet’s Black Lotus Eau de Parfum intoxicates the senses with woody notes. This unforgettable fragrance redefines the classic notion of a floral fragrance, the classic English-Rose dressed in a black leather jacket. The honeyed sweetness of centifolia rose is offset by spiced nuances of red peppercorn and saffron, creating a complex, multifaceted scent. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Poudrée Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Capture the allure of attraction with the Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Poudrée Eau de Parfum. The blush pink bottle reflects the sensuality of skin, mirroring the fragrance’s seductive rendezvous between velvety jasmine, warming wood and powdery musc. Tender top notes of jasmine and Bulgarian rose are scattered like fallen petals over a mysterious base of white and black cedars and vetiver. Unified by a powdery musk heart, this alluring EDP encapsulates the intimate appeal of bare skin, in an elegant feminine fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez All of Me Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Inspiring individuality and self-expression, the Narciso Rodriguez All of Me Eau de Parfum is a bold, prismatic floral fragrance created for a new generation of women who are confident to embrace their uniqueness and let their true colours shine. The multi-faceted perfume reinvents the floral olfactory by fusing precious rose centifolia with bold geranium bourbon, a note traditionally present in men’s fragrances. Revisiting the Narciso Rodriguez signature, a delicate accord of musc and sandalwood envelop the scent. Six musc notes combine to create an alluring quality, each one adding dimension to the floral blend. Vegan and 88% natural origin ingredients.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Ex Vetiver 100ml
listings.description: Fusing citrus freshness with the richness of woods, Ex Vetiver by Juliette Has a Gun spotlights olfactive duality, showcasing its capability to achieve a delicate yet impactful finish. To open, hesperidic notes of bergamot and lemon lend gentle, versatile vibrancy, that uplifts the senses and complements the green nuances of a three-piece vetiver medley. Edging towards a slightly smoky base, the cologne evolves with wear to unearth second skin-like musks and ambery ambroxan to grant a long-lasting, compelling scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Capturing the aquatic intensity of the ocean, the Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Parfum channels nature’s most powerful entity to portray its marine-woody scent. Weaved with Sichuan pepper and fir balsam, the fragrance showcases the shimmering nuances of the sea, carrying crisp, slightly citrusy aromas on its olfactive wave. Cedarwood grants a magnetic depth, rounding the eau de parfum with a warm, woody closure that lingers on the skin with a slightly balsamic allure. Housed in a refillable crystal-clear flacon, topped with a wooden cap, the bottle reflects the contrast between earth and sea.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Her! Eau de Parfum Refill 150ml
listings.description: Elegance and edge distilled, Zadig & Voltaire's This Is Her! Eau de Parfum brings a certain  je ne sais quoi  to your fragrance collection. The profile opens up with a familiar layer of jasmine, adding a petal-rich brightness to your entrance. Journeying into vanilla and roasted chestnut, the bouquet becomes intriguingly complex as it settles on the skin. A recurring theme in the brand's scent portfolio, sandalwood lingers at the very base, imparting an effortlessly chic and milky Parisian flourish. "I like when it leaves a trail, asserts a personality," says founder and art collector Thierry Gillier – a sentiment that echoes through the fragrance’s refined pyramid.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Forever Wanted Absolu 50ml
listings.description: The ultimate expression of intensity, Azzaro's Forever Wanted Absolu captivates with a blend of addictive amber and woody notes. The fragrance embodies the Azzaro Wanted man who seizes every moment with confidence and charisma, through a smoky allure of incense, a boozy whisky accord and rich vanilla. Offering up to 24 hours of intensity, it commands attention with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Green Stravaganza Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the culture of Italy’s capital city with the Born In Roma Donna Green by Valentino. Inspired by the extravagance and beauty of the eternal city, the fragrance unleashes luscious floral notes to transport your mind to the gardens of Rome. The scent opens with a smoky aroma of lapsang souchong tea accord, mingling with jasmine absolute to create heat and passion reminiscent of the Roman sun. A base of lavish vanilla takes over to add a luxurious but enchanting finish to the scent. Reinventing the iconic pyramidal structure, the bottle captures the spirit of Valentino with its distinctive studded design and leather accents as a symbol of fearlessness.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire ZADIG Eau de Parfum Intense 90ml
listings.description: The Zadig & Voltaire ZADIG Eau de Parfum Intense 90ml brings a richer, warmer twist to the original, with a glowing trail that lingers from day to night. A blend of black and golden sesame opens the scent with a soft spice, lifted by ginger and incense. Orange blossom and a creamy vinyl accord sit at the heart, before settling into vanilla, sandalwood and guaiac wood for a smooth, long-lasting finish. Housed in a gold-toned, refillable wing-shaped bottle, the scent is expressive and easy to wear.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Window2Soul Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Step into a luminous garden with the Orebella Window2Soul Eau De Parfum, a floral fragrance where a delicate bouquet of faceted rose and jasmine unfurls on the skin, kissed with fresh lemon for a natural, green brightness. Beneath the airy florals, warm tonka bean lingers softly, adding depth and a subtle sweetness. Light, elegant, and effortlessly radiant, this fragrance evokes sunlit mornings and gentle breezes.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun MMMM... Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Putting a contemporary spin on Shakespeare’s heroine, Juliette Has a Gun presents feminine fragrances designed for the modern-day woman. Behind MMMM… Eau de Parfum lies a world of hidden pleasure that goes beyond the sound. The gourmand fragrance showcases an olfactive sweetness to provoke immediate bliss. Mouth-watering top notes of raspberry, geranium and neroli are sprinkled over a floral bouquet of orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose. Comforting like an indulgent treat, sandalwood and patchouli mingle with accents of vanilla and caramel to create a sweet, rich scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Chypre Sublime Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Incense, Pink Pepper. Heart Notes: Wild Geranium, Damask Rose Absolute, Midnight Violet. Base Notes: Patchouli, Labdanum, Benzoin, Olibanum. A muse to your inner creativity, the FloralStreet Chypre Sublime Eau de Parfum captivates the senses with an exotic and mesmerising fragrance. Wrapped in a vibrant floral design, the perfume bottle itself is a work of art. This modern and glamorous Chypre opens with notes of smoky incense and sharp pink pepper, shrouding a rich, intense bouquet of florals. Feel inspired by a blend of purified damask rose absolute, violets and geranium, soaring into spirit-awakening olibanum for a captivating finale. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Black Lotus Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody, Oriental. Top Notes: Black Cherry, Red Peppercorn, Saffron. Heart Notes: Centifolia Rose, Black Violet Accord, Narcotic Musk Flower. Base Notes: Patchouli Fraction, Labdanum, Black Leather. A rebellious scent to inspire your wild side, FloralStreet’s Black Lotus Eau de Parfum intoxicates the senses with oriental, woody notes. This unforgettable fragrance redefines the classic notion of a floral fragrance, the classic English-Rose dressed in a black leather jacket. The honeyed sweetness of centifolia rose is offset by spiced nuances of red peppercorn and saffron, creating a complex, multifaceted scent. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Rose Chocolat Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A delicious recipe made up of cocoa, floral and woody accords, Le Monde Gourmand’s Rose Chocolat Eau de Parfum serves up a mouth-watering fragrance that’s almost good enough to eat. The scent offers a flirty interpretation of a classic chocolate perfume. Cocoa blossom meets pink musk in a sweet juxtaposition that exudes femininity, underpinned by warm, creamy sandalwood for a delectable finish.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: From the very first spritz, the Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush Eau de Parfum envelops the senses with an invigorating warmth. Ripe banana and irresistibly sweet maple syrup create a captivating opening, inspiring confidence before melting into sun-kissed notes of creamy coconut and exotic frangipani, reminiscent of basking at the ocean’s edge. Smooth and addictive, the fragrance settles into a lingering trail of soft vanilla and velvety sandalwood for an indulgent, escapist finish.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Toilette 150ml Refill (Worth £142.50)
listings.description: Discover Prada’s Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Toilette Refill, a scent for the modern adventurer. The powerful fougere fragrance embraces the calling of discovery, offering a fusion of naturally-inspired fresh and aquatic accords. The energetic eau de toilette for men features an invigorating bergamot opening, contrasted with the masculine elegance of vetiver and iris. Creamy tonka bean offers an additive smoothness, creating a unique everyday scent.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Essence Parfum Refill 100ml (Worth £196.67)
listings.description: Reimagining gourmand as you know it, the Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum Refill explores the boundaries between sweet and salty in this sophisticated display of floral amber nuances. Opening with a bouquet of neroli and orange flower, the scent transcends the floral realm with its zesty aura. At its heart, salted pistachio adds an unexpected twist with an addictive roasted note. Sophisticated sandalwood grounds the scent at the base to leave a modern, sensual trail.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel D'Issey Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Taking you an olfactive expedition from the sea to the land, Issey Miyake’s Le Sel D’Issey plays on two scent polarities in this thrilling woody marine fragrance. The Eau de Toilette brings to life a salt accord with nuances of ginger and seaweed, evoking images of an azure ocean rippling with powerful currents. Married with sand vetiver, the aquatic character of the scent takes on a new form with intense earthy accords, pairing cedarwood with oakmoss to create a dynamic sillage. Made with 95% natural origin ingredients and 100% natural origin French alcohol, the Le Sel D’Issey Eau de Toilette arrives in a luminous flacon that represents the energy-filled fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Lust for Sun Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Chase the scent of the tropics with the Juliette Has a Gun Lust for Sun Eau de Parfum, a solar floral fragrance brimming with vibrant accords and splashes of sun-drenched nuances. Immersing the senses into summertime, notes of care-free freesia, creamy coconut and bright bergamot open the olfactive trail with a sparkling floralcy, enhanced by ylang-ylang, monoi and gardenia for an uplifting effect. Adding a sensual edge, vanilla, ambroxan and musks warm the fresh scent with an addictive richness, conjuring the image of sun-kissed sands being met by the sea’s soft lullaby.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club New York Parfum 110ml
listings.description: Inspired by the magnetic energy of Manhattan’s nightlife, Ralph's Club New York Parfum by Ralph Lauren is a resinous, spicy scent with rich undertones. Addictive from the first spritz, the cologne opens with ripened blackcurrant, before revealing a smooth oud wood accord. In the base, aged cognac gives the blend its distinctive character, heady yet comforting as it lingers with long-lasting intensity on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: The essence of a summer escape, perfectly encapsulated in a fragrance. The Juliette Has A Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum is a sensual and powerful scent, transporting the senses to paradise with its intoxicating aroma. The salty undertones of the perfume can be attributed to fleur de sel, a natural ingredient found in the coastal regions of France. Paired with vanilla, alongside warm sandalwood, tonka bean and musk, the fragrance’s juxtaposition of warmth and freshness creates a captivating scent trail that lingers on the skin.
