Immersing the senses into summertime, notes of care-free freesia, creamy coconut and bright bergamot open the olfactive trail with a sparkling floralcy, enhanced by ylang-ylang, monoi and gardenia for an uplifting effect. Adding a sensual edge, vanilla, ambroxan and musks warm the fresh scent with an addictive richness, conjuring the image of sun-kissed sands being met by the sea’s soft lullaby.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo 67 Extreme Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Ralph Lauren's Polo 67 Extreme Eau de Parfum opens with a soft, clean veil of musk, creating a warm and understated introduction. As the fragrance unfolds, a vibrant burst of sweet‑tart pineapple rises at the heart, adding an energising freshness and a bright, modern lift. In the dry-down, the scent deepens into a rich, smoky leather base. Housed in a sleek metallic bottle with a deep blue cap, the design reflects the fragrance’s polished and contemporary character.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: Dreamt up in collaboration with renowned perfumer Sonia Constant, For Her Eau de Parfum Intense offers a new twist on Narciso Rodriguez’s quintessential heart of musc accord, layering fresh fruits and florals with addictive vanilla for a sensuous olfactory experience. The vegan fragrance starts with a juicy trail, invigorating the senses with a bite of peach and bergamot. Solar white flowers amplify the scent’s musk signature, before giving way to woody, earthy nuances of vetiver. The iconic For Her perfume bottle is reimagined to reflect the intensity of the perfume within. Wrapped in a deep shade of pink, the flacon encapsulates the fragrance’s bold character.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only Desire Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Celebrating self-expression and authenticity, the Only Desire Eau De Parfum by Diesel transforms a traditional vanilla note into a symbol of contemporary fierceness. The brand’s first metallic vanilla is created with luminous aldehydes, acting as an airy nuance that lifts the amber-gourmand facets. Striking yet sumptuous, the blend settles into a creamy heart of orchid, before bourbon vanilla lends lasting intensity and warmth on the skin. Simply spritz onto the pulse points to indulge in the multi-dimensional scent as desired.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Lust for Sun Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Chase the scent of the tropics with the Juliette Has a Gun Lust for Sun Eau de Parfum, a solar floral fragrance brimming with vibrant accords and splashes of sun-drenched nuances. Immersing the senses into summertime, notes of care-free freesia, creamy coconut and bright bergamot open the olfactive trail with a sparkling floralcy, enhanced by ylang-ylang, monoi and gardenia for an uplifting effect. Adding a sensual edge, vanilla, ambroxan and musks warm the fresh scent with an addictive richness, conjuring the image of sun-kissed sands being met by the sea’s soft lullaby.

listings.rawTitle: BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum for Him 150ml
listings.description: Memorably bold and long-lasting, amplify your presence with BOSS' Beyond Eau de Parfum for Him. Fronted by global ambassador Bradley Cooper, this standout scent makes a confident entrance into your aftershave collection. The composition opens with a vibrant burst of ginger, delivering a zesty, peppery freshness that awakens the senses. As it settles, smooth leather emerges, adding a smoky, resinous depth that’s equal parts refined and magnetic. Lending itself to evenings that demand impact, the Beyond EDP is for leaving your mark in olfactory form.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aromatic Essence for Men 100ml
listings.description: An ode to precious gems, the Men's Eternity Aromatic Essence by Calvin Klein is a fresh fougere fragrance that unites the sophisticated and the sensual. Aphrodisiacal, the addictive trail opens with juicy juniper berries, creamy coconut and zesty lemon nuances, an invigorating blend that captures the olfactive attention with the very first spritz. This gourmand aroma is grounded by a powerful base of spiced cardamom, cedar and patchouli, granting a sultry edge as the scent warms on the skin and lingers in the air around you. Housed in a teal-hued flacon to resemble a vibrant gemstone, place the cologne on your dresser as a reminder of your inner fearlessness and cool confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: From the best-selling fragrance collection, the White Tea Eau de Parfum by Elizabeth Arden epitomises free-spirited femininity in a fresh, floral orchestra of notes. Crafted with VivaScentz™ technology, the eau de parfum seeks to balance the white tea accords to encourage a sense of wellbeing, promoting an uplifting effect when worn. Opening with zesty mandarin, crisp sea breeze and clary sage nuances, the fragrance melts into a floral heart, emboldened by soft herbal hints of white tea. Tonka bean, musks, and amberwood lend their warmth and earthiness to underlie the scent and achieve a well-rounded closure to the olfactory trail.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Idôle Peach’N Roses 100ml
listings.description: Evolved from the 2019 Idôle, Lancôme’s Idôle Peach ’N Roses arrives with a brighter, more fruit-driven expression, reimagined for effortless daytime wear. Building on the house’s signature rose DNA, the fragrance introduces a softer, juicier dimension to your collection. A lively burst of red currant opens the composition, lending a crisp, lightly tart sparkle that sets a feel-good tone from the very first spritz. At the heart, succulent peach takes centre stage, wrapping the florals in a velvety sweetness that feels contemporary and inviting. Beneath it all, the iconic Idôle rose base anchors the scent, adding a smooth, petal-rich familiarity.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Ô Zenith Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Escape to sunnier climes with the Lancôme Ô Zenith Eau de Toilette, an optimistic fragrance that explores petals and fruits in full force. Brainchild of master perfumer Dominique Ropion, the scent pyramid is built around a luminous tropical accord of monoi – a coconut-tinged, softly vanilla floral that instantly evokes sun-warmed skin and island air. Delicate white petals bloom alongside juicy fruit notes, creating a harmonious juxtaposition of creamy sweetness and fresh vibrancy. To finish, the fragrance is encased in a rose-embossed glass bottle, in line with the rest of the Ô collection.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Nightcap Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: With a single spritz of Orebella Nightcap Eau de Parfum, you’re enveloped in a warm, molten mist of comfort.  Creamy top notes of vanilla open the scent, lending a sweet, subtle woodiness. At the heart, ginger unfurls with a lively complexity that feels zesty, earthy, and delicately sweet. This is anchored by a base of sandalwood, bringing a soft, floral warmth to the composition.  Striking the balance between depth and sweetness, Nightcap is the perfect fragrance to carry you from day into evening.

listings.rawTitle: MCM Onyx Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Allow MCM to take you on a transformative journey with the Onyx Eau de Parfum. Blurring the lines between real and virtual, the fragrance fuses vibrant aromatic notes with woody undertones to create a modern masculine scent. Hand-picked ginger and spices open with a burst of energy, before revealing a heart of lavender, basil and violet leaf. A dry down of sensual woody notes offers long-lasting minerality.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Ôff Now Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Elevate your perfume repertoire with the Lancôme Ôff Now Eau de Toilette, a citrus-forward fragrance boasting a sharp profile and high longevity. Inspired by the lush gardens and Provençal scenery of Grasse, the EDT weaves an olfactory tale of sunlit serenity and effortless escape. Opening with a zesty top note, conjuring the village's beloved citrus groves, the scent makes its mark as soon as you enter a room. Just below, a heart of verbena unfolds with a crisp freshness, nuanced with a hint of green spice. Sandalwood grounds the composition with a smooth, creamy warmth that lingers long after you apply. The bottle is engraved with the label's rose motif for a novel yet timeless Lancôme sign-off.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Original Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Find your new signature scent in Lacoste's Original Parfum, a fougère woody, spicy blend that reworks the original fragrance from '84 with a warmer, smoother profile. Bergamot, cardamom and ginger inject sharpness and spice in the top layer, setting a confident tone. Just beneath, lavender, incense and violet help to soften this initial hit, forming a slightly mysterious, powdery-floral core. Coming through after the dry-down, amber essence, patchouli and tonka bean swell with lingering warmth and sweetness. The overall sillage of the fragrance is noticeable without being overpowering, building on the label's sporty fresh DNA. Creative, refined and energising, reach for the EDP from day to night, season to season.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Refill 150ml
listings.description: A fusion of earthy accords and aromatic woods, Moncler’s Pour Homme Eau de Parfum captures the vivid natural beauty of an alpine forest. The masculine iteration of Moncler’s first-ever fragrance opens with an exclusive alpine green accord, elevated with fresh notes of clary sage to embody a leafy vastness of pine trees. Carried by warming cedarwood, an exclusive mountain woods accord creates an earthy dry-down, enhanced by the allure of vetiver. The fragrance is housed in a unique ‘borraccia’ flask-shaped bottle with a ribbed silver design, echoing Moncler’s mountaineering origins and the iconic quilted construction of a Moncler jacket. This refill bottle is designed to fit into your existing LED case.

listings.rawTitle: Olfactive O Skin Extrait de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Experiment with aromatic alchemy using Olfactive O's Skin Extrait de Parfum, where your scent becomes a fingerprint of your identity, weaving a tale of confidence and authenticity. Envision a sun-kissed beach, windswept hair and the breeze whispering over your body as you lay on the sand, while the fragrance embraces your skin like cool cotton sheets at day's end. As notes of magnolia flower and orris mingle, your skin chemistry becomes the canvas, crafting a scent that is unique to you. Apply it solo or layer with other scents for an amplified aura. A fragrance as dynamic and individual as you are.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Cleopatra Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Floral Top Notes: Bitter Grapefruit, Lush Greens, Cassis Bud. Heart Notes: White Jasmine, Peach Nectar, Tuberose. Base Notes: Warm Patchouli, Golden Amber, Rich Vanilla Musk. Inspired by the ancient, iconic seductress, Tocca 's Cleopatra embodies the beauty, passion and confidence of the modern woman. Enveloping you in a floral coat of freshly-picked blooms, the fragrance opens with a concoction of sparkling Grapefruit and Cassis bud, transitioning seamlessly into a hint of lush, verdant greens. Powdery hues of heady white florals creep in at the heart; a bouquet of White Jasmine, Peach Nectar and musky Tuberose that creates a slightly-honeyed, intoxicating layer, before delving into warmer depths. A dry-down that combines notes of Indian Patchouli, Amber and rich, creamy Vanilla creates a lasting, luxuriant sillage that seduces the senses. Boasting a long-wearing eau de parfum concentration, the opulent concoction is bottled in a spherical glass flacon that sits perfectly in your palm. Crowned with a vintage gold top and adorned with a logo plaque, Tocca lovingly presents the perfume in a sleek, collector’s box embellished with gold-foiled vines for a touch of glam.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Solar Elixir Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Reminiscent of sun-kissed skin and florals in full bloom, the Calvin Klein Euphoria Solar Elixir Parfum Intense reveals a bright aroma, perfect for summertime. Inspired by blooming vanilla in its rare green stage, the scent opens with a burst of juicy mango before revealing a heart of golden orchid that lends a soft, sensual twist. Creamy vanilla notes envelop the base in warmth, creating a sweet, indulgent finish. Crafted with a high concentration for added intensity, this feminine fragrance leaves a long-lasting olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Eau Bleue Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Spring may be its muse, but the Miu Miu L’Eau Bleue Eau de Parfum wears beautifully year-round, imparting fresh and floral notes wherever you go. Picture a sun-dappled morning in a Parisian garden. The fragrance opens with the crisp sparkle of lily of the valley, a bell flower essence that crops up consistently in the French label's flacons and perfumes. Violet leaf blooms at the heart, luminous and verdant, adding a cool, elegant lift. Anchored by a textured core of white musk, the drydown hums with a woody trail that lingers softly in the air. The bottle is a turquoise matelassé glass flacon adorned with a pastel yellow disc – an extra luxe flourish to the design.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aromatic Essence for Men 50ml
listings.description: An ode to precious gems, the Men's Eternity Aromatic Essence by Calvin Klein is a fresh fougere fragrance that unites the sophisticated and the sensual. Aphrodisiacal, the addictive trail opens with juicy juniper berries, creamy coconut and zesty lemon nuances, an invigorating blend that captures the olfactive attention with the very first spritz. This gourmand aroma is grounded by a powerful base of spiced cardamom, cedar and patchouli, granting a sultry edge as the scent warms on the skin and lingers in the air around you. Housed in a teal-hued flacon to resemble a vibrant gemstone, place the cologne on your dresser as a reminder of your inner fearlessness and cool confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Idôle Power L'Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The first woody floral fragrance in Lancôme’s beloved Idôle collection, Power L’Eau de Parfum 50ml is an empowering scent that inspires you to be your most true and authentic self. The fragrance is perfectly balanced with scent dualities that reflect the multi-faceted character of its wearer. A molecular Pomarose accord introduces the perfume, its juicy floral nuances heightened with a sensuous rose bouquet at the heart. As the fragrance wears on the skin, a creamy sandalwood accord begins to unfurl, closing the sillage with warmth and richness. The Idôle perfume bottle takes on a new form. Its iconic, ultra-thin silhouette is reimagined with an ombré pink colourway, complete with a metallic topper.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Mood Palette 8 x 2.5ml Discovery Set
listings.description: Your go‑to olfactory array, the Perroy Mood Palette 8 × 2.5ml Discovery Set brings together eight ultra-travel‑ready scents for effortless sampling, gifting or day‑to‑day spritzing. Set Contents: Perroy Azure Blush Eau de Parfum 15ml A candied bouquet that balances pink florals with a subtle warmth, evoking a tangy, fruity indulgence. Perroy Blonde Purple Eau de Parfum 15ml A fruity nectar that opens with juicy mango and softens with petals of ylang-ylang. Perroy Ivory Sky Eau de Parfum 15ml A subtly powdery fragrance laced with nuances of bright citrus and smooth woods. Perroy Mahogany Sun Eau de Parfum 15ml Warm and enveloping, the sun‑touched scent wraps rich woods in vanilla florals for a feel-good finish. Perroy Blue Forest Eau de Parfum 15ml Cool, green and quietly intense, the clean woody fragrance remixes cedar and black pepper with skin-like musks. Perroy Gold Fawn Eau de Parfum 15ml A trailblazing pyramid that features majestic amber, vanilla wood, spices and comforting sandalwood. Perroy Pink Fire Eau de Parfum 15ml Provocative to the core, the bouquet pairs raspberry with warm, woody amber and more. Perroy Tangerine Pearl Eau de Parfum 15ml A cocktail of grapefruit and ginger, with a smooth, grounding dry-down.

listings.rawTitle: Khloé Kardashian Almost Always Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Embrace each spritz of Khloé Kardashian's Almost Always Eau de Parfum, a floral amber woody fragrance inspired by moments that matter the most. The scent blooms with lavender and magnolia, revealing a heart of star jasmine and orange blossom petals. Like a warming embrace, the base of Palo Santo, sensual woods, musks and vanilla add a sensual, addictive edge.

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Eilish Eau de Parfum Refill 150ml
listings.description: From the musings of singer Billie Eilish comes her debut Eau De Parfum, an amber gourmand scent that feels like home. The warm and cosy composition delicately blends fruity nuances with woods and spices for an inviting olfactory experience. Opening with sweet sugared petals, the EDP uplifts the senses with red berries and a mandarin accord, wrapped in a delectable blend of cocoa and vanilla. A creamy dry down of musk and woods adds a sensual twist, finished with tonka bean. Veiled in a luxurious amber-bronze hue, the statement bottle highlights Eilish’s favourite parts of the body, including the chest, neck and collarbone.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Ètui Noir Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inhale the leathery intensity of the Miller Harris Etui Noir Eau de Parfum. Captivating and hypnotic, the perfume cloaks skin in sweet yet smoky notes of incense combined with a suede-like leather accord. A heart of iris and cashmere wood adds a soft contrast to this aromatic scent. Amber and vetiver lie at the depths of the fragrance creating a warm, earthy and comforting edge, reminiscent of an alluring dusk.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Eternal Roots Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Enter another world with the Orebella Eternal Roots Eau De Parfum, an empowering, juicy explosion of woody-floral notes. Starting with vibrational notes of bergamot, lychee and pink pepper, the fragrance has a sweet, sparkling citrus intro that surges with life. As the scent dries down, the heart swells with addicting nuances of raspberry blossom and pink sugar, texturised by suede that emphasises the wearer's complexity. Birch smoke bolsters the fragrance's depth in the base, softened by a floral facet of patchouli. Infused with essential oils and crafted in a bi-phase formula, this scent nourishes the skin while delivering long-lasting, immersive wear. Shake to activate the alchemy.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Stella Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Blood Orange, Watery Accord. Heart Notes: White Freesia, Wild Diamond Orchids, Spicy Lily. Base Notes: Sheer Musk, Sandalwood. Feel radiant and luminous every time you envelop yourself in the sumptuous aromas of Tocca Stella Eau de Parfum. The perfume instantly evokes images of lightness and spontaneity, as top notes of juicy Blood Orange and crisp, clean Watery Accord begin the sensual journey. Pleasantly contrasting, the boldness of the Blood Orange and the elegance of the Watery Accord are a constant reminder of the empowerment and vulnerability that make up the modern woman. Heart notes of smooth White Freesia, tantalising Wild Diamond Orchids and fiery Spicy Lily conjure free-spirited and fun-loving visions, as the playful clash of aromas linger in the air and on the skin. Flirtatious and whimsical, the heart notes blend into a deliciously intoxicating cocktail that encourage you to embrace your carefree, happy-go-lucky side more often. The fragrance reaches a dramatic crescendo with base notes of creamy, opulent Sheer Musk and rich, luxurious Sandalwood, drawing the exhilarating expedition through the various scents to a close. The uniquely-crafted blend works to inspire and invigorate, prompting you to seize each day with a hopeful and curious perspective on life. Encased in a striking round bottle that is topped with an engraved, bronze-toned lid, the perfume is destined to become an eye-catching element of any room.

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 102 Tea Cardamom Mimosa Eau de Parfum - 15ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Bergamot, Coriander, Cardamom. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Tea, Violet. Base Notes: Mimosa, Oak Moss, Musk. Embellish your skin with the fresh, crisp notes within Bon Parfumeur ‘102’ Tea Cardamom Mimosa Eau de Parfum. Opening with top notes of juicy Bergamot, herby Coriander and fiery Cardamom, the fragrance instantly unleashes a potent and unignorable cocktail that lingers in the air and on the skin. A smooth, sensual amalgamation leads you into the heart of the blend, with aromas of floral Jasmine, enticing Tea and delicate Violet. Clean and enlivening, the wearable, versatile fragrance is perfect for everyday use, allowing you to go effortlessly from daytime to night-time glamour. Smouldering base notes of Mimosa, Oak Moss and creamy Musk allow the fragrance to reach its crescendo in a sharp, stimulating manner. The perfume is encased in a sleek and minimalistic bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Original Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Channelling an air of elegance and power, the Lacoste Original Eau de Parfum reinvents the meaning of modern masculinity. The scent is powered by an enigmatic fusion of dazzling spices and enlivening fougère accords. Bursting with freshness, zesty bergamot opens the scent with an energising kick, spiked with the fire of pink pepper and cardamom. Its aromatic core reveals a tone of sophistication with an earthy duo of French raw materials, lavender and clary sage. The intensity of patchouli and the sensuality of sandalwood combine at the base to create a finish that stands out.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela REPLICA Ideal One Eau de Parfum 100ml
Calvin Klein Euphoria Magnetic Elixir Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: Spritz your pulse points with the warm, comforting allure of Calvin Klein’s Euphoria Magnetic Elixir, an irresistible Eau de Parfum infused with floral and earthy notes. Wrapped in softness and sweetness, it unveils creamy vanilla tones balanced by the clean warmth of musk, creating a cosy yet elevated scent that lingers close to the skin. Smooth and captivating, this fragrance transitions from day to evening, featuring a 28% ultra-concentrated formula for amplified intensity and long-lasting depth.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Nightcap Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: With a single spritz of Orebella Nightcap Eau de Parfum, you’re enveloped in a warm, molten mist of comfort.  Creamy top notes of vanilla open the scent, lending a sweet, subtle woodiness. At the heart, ginger unfurls with a lively complexity that feels zesty, earthy, and delicately sweet. This is anchored by a base of sandalwood, bringing a soft, floral warmth to the composition.  Striking the balance between depth and sweetness, Nightcap is the perfect fragrance to carry you from day into evening.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Her 100ml
listings.description: Experience the power of seduction with the BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Her. Hugo Boss captures the dichotomy of femininity with a floral-amber blend of fiery, yet anchoring notes that reveal an intoxicating trail. Sweet but energising, nuances of juicy peach open the scent, honeyed by a bouquet of osmanthus at the heart. White musk lingers at the base with a hint of sensuality and wanting that compels the sense to desire more. Housed in a refillable bottle, the flacon features the BOSS logo on translucent, golden glass and a BOSS Double-B monogram icy-gold cap.

listings.rawTitle: Eilish No. 2 by Billie Eilish Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Embark on Billie Eilish’s dark floral fantasy with her latest fragrance addition, Eilish No. 2 Eau De Parfum. Housed in her signature sculpted silhouette with a chromatic black finishing, the mesmeric scent is sure to take centre stage on any vanity. The captivating aroma opens with an exhilarating air of Italian bergamot and apple blossom, lacing between sultry spices and flowered facets of black pepper and wild wet poppy to charm the senses. Papyrus welcomes warmth and earthiness, pairing perfectly with the woodiness of palo santo and ebony, wrapped in a seductive skin musk essence for longevity and intensity.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Nerolia Vetiver Eau De Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step with the Nerolia Vetiver refill format. The floral radiance of Calabrian neroli, accentuated by vetiver and refreshed by basil, fused with a delicious fig accord. Create your own signature by pairing Nerolia Vetiver with: Bergamote Calabria, Orange Soleia, Mandarine Basilic or Pera Granita. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Bosca Vanilla Eau de Parfum 200ml Refill
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Bosca Vanilla Forte the Refill, the meeting between a driftwood accord with hints of the sea and the warmth of vanilla and everlasting flower with sunny, enveloping accents.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Rossa Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Rosa Rossa Forte, majestically blooming sweet roses bathed in light, paired with a juicy white peach over a deliciously woody base. « Rosa Rossa Forte is a sunset rose, an intense, fruity and velvety rose. » - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. The Aqua Allegoria fragrances are housed in a screw-top, refillable and recyclable bottle made in France from at least 15% recycled glass. The 200 mL refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75 mL and 125 mL bottles.
