listings.rawTitle: Floral Street London Poppy Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral. Top Notes: Orange, Lemon, Apricot Blossom. Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac, Neroli, Sunflower Accord, Marine Accord. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Hinoki Woods, Black Amber. Discover the warm, floral embrace of Floral Street’s London Poppy Eau de Parfum. A fresh citrus opening unfurls to a hypnotic bouquet of jasmine, neroli and sunflower accord, intertwined with deep, resinous woods. Formulated with a 20% concentration of aromatic oils, the fragrance provides a long-lasting perfume. Vegan. Made in the UK.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès H24 Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: The combination of an enveloping sage, an electrifying narcissus, an invigorating rosewood and a warm, metallic note of sclarene. A lively, sensual and bright perfume. H24 is the first perfume expressing the contemporary man as seen by Hermès. A lively, sensual and bright perfume, stemming from the daring blend between nature and technology. A 100% recycled and recyclable paper case decorated with a lime coloured net enclosing but opening up to space.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Héritage Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by yesterday's generations, Héritage is a fragrance dedicated to the men of tomorrow. It opens with aromatic freshness, succeeded by the subtlety of a warm spicy accord on a woody dry-down with shades of the Orient. Héritage, for a man who is at once a trustee for tradition and a herald of a new spirit.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette is a classic of elegance, glorified by the freshness of citrus notes. Created in 1965, Habit Rouge was the first ambery fragrance for men in perfumery. From the moment of its launch, this tribute to Guerlain's passion for the dressage of horses created an element of surprise with its scents of sensual and bold vanilla. With its modern geometry and mastery of form, Habit Rouge has an eternally elegant French appeal. Habit Rouge embraces a dandy man who dares everything, combining sophistication and refinement. He lives his life fervently and distinguishes himself with a trail of extreme sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: In La Petite Robe Noire’s perfume wardrobe, I am the Original Dress. A perfumed creation by Guerlain: An eau de parfum embroidered of the most beautiful "black" notes of perfumery. The legendary "heart-shaped" bottle has been boldly reinterpreted with a modern touch. Its crystalline transparency, fading from black to powdery pink, reveals an iconic little black dress. I am absolutely essential and utterly irresistible. I am the chic and very glamorous perfumed creation by Guerlain. I am La Petite Robe Noire.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Mitsouko Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Mitsouko is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Jacques Guerlain named his creation “Mitsouko” after the name of the heroine in the bestselling novel of that time called La Bataille. Mitsouko, a beautiful married Japanese woman, secretly loves a British officer. In 1905, the Russo-Japanese war breaks out. Mitsouko awaits with dignity the outcome of the battle, nobly dominating her feelings. Jacques Guerlain had the incredible and daring idea of combining a chypre with a very fruity peach note, giving this fragrance all of its modernity. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Vétiver Parfum 100ml
listings.description: In the 1950's, the GUERLAIN family decided to create a fragrance based on the surprising roots of vetiver. After a few trials, the GUERLAIN Perfumer succeeded in making a subtle dosage that recalls the exhalations of the earth in the pale dawn light. This evocation of the world's first morning is enriched with a woody accord and the refined elegance of spices and tobacco to give rise to a rare and sophisticated fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Infusion De Rose Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A delicate floral scent, emboldened by zesty and earthy tones. Prada’s Infusion De Rose Eau de Parfum is inspired by the beauty of the rose, emitting a fresh flowered fragrance, that reveals surprisingly harmonious layers for a modern composition. Powdered rose sits in a basket of zesty mandarin and fresh neroli, while galbanum gives the soft citrusy infusion an earthy edge. The unsuspecting collaboration of aromas work to create a magnetic appeal, ideal for all.

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant of Venice Murano Imperial Emerald Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Emerald-coloured eyes, the whoosh of a regal garment and the unmistakable scent of timeless elegance: Imperial Emerald is the seductive fragrance and takes its inspiration from the peacock, the most enchanting and majestic of creatures. For millennia this bird has inspired myths and legends in both western and eastern cultures, legends that attributed to it the most sublime meanings: beauty, longevity and love, along with vanity, luxury and pride. The dazzling, visual displays generated by its fan-like tail have enchanted and confused the gaze of mortals, as well as the immortals of countless myths. To pay homage to the elegance and wonder of Venice, The Merchant of Venice was inspired by these emerald-green and blue patterns and created this olfactory masterpiece. The top is joyful, with splendid modern citrus faceting the fragrance from the top to the dry-down as a caressing shiver to accompany an orris poudrè and pink pepper in a passionate crescendo. In the middle a loving tremble, ylang ylang and opulent rose absolute Chile, is joined by a marvelous bouquet of clinking lily of the valley with all the magnificence of night-blooming jasmine, tuberose and orange flowers. The dry-down is warm and rich of white amber and precious benzoin passionately hugged in a seductive dance. A creamy vanilla and the most enveloping musks accompany an innovative patchouli for an unforgettable long lasting trail, for a woman who leaves her mark and is, like her Imperial Emerald, forever.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar Souffle De Parfum Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Shalimar Souffle de Parfum is like a perfumed caress. A light and enchanting Eau de Parfum with citrus fruits, jasmine, white musks and vanilla notes, revisiting the mythic Shalimar in a modern way. Once upon a time, four centuries ago, in India, there was a love that knew no bounds. For his beloved wife, the princess Mumtaz Mahal, the emperor Shah Jahan ordered the creation of the most luxurious gardens of Shalimar as a setting for their love. Later, he erected the Taj Mahal, a marvel admired by the entire world. This fabulous story inspired Jacques Guerlain to create an exquisitely seductive scent: Shalimar.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Homme Idéal Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The ideal man is a myth. But with L'Homme Idéal Eau de Parfum, Guerlain has made his fragrance a reality. A woody fragrance combining three ingredients and three accords to boost your powers of seduction and awaken the ideal lover within you.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Rose Morning Eau de Parfum 9ml
listings.description: Awaken your inner romantic with the Fresh Rose Morning Eau de Parfum, a charming fragrance infused with freshly cut roses and musk notes to fill your day with passion and enchantment. Conjuring the aroma of a bright morning in summer, the scent unleashes a mist of aromatic florals to start your day. Laced with the most romantic flower of all, the rose, the alluring aroma is matched with a tempting blend of blackcurrant and violet leaf. At the heart lies a bouquet of Bulgarian rose, peach blossom, and freesia, unmasking a love potion that leaves a lingering floral trail on the skin. Hypnotic musk warms the scent with white tea and amber for the touch of sensuality within this tender union of accords.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar L'Essence Eau de Parfum Intense 90ml
listings.description: The first amber perfume in history created by Jacques Guerlain, Shalimar celebrates its 100th anniversary. To mark this exceptional event, the Maison is revealing Shalimar L’Essence, a new intense variation which concentrates Shalimar’s distinctive codes: its quintessence. A homage to the timeless modernity, daring and seduction of Guerlain’s most famous scent for women. More than a perfume, Shalimar L’Essence is a declaration of love. One made by Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Director of Perfume Creation and Perfumer, to the Maison’s heritage icon, and specifically to its most emblematic note, the cornerstone of its scent: vanilla. Delphine Jelk has added the precious Madagascan vanilla tincture stemming from Guerlain's ancestral know-how to the ethylvanillin found in Jacques Guerlain’s original formula, giving Shalimar a new intensity without detracting from its signature. Discreet and subtle bergamot illuminates the floral heart, which blends rose absolute with the powdery elegance of iris. Little by little, Shalimar’s amber note unfolds, deeper than ever. Used in abundance, vanilla infuses it with new facets – smooth and woody with a hint of leather. Guerlain has reinterpreted the logo of its iconic bottle for Shalimar L’Essence. A nod to Art Deco, the artistic movement contemporary to Shalimar. Assembled in a bold graphic logo, the letters are crafted in a golden shade reminiscent of the perfume itself. Firmly anchored in its history yet unmistakably contemporary, the Shalimar L’Essence bottle forms a bridge between the eternal Shalimar and its future iteration.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom For Her Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci Bloom Parfum blossoms into the floating garden of dreams, bringing an addictively solar amber bouquet to the Bloom collection. The new Parfum from Gucci Beauty reimagines the iconic white Bloom Accord, transforming it into a golden Bloom Accord. It brings an intense gourmand edge with Coral Jasmine accord, a warm and luminous night-flowering jasmine that bathes the scent in a timelessly elegant golden veil. A modernizing co-extraction of Tuberose accord brings intensely fragrant sophisticated richness and powdery sensuality with hints of orange blossom accord. With subtle yet unique differences created through a singular note, the new Bloom scent’s rich and ambery accent is driven by the Peru Balsam extract. This is passionately blended with a duo of vanilla notes: a contrasted blend of creamy sweet and spicy woody accords. With these additional notes, the fragrance is wrapped in golden layers of delectable Vanilla, sweet Balsam, and rich Amber accords that drive its addictive solar intensity. The bottle is presented in a striking midnight black that echoes the concentrated depth and power of the juice within. The House’s iconic print of leaves, cherry branches, flowers, and butterflies is finished in gold to evoke its warm, elegant lightness. A modern portrayal of blooming femininity, Gucci Bloom is a place of self-discovery, where beauty blossoms and women celebrate each other as they evolve.

listings.rawTitle: Aromatherapy Associates Rose Essential Oil
listings.description: Luxury wellbeing brand Aromatherapy Associates present their Rose Essential Oil. Designed for use with the brand’s diffuser, The Atomiser, the essential oil imparts a soothing and balancing blend of warm rose, geranium and palmarosa. The ethically and sustainably-sourced essential oil can also be added to a warm bath to create a moment of self-care.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Intense Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances relaunches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Intense for Women presents an ambery floral scent, that inspires a fresh take on blending sensuality with living authentically. The scent reinterprets the signature Gucci Guilty for women in a move that elevates the original fragrance to new heights. Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Intense for Women combines ambery floral nuances with woody notes that accentuate the Gucci Guilty for Women collection's essential core. The vibrancy of the Mandora's citrus perfume and the generosity of Lychee come together to modernise this citrus scent with notes of violet. At its heart, an audacious floral bouquet of Ylang Ylang and Tuberose is enhanced by the mysterious sensuality of a dark Plum accord. Finally, Patchouli and Vetiver meet the indulgence of Vanilla for a bold, feminine signature. This perfume for women is housed in a metallic bronze bottle that features the brand's iconic interlocking Gs, mirroring the fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances relaunches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Toilette for Women presents an ambery floral scent, that inspires a fresh take on blending sensuality with living authentically. The Eau de Toilette is defined by the light, fresh femininity of lilac petals, immersed with a sparkling citrus twist on a trail of rich and sensual amber notes and Patchouli. Opening in the mood of this Gucci scent’s signature, the luminous citrus top notes of Mandarin are blended with Pink Pepper for a bright and vibrant freshness. At the heart of this citrus perfume, the lilac floral quality combines with the fruity blend of Peach and Raspberry and with notes of Egyptian Geranium to create a delicate and harmonious contrast. Finally, Patchouli and amber notes reveal the warmth and creaminess of the dry down, echoing the base notes of the women's Eau de Toilette to bring strength and sensuality to the juice. This perfume for women is presented in a shade of metallic rose gold. The bottle is partly wrapped in the coloured metal with a matching cap, that features the brand's iconic interlocking Gs, mirroring the fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge - Eau De Toilette Gift Set
listings.description: For Father’s Day, offer him the elegance and boldness of Habit Rouge. Set Contents: Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette 100ml The first amber men’s fragrance with the unmistakable top notes of lime and bitter orange. Its spicy, sophisticated heart, warmed by patchouli, rests on a base where leather mellows under the creamy caress of benzoin and vanilla with a rebellious touch. Habit Rouge Shower Gel 75ml With its invigorating texture, it gives the skin the inimitable scent of Habit Rouge.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cypress & Grapevine Duo
listings.description: Introducing the Jo Malone London Cypress & Grapevine Duo, a two-piece collection that cleanses and scents the skin. Set Contents:  Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense 50ml Infused with uplifting botanicals, the fragrance awakens the senses with resinous cypress before introducing grounding vetiver and grapevine. Moss accord adds a grounding edge, while amber leaves behind a warming impression. Cypress & Grapevine All Over Body Spray 125ml The same earthy-woody scent in the form of an all-over body mist.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez All Of Me Eau De Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: A bolder interpretation of Narciso Rodriguez’s original floral musky scent, the All Of Me Eau de Parfum Intense empowers its wearer to embrace their individuality. Inspired by self-love, the multi-faceted fragrance opens with a refreshing iris and jasmine sambac blend, lending the perfume an air of opulence. The heart notes are elevated with a new tuberose accord, captivating the senses with its rich aroma, before closing with a warm, sensuous elixir of vanilla, sandalwood and musc. The prismatic 50ml bottle is reimagined with a rose pink tint that deepens in colour at the base. Complete with a luminous topper, the perfume is an elegant addition to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Amethyste Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Evoking the soft shine and noble refinement of amethyst, the fragrance of BVLGARI Omnia Amethyste is an incredibly nuanced bouquet embodying the myriad scents of Iris gardens dappled with morning dew. A flower of great luxury and originality, the iris' velvety petals capture the multiple textures of light and reflect them with intense and enchantingly feminine shades. The new flacon design pays tribute to Omnia's iconic shape while staying true to its inimitable original scent, which remains untouched. Like a frame of light, an invitation to rediscover the iconic fascination of Omnia from a new, more precious perspective. Two rings smoothly flowing into each other through two detachable elements, unveiling the fragrance's atomizer and introducing a new concept for this iconic flacon. Like a shining secret at the heart, an elegant rose gold-coloured frame on the cap brings Bulgari's DNA as a jeweler to the core of one of its most iconic feminine fragrance collections. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, the new flacon captures every single drop of light.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Discovery Set Colonias: Colonia, Colonia Eau de Parfum, C.L.U.B.
listings.description: Get the best out of three with this treasure trove of Acqua di Parma fragrances, offering different (but equally tempting) takes on the iconic Colonia . Set Contents: Colonia Eau de Cologne 12ml The timeless original – Italy in a bottle. Crisp bergamot and lemon meet aromatic lavender and rosemary, creating a fresh, elegant scent that’s effortlessly classic and endlessly wearable. Colonia Eau de Parfum 12ml A richer, more modern take on the original. Blood orange and grapefruit add depth to the citrus opening, while rosemary and vetiver bring complex warmth. It’s vibrant, grounded and evocative of sunlit Mediterranean landscapes. Colonia C.L.U.B. 12ml A contemporary twist with a youthful edge. Green and spicy notes of shiso, pink pepper and raspberry subtly disrupt the citrus tradition, offering a fresh, dynamic scent that balances heritage with modernity.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Paying homage to the Greek God of love, the Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum is a woody-citrus iteration of the iconic original Eros fragrance. Symbolising the serenity of the Mediterranean coastline as the crisp waves lullaby nearby, the cologne features vibrant bergamot, blood orange and grapefruit notes to capture the beauty of its bountiful nature. Italian lemon imbues a zested, fresh aroma, before warm green nuances of patchouli and oakmoss provide a deep, authentic edge with a long-lasting sillage. Arriving in the signature quadratic bottle, embossed with Eros’ portrait in a new, yellow hue, the eau de parfum sits proudly on any dresser.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Signatures of the Sun Zafferano Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A combination of warm and dry notes, perfectly balanced and blended with a sweet, amber-woody edge. Acqua Di Parma’s Signatures of the Sun Zafferano Eau de Parfum celebrates the harmony of uniting elements to create something exquisite. Spotlighting the renowned ‘red gold’ of fragrance, the eau de parfum fuses saffron with bright citrus notes to contrast its intense, resinous facets. To complement, nuances of jasmine, rose and orange blossom lend a floral softness, breathing a light, gentle breeze into the blend. In the base, vaniglia, tonka bean and patchouli close the trail with depth and intensity, promising scent longevity on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Un Jardin en Mediterranee Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: The first in the Parfums-Jardins collection, created in 2003, Un Jardin en Mediterranee eau de toilette evokes a walk through a secret Tunisian garden exuberantly overflowing with trees and flowers. It is an unusual oasis combining olfactory, visual and tactile sensations, by Jean-Claude Ellena.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The scent of the Hermès girls, a daring fragrance woven with striking ginger and sensual tuberose. A floral, spicy eau de parfum. "It is with young women in mind, by observing their lives, that I created Twilly d’Hermès. Free, bold, connected, mischievous and irreverent, they turn expectation on its head, swim against the tide, impose their own rhythm, invent a brand new tempo." Christine Nagel It is in this spirit that Christine Nagel composed Twilly d'Hermès. Ginger, tuberose and sandalwood are given a new twist. Combined differently, they become searing spice, disconcerting attraction, a revelation of the carnal. In a final flash of wit, a hand-tied silk ribbon playfully graces the bottle. Each silk ribbon is unique.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Tutti Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Created by Christine Nagel for the Hermès girls, Tutti Twilly d'Hermès eau de parfum is a tribute to their free spirit – a blend of daring and lightheartedness – and their multifaceted nature. Individuality is reflected in this fragrance. A floral and fruity eau de parfum with a generous character crafted with gentle ginger blossom, mellow lychee, and enveloping musk notes. Designed by Florence Manlik, the lantern-shaped bottle has a square silhouette, adorned with an inverted lychee-red color graduation. With a final flourish, a hand-tied silk ribbon playfully embellishes the cap of each bottle designed by Carine Brancowitz. Each silk ribbon is unique. Its 30 ml format allows you to take the notes of Tutti Twilly with you while on the go to diffuse the sparkle of the Hermès girls anywhere and everywhere. The Twilly d'Hermès family of perfumes evokes the Hermès silk métier on two fronts: it calls to mind the house's silk twill scarf as well as the Twilly, a small, joyful, colourful silk ribbon that can be worn in countless ways.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man In Black Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Elementally inspired by fire, BVLGARI Man In Black Parfum ignites your scent arsenal with bold intensity. True to BVLGARI’s signature of unexpected contrasts, the fragrance opens with a striking spice accord, fused with elemi essence for a smoky, resinous lift – an aromatic intro that evokes the orange-red glow of flames. A powdery, creamy heart follows, softening the heat with a skin-like sensuality. Anchoring the composition is a base of dark woods and benzoin, their musky, enveloping richness strengthening one another. Sense as they linger in your wake, like drifting embers. The flacon itself is rendered in classic black, finished with gold-tone branding for a strong, decisive flourish.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette 200ml Refill
listings.description: Reveal your light through OMNIA. Evoking the purity and clarity of crystal, the iconic BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline is a luminous Eau de Toilette Refill signed by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas. A fragrance inspired by the aquatic transparency of the lotus flower, sublimated by the airy generosity of a white peony. Omnia Crystalline is a delicate scent evolving through watery crispy notes of nashi pear, the vegetal freshness of bamboo and ending on the warmth of balsa wood softened by an accord of crystal musks.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Love In Capri Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Dive into the exhilarating waters of Capri, as Dolce&Gabbana’s Light Blue Love In Capri Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray captures the island’s magnetic charm. Inviting the senses on a sea-breezed journey, the fragrance opens with black pepper, before a vibrant heart of Capri green fig harmoniously contrasts against the spiced allure. Refining the aroma is a sophisticated base of patchouli, warming the scent and providing a long-lasting trail. Topped with an enamelled cap, the bottle is embellished with motifs of Caprese blue majolica for a decorative finish.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Pure Perfume 75ml
listings.description: The warmth and density of wood combined with the softness of benzoin and the sparkle of shiso. Terre d’Hermès narrates the relationship between man and earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with the elements and nature. Terre d’Hermès is the perfume that connects man to his origins, to the source of his creative power.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The strength of vetiver mixed with the vitality of the Sichuan pepper and green bergamot. Vetiver, inherent to Terre since its origins, is the culmination of this new composition. The initial woody and mineral balance of Terre becomes woody and vegetal.

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons 44 Gerrard Street Eau de Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Sophisticated and fresh, the 44 Gerrard Street Eau de Cologne celebrates Atkinsons’ beginnings. The scent pays homage to the location of the brand’s first store and the birthplace of their products. Created by perfumer Mathieu Nardin, the fragrance reinterprets the classic cologne recipe, opening with an invigorating blend of eucalyptus, ginger and ginger lemon. The heart offers a striking juxtaposition, lending the scent floral nuances of jasmine and rose before settling into an intoxicating creamy base. The ingredients are extracted with pioneering technology that expertly captures the scent of raw materials for a pure olfactory experience.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia C.L.U.B. Eau de Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Celebrating individuality, the Acqua Di Parma Colonia C.L.U.B. Eau de Cologne combines fresh facets with sparkling fruits and aromatic wood notes. Opening with a bright breeze of bergamot, lemon and pink pepper, the fragrance makes a bold statement upon first spritz, before rounding out with an earthy black pepper, shiso and rosemary edge. Granting longevity, a skin-like blend of cedarwood and musk warm the scent with resinous, woody nuances, leaving a rich, unique trail that lingers long into the night.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Travel Spray Gift Set
listings.description: The Balmain Travel Spray Set invites you to immerse yourself in an expression of musk, amber and floral statements. Set Contents: Sel d'Ambre Eau de Parfum 5ml Swirling in warming accords, the aroma exudes a mysterious glow of amber, olibanum and orris extracts. Inspired by desert nights, the fragrance is housed in a golden flacon. Carbone Eau R23e Parfum 5ml Revealing the multifacets of musk, the scent combines rose, suede and patchouli to explore a darker, more sensual side to the classic fragrance note. Rouge Eau de Parfum 5ml Flirting with florals, the fragrance is elevated with notes of lily, ylang ylang and magnolia flower to create a sunlit aroma.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Eau de Grey Vetiver Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Tap into your dynamic side with Tom Ford’s Grey Vetiver Eau de Toilette, a woody-spicy elixir that elevates any scent collection. The fragrance embodies what the designer calls  the essence o f  debonair, charismatic, and provocative masculinity . Vetiver makes up its core, that textured, earthy treasure revered by master perfumers for centuries. In Ford’s hands, this note is remixed and reborn: sharpened by crisp citrus and livened up by colourful nuances. Orange flower and grapefruit introduce an invigorating brightness, while nutmeg and pimento weave a subtle, seductive spice. Woody oakmoss adds a grounding element to the scent pyramid, forging a depth that lingers when you exit the room. The fragrance is housed in a clean, minimalist bottle with matte silver-tone accents and a debossed logo.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri La Riserva Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Composed through a slow two-month maceration process, the Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia di Capri La Riserva Eau de Parfum 100ml is inspired by Capri’s textured coastline and citrussy aromas. The scent begins with a burst of sunlit citrus thanks to nuances of Italian blood orange and mandarin, brightened by the freshness of petitgrain bigarade. Notes of rosemary and Italian basil weave an aromatic accord, softened by a trace of sea air. As the fragrance settles, cedarwood, ambrettolide and suede emerge, leaving a soft lingering warmth. The deep blue bottle mirrors the strength of the scent, echoing the depths of the Mediterranean itself.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Envelop yourself in a celebration of delectable aromas with the Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum. The fragrance emulates feelings of temptation and cravings summoned by citrusy, vanilla baked goods amid the winter season. Inspired by the divine Italian dessert, panettone, the scent takes you on an olfactive journey through the sweet streets of Milan, wafting through irresistible accords of charming baked treats. Tantalising, gourmand notes of candied lemon open the fragrance for a bright and captivating beginning. At the heart, orange blossom adds luminosity and freshness to Eau de Parfum with an exquisite contrast of richer, sweeter accords. The superstar of the fragrance, Madagascar vanilla, interrupts the sensory journey, conjuring feelings of sensuality and irresistibility.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Jour d'Hermès Absolu Eau de Parfum Refillable Natural Spray 50ml
listings.description: Jour d'Hermès Absolu was created by perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena in 2014. Its formula is quintessentially floral and feminine. "I wanted to create an assertive signature that took us as close as possible to the body of a woman. You can see her shoulders, her neck; you can touch her and breathe in her scent." A floral fragrance, Jour d'Hermès Absolu eau de parfum reveals sensual gardenia, sun-drenched sambac jasmine and velvety apricot blossom. Created by designer Pierre Hardy, the bottle displays rounded, sensual curves. At the centre, a drop of pink amber light hangs suspended. The bottle can be replenished using the 125 ml Jour d'Hermès Absolu eau de parfum refill. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. An essential tool for the artisan's work, light is the primary material at Hermès. It energizes objects and brings them to life, while revealing the beauty of the world. It is this light that inspired Jour d'Hermès, the most vital of fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Atkinsons Oud Save The King Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A scent with a story, the Atkinsons Oud Save The King takes us back to 1920s London. Prohibited by his uncle to marry Hollywood movie star Mabel Normand, Prince Mohammed Ali Ibrahim of Egypt required James Atkinsons to create two matching scents to connect him and his forbidden lover. Opening with accords of unusual earl grey tea, the fragrance was required to remind the prince of the time he spent with Mabel in London and her favourite tea. The heart of suede emulates the leather of his victorious boxing gloves, complimented by aromatic iris. Intensely rich oud finalises his magnificent scent, which the prince referred to as "the liquid gold of the Orient”.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Intensa Eau de Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Refine your scent collection with Acqua di Parma’s Colonia Intensa Eau de Cologne, a fragrance that harnesses the pulse of modern masculinity through a dynamic interplay of citrus, spice and leather. The EDC opens in a blaze of brightness – Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian lemon and ginger sparking against the aromatic warmth of cardamom. The effect is electric yet composed, like sunlight striking polished chrome. As the top notes settle, a more textured profile unfolds: herbal myrtle and neroli lend Mediterranean clarity, while artemisia weaves in a subtle, green tension. Beneath it all, a smooth foundation of leather, patchouli and benzoin roots the composition in strength. Each spritz is a passport to  " la dolce vita" – think sharp suits, golden hour and magnetism.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Jasmin Rouge Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Blending florals with spice, the TOM FORD Jasmin Rouge Eau de Parfum 50ml presents jasmine in a rich, expressive way. Opening with black and white peppercorn, the scent has a smoky undertone, softened by clary sage. At its heart, jasmine sambac takes centre stage, layered with ylang ylang for a luminous floral note. As it settles, labdanum and amber bring a smooth, resinous finish that lingers on the skin for a long-lasting olfactive experience.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi EDT 100ml
listings.description: Taking cues from its coastal namesake, Acqua di Parma’s Blu Mediterraneo Fico di Amalfi Eau de Toilette captures the spirit of southern Italy in a bottle. The EDT paints a vivid portrait of the Amalfi coast – sunlit cliffs draped in citrus groves, their sharp zest softened by the honeyed sweetness of figs ripening just inland. A radiant burst of Italian lemon, bergamot and grapefruit opens the pyramid, effervescent and full of movement, like sea spray catching the morning light. Beneath this brightness, jasmine petals unfurl against a whisper of pink pepper, balancing florals with a spark of spice. As it dries, detect the woody-green base formed by a trifecta of woody notes, finishing the fragrance with a calm flourish. Your olfactive postcard from the Mediterranean, this fragrance will inject vitality (and a dash of escapism) into your aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Signatures of the Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by radiant days and golden horizons, Acqua di Parma Signatures of the Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum is a celebration of contrast and warmth. A luminous opening of citrus and florals gives way to a sensual heart of cinnamon and pink pepper, capturing a delicate balance between freshness and spice. As it settles, deep notes of oud, patchouli and amber unfold, leaving a long-lasting, smoky trail that lingers with sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A signature in the making, the Burberry Her Eau de Parfum elevates the art of fragrance to daring new heights. Crafted with a bold trifecta of notes, this feminine scent elevates your collection with precision and poise. Opening with a delicate cherry overture, it teases with a sweet, gourmand whisper rather than an overpowering fruity punch. Beneath this, amber lends a sensual, sun-warmed glow, wrapping the skin in a sentiment of freedom and expression. Vanilla absolute grounds the fragrance and establishes a time-old, lasting decadence. Far from a fleeting mist, the EDP offers a sultry take on amber, flirting with freedom while remaining sophisticated. As inspired as the woman who wears it, the fragrance is housed in an opaque pink bottle, then accented with ribbons for a feminine flourish.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Nuit d’Egypte Eau de Parfum for Women 75ml
listings.description: Inspired by the ancient kyphi, the first known perfume to humankind, the Chloé Nomade Nuit d’Egypte Eau de Parfum fuses age-old allure with modern refinement. The floral ambery fragrance pays homage to Egypt, constructed with base ingredients mentioned in recipes of the ancient elixir. The sensory masterpiece opens with accents of myrrh, spicy cinnamon and ginger melting into honeyed hues of bloom flower nectar. Orange blossom absolute, sourced from the heart of Egypt, is paired with an exquisite kyphi accord for a feminine and addictive scent. Sensuous vanilla warms the base for a fragrance that endures. Tinged deep Egyptian blue, the iconic bottle is reinvented with a braid tied around its mysterious hue. Embark on a new adventure with Chloé Nomade Nuit d’Egypte, a high-intensity scent perfect for any occasion.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein DEFY Eau de Toilette For Him 30ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Bergamot, Lavender Absolute. Heart Notes: Vetiver Oil. Base Notes: Amber Notes. Lose yourself in the intoxicating aromas within the Calvin Klein DEFY Eau de Toilette For Him. Smouldering and powerful, the fragrance opens with surprising notes of bergamot and lavender. Floral yet fruity, the olfactory journey leads you through a colourful, sun-kissed orchard, adorned with swaying trees. A beating heart of vetiver oil enlivens the senses, lingering in the air and on the skin. Finishing with amber notes, the EDT embodies the many layers that make up the modern man.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Collection Le Bois Glace Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the materials found in Moncler boutiques, the Les Sommets Collection Le Bois Glace Eau de Parfum pays homage to Haitian vetiver, a multi-dimensional note laced with resinous, woody nuances, contrasted with the zest of Italian bergamot. Housed in a simplistic apothecary-style bottle adorned with cursive text, the flacon showcases its rustic feel with a contemporary edge, reflective of the scent kept inside. Warm woods mingle with the earthy headiness of vetiver, before settling upon a bergamot and pink pepper base. Striking yet sophisticated, Moncler masters the unisex fragrance effortlessly.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Where glamour meets seduction, TOM FORD’s Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum is an interplay of addictive gourmand accords with a captivating trail. A triple dose of vanilla powered this smouldering scent, as the deep and bright creamy notes kiss the skin with a soft sensuality. Laced with vanilla tincture, the tempting blend has been designed specifically for the Tom Ford fragrance house. Sweet but far from innocent, fresh floral notes intertwine with bitter almond and rich sandalwood to entice the senses in an alluring and opulent dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Ivoire Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: First debuted in 1979, Balmain’s Ivoire Eau de Parfum returns anew in the image of modern Paris – an olfactory journey through the beloved city. Crafted from an inimitable blend of notes, the fragrance weaves fruity, earthy, woody and spicy facets into an irresistibly elusive companion – never linear, always unfolding. At its heart lies tubéreuse de nuit, the nocturnal tuberose whose carnal, sophisticated quality forms the perfume’s central allure. Its intensity is softened by luminous orange blossom, adding a warm, solar lift. Deeper in the aroma’s structure, supporting the grapefruit and turmeric notes further up in the pyramid, vetiver and supple suede offer a vintage layer – a nod to old France that lingers magnetically on the skin. A true meeting of old and new, this refreshed archival scent transitions effortlessly from day to night, season to season.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Barenia Eau de Parfum Refill 125ml
listings.description: Perfumer Christine Nagel presents her chypre for Hermès: a sensual fragrance of rare, unforgettable elegance. Barénia is a skin perfume, bringing together strength and softness. It expresses the instinctive, captivating facets of a woman. An unstoppable woman. The living embodiment of freedom. Barénia eau de parfum blends exhilarating butterfly lily with the delicacy of the miracle berry, and envelops them in oakwood and an intense patchouli. An elusive, stirring and surprising chypre with a sensuous texture. The 125ml refill of Barénia eau de parfum can be used to replenish the 100ml, 60ml and 30ml bottles. A responsible act, integral to an object created to last.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Q Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A fragrance designed to make its wearer feel like a contemporary queen, Q by Dolce&Gabbana exudes radiant and refined feminine energy. The Eau de Parfum fuses vibrant citrus fruits with a delicate bouquet of florals. Sparkling notes of Sicilian lemon and red orange are elevated by delicate jasmine petals. A heart of sweet cherry and creamy heliotrope seduce the senses, before base notes of cedarwood and musk give the floral perfume an intense, addictive edge.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Barénia Eau de Parfum Intense, 100ml
listings.description: Perfumer Christine Nagel has created a new interpretation of the Hermès chypre perfume: Barénia Eau de Parfum Intense. The captivating intensity and sensuality of this new expression infuse the fragrance with a femininity steeped in mystery. True to the elegance of a classic chypre perfume, Barénia Eau de Parfum Intense amplifies the softness of butterfly lily and the depth of oakwood. Leathery notes evoke Barénia leather, harmoniously underlining the intensity of a patchouli absolute and creating a unique and captivating signature. The bottle, created by Philippe Mouquet and inspired by the Collier de Chien bracelet, is tinted with an amber gradient, echoing the depth of this eau de parfum intense. Its gentle elliptical curves balance out the strength of the pyramidal studs with their domed sides. At the heart of the jewel-like Barénia bottle is one final stud, shaped into the base of the glass. The 100 ml, 60 ml and 30 ml bottles of Barénia Eau de Parfum Intense can be replenished using the 125 ml refill (sold separately).

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandorlo Di Sicilia Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Bottling the scent of Sicily, Mandorlo di Sicilia Eau captures the warmth and sweetness of sun-drenched shores and citrus groves. The fragrance opens with bright, aromatic star anise, followed by bergamot and orange, zesty, softly spiced accords that feel uplifting and radiant. As it settles, the heart of green almonds and ylang-ylang unfolds, releasing floral tones with a hint of freshly-cut grass. It’s grounded in a creamy base of vanilla, cedarwood, tolu balsam, and musk, wrapping the scent in a cocoon of softness. Wear it on slow, sunlit mornings or gentle evenings and embody the serenity of the Sicilian sunset.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Looking for an elevated vanilla scent? This TOM FORD Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum isn't your typical gourmand, layered with an inimitable blend of notes to distinguish your every entrance. On the first spritz, a velvety ribbon of vanilla tincture from India comes through, complemented by a comforting layer of vanilla absolute. As the fragrance settles, sandalwood essence glides in like polished mahogany, adding a quietly powerful dimension to the pyramid: picture a dimly lit room filled with antique wood and gently flickering shadows. True to the label's signature edge, an animalis accord in the base disrupts the softness of vanilla, leaving behind a complex, musky trail that naturally turns heads. Encased in a gold-tone flacon, the bottle itself is a statement of luxury. It's framed by a sleek clear border and finished with signature branding.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Intensa Eau de Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Refine your scent collection with Acqua di Parma’s Colonia Intensa Eau de Cologne, a fragrance that harnesses the pulse of modern masculinity through a dynamic interplay of citrus, spice and leather. The EDC opens in a blaze of brightness – Calabrian bergamot, Sicilian lemon and ginger sparking against the aromatic warmth of cardamom. The effect is electric yet composed, like sunlight striking polished chrome. As the top notes settle, a more textured profile unfolds: herbal myrtle and neroli lend Mediterranean clarity, while artemisia weaves in a subtle, green tension. Beneath it all, a smooth foundation of leather, patchouli and benzoin roots the composition in strength. Each spritz is a passport to la dolce vita – think sharp suits, golden hour and magnetism.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum Refillable 100ml
listings.description: A modern scent inspired by the strength and spontaneity of nature, infused with the free-spirit of the Chloé woman. Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum Refillable is reminiscent of a serene natural setting, taking you back to the essentials with an organic rose accord and sensuous woody notes. The composition is introduced with fresh nuances of bergamot and neroli. Rose essence intertwines with a sweet, slightly smoky oakwood accord, before diffusing into an intoxicating base of sandalwood and cedar. The feminine fragrance is housed in a vintage-inspired bottle, embellished with a chic recycled ribbon and wrapped in an intense green hue. 100% natural origin ingredients. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Parfum for Men 150ml
listings.description: Connecting courage and contemporary values, the Burberry Hero Parfum for Men embodies the modern man, strong yet sincere, through the means of an intense woody scent. Encouraging you to embrace your individuality and unlock its superpowers, the fragrance is led by a blend of cypriol oil and Amyris to make an intense olfactive statement, before warming on a base of cedarwood nuances. Smoky, balsamic and slightly sweet, the medley of notes mingle to imbue a rich, complex charm with an inspiring allure. Housed in a quadratic glass flacon detailed with the Burberry logo.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Cleopatra Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Floriental Top Notes: Bitter Grapefruit, Lush Greens, Cassis Bud. Heart Notes: White Jasmine, Peach Nectar, Tuberose. Base Notes: Warm Patchouli, Golden Amber, Rich Vanilla Musk. Inspired by the ancient, iconic seductress, Tocca 's  Cleopatra embodies the beauty, passion and confidence of the modern woman. Enveloping you in a floral coat of freshly-picked blooms, the fragrance opens with a concoction of sparkling Grapefruit and Cassis bud, transitioning seamlessly into a hint of lush, verdant greens. Powdery hues of heady white florals creep in at the heart; a bouquet of White Jasmine, Peach Nectar and musky Tuberose that creates a slightly-honeyed, intoxicating layer, before delving into warmer depths. An oriental dry-down that combines notes of Indian Patchouli, Amber and rich, creamy Vanilla creates a lasting, luxuriant sillage that seduces the senses. Boasting a long-wearing eau de parfum concentration, the opulent concoction is bottled in a spherical glass flacon that sits perfectly in your palm. Crowned with a vintage gold top and adorned with a logo plaque, Tocca lovingly presents the perfume in a sleek, collector’s box embellished with gold-foiled vines for a touch of glam.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Jasmin Naturel 75ml
listings.description: An uplifting perfume that radiates power and femininity, Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Naturelle invites your senses on an exciting olfactory voyage. The latest addition to the Chloé Signature collection, the gourmand jasmine scent marries romantic floral nuances with intoxicating woods. An opening of refreshing bergamot, intertwines with sensuous Egyptian jasmine absolute. Date accord lends a sweet, decadent twist, before diffusing into a warm and welcoming base of vanilla and sandalwood. Embark on a quest for freedom with this free-spirited EDP.

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS The Scent Magnetic For Her Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: An olfactive depiction of a power couple, BOSS The Scent Magnetic Eau de Parfum 30ml captures the essence of chemistry with its mesmerising trail. A dark, textured osmanthus flower accord is juxtaposed against sensuous white musk to create an enticing scent juxtaposition. Lending an irresistible warmth, the fragrance is wrapped in an amber accord, tantalising the senses with every spritz. The design of the bottle represents the thrilling character of the perfume within. The multi-faceted flacon features a deep purple hue and is topped with an icy-gold cap, finished with the signature BOSS logo.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Cedar Violet Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Part of a collection inspired by Aerin's travels, experiences and memories, Cedar Violet Eau de Parfum invites you to embark on a journey through the forest on a crisp autumn day. The woody floral perfume is inspired by the scents and colours of an autumnal mountain forest, sprinkled with the golden hues of crisp leaves and sun-dappled paths. Luminous notes of violet leaf fuse with warm cedarwood to transport the senses to the wilderness of the Adirondacks. At the base, glowing amber adds an uplifting element to the sparkling olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Hibiscus Palm Eau de Parfum Travel Spray 7ml
listings.description: A lazy island breeze, the AERIN Hibiscus Palm Eau de Parfum is an exotic blend of blooming florals set against a backdrop of beaches dusted with white sands and fringed with overgrown palms. Baking under the golden glow of the sun reflecting off the waves, the fragrance exudes the relaxation of a far-away luxury retreat. Opening with hibiscus palm and lotus flower, the scent has a powerful, floral presence, supported by ylang-ylang’s heady sweetness and frangipani’s fruity edge. Ginger’s spice peppers through the perfume’s layers, sharpening and balancing the delicate swirl of white blossoms. Finishing with a decadent base of sweet coconut milk and vanilla, the fragrance settles into an indulgent trail mixed with lingering musks.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Eau Parfumée Thé Vert Eau de Toilette 150ml
listings.description: First crafted for an inner circle of high-end jewellery clients, BVLGARI Eau Parfumée Au Thé Vert 150ml remains an iconic scent known for its light, uplifting and effortless nuances. The citrus-aromatic cologne blends the crispness of green tea with the brightness of neroli petals, softened by a lift of bergamot. The result is sheer and fresh, evoking early morning light over a garden landscape. Worn close to the skin, the scent leaves a subtle trail that lingers long after each spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Strawberry, Pear. Heart Notes: Honey, Rosebud. Base Notes: Vanilla, Green Moss. Marc Jacobs’ Daisy Eau So Intense is a captivating fragrance filled with vibrant, sparkling notes. Bringing a deeper, more intense dimension to the beloved Daisy scent, the perfume is brimming with all of perfumer Alberto Morillas’ expertise in this bright yet sophisticated blend. Marrying playfulness with sprightly youth, the perfume opens with fruity Strawberry and fresh Pear, sinking into the sweetness of Honey. A heart of Rosebud adds a softer floral touch while smooth Vanilla creates a creamy, indulgent base. This is offset by Green Moss’ crisp presence for a balanced, fresher feel. Embodying warm springtime charm, the fragrance captures the ephemeral glow of the sunset.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Lily & Magnolia Blossom Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Magnolia, White Tea, Green Mandarin. Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley, Peony, Freesia. Base Notes: Sandalwood, White Musk, Ylang-Ylang. Olfactive Signature: Juicy Pear. The first beams of sunlight across a Cornish woodland grove, Molton Brown’s Lily & Magnolia Blossom Eau de Parfum has a soft, ethereal presence. Combining delicate white florals with exuberant freshness, the fragrance has the unmistakable quality of a ripe, fleshy Pear. With a touch of sweetness from Magnolia, this creamy scent unfurls gradually, carefully revealing itself to have crisp layers of White Tea and sparkling Green Mandarin. Moving deftly through the leafy undergrowth, Lily of the Valley opens into brightness, reflecting off the surface of a rippling brook. The fragrance shrugs into a warming base of Sandalwood and familiar White Musk, joining the damp earth where wildflowers grow. Housed in a glass flacon with a swirling green spherical cap. Made in England.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Costa Azzurra Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tom Ford's Costa Azzurra Eau de Parfum acts as an olfactory postcard, transporting you to warmer climes (no boarding pass required). Cool, salty, and invigorating, this fougère citrus fragrance recalls the sensation of a refreshing plunge into the ocean. Merging elements of air and water, citrus and wood, it carries the senses to the deck of a sleek yacht gliding through open water and past sunlit groves. A bright nuance of lemon cuts through the breeze with crystalline clarity, while cypress, laced with conifer, grounds the composition in coastal green. Salted air mingles with the wild macchia of the shore as azure waves meet spirited winds. Finally, liquid amber facets of cistus absolute lend a smooth, resinous warmth, anchoring the scent to skin through long, sun-drenched days.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Costa Azzurra Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Tom Ford’s Costa Azzurra Eau de Parfum bottles the feeling of a coastal escape, where water, wind and warmth meet in harmony. Salty driftwood and seaweed open the scent, lifted by ambrette and cardamom for a soft, subtle spice. The heart reveals a bright blend of lavender, lemon and mandarin, woven with juniper and myrtle to mirror the wild greenery along the shore. As it settles, vetiver and oak add depth, wrapped in smooth olibanum, incense and a touch of creamy vanilla. The dry-down is fresh, polished and quietly sensual, like a wood-decked, sunlit yacht.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum 40ml
listings.description: Housed in a luxurious golden flacon, the I WANT CHOO Eau de Parfum is an ode to the glamour and free-spirited femininity that epitomises the Jimmy Choo woman. The radiant floral scent opens with an energising burst of sparkling citrus notes of mandarin juice, softened by velvety peach nuances. A passionate heart of solar vanilla-like notes of red spider lily intertwines with jasmine sambac, capturing the essence of golden hour’s allure. An intoxicating blend of vanilla and benzoin provides a creamy and sensual base, leaving an intense, yet joyful, lingering scent trail to captivate those around you. The bottle features a hammered jewelled effect, punctuated by a JC monogram logo, all underlined by the soft and ultra-feminine peach tint of the fragrance. The shimmering golden design mirrors the luminous and luxurious qualities of the precious fragrance housed within.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Floral Chypre Top Notes: Cherry Plum. Heart Notes: Freesia. Base Notes: Oak Moss. Give power to your femininity with the Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum. This fragrance gifts the senses a floral, woody moment to inspire your adventurous side. Free and thriving, the EDP opens with a sweet, voluptuous note of Mirabelle Plum. It gives a dainty but memorable impression before succumbing to a radiant Freesia heart. Oak Moss defines the base with earthy complexity – a dry, green accord that tempts the soul. The Chloé woman is confident, elegant and truly timeless. Housed in a sleek, curved bottle with gold-toned accents, the EDP’s design reflects the exquisite fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratory Perfumes Amber Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Amber. Citrus: Bergamot, Lemon, Black Pepper, Birch Leaf, Juniper, Bourgeon de Cassis. Floral Woody: Lavender, Jasmine, Vetiver, White Flowers. Sensual Woody: White Amber, Leather, Oakmoss, Musks. Bursting open with a lively and energising introduction of fresh citrus, Laboratory Perfumes’ Amber Eau de Toilette has been expertly blended to follow the wearer through their day, mellowing as the hours pass. Bright, effervescent hues of spiced greenery that capture the spirited energy of morning slowly unfurl, making way for a dynamic burst of herbaceous florals, before maturing into a subdued backdrop of warm, earthy, balsamic notes as the evening draws in. The opening fuses fragrant citruses like Lemon and Bergamot, laced with the pungent bite of Black Pepper and subtle hints of multi-faceted aromatics like Juniper, which unleash piney nuances. At the heart, a bouquet of Lavender and Jasmine soften the zing of the fragrance’s zesty launch, bringing balance with a melancholic trail of heady, powdery flowers. As night falls, the EDT evolves slowly, cloaking the wearer in a balmy haze of Ambergris; a rich, woody warmth supported by Leather, Oakmoss and Musks. The luminous, golden-tinted perfume is presented in a contemporary glass bottle, crowned with a spray top for spritzing your pulse points. Socially-conscious, environmentally-friendly and cruelty-free ingredients. Made in the UK.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratory Perfumes Gorse Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Bergamot, Coconut, Lime, Lemon, Mandarin, Ginger, Cardamom. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Lily of the Valley. Base Notes: Musk, Amber, Milky. Breathe in the crisp, fresh notes within Laboratory Perfumes’ ‘Gorse’ Eau de Toilette. Clean and smooth, the fragrance opens with daring Citrus notes, mingling sumptuously with aromas of Ginger, Cardamom and Coconut. Envision the sun delicately kissing your skin as you wander through the gorse bushes in Provence, the vibrant yellow of the flowers encouraging you to think of adventure and new experiences. The velvety petals caress your hands as you make your way towards the beach, the sand warm beneath your feet. The sun sets into heart notes of Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang and Lily of the Valley, offering a delicate vulnerability to the fragrance. The floral scents mingle together deliciously with the spiciness of the top notes, creating a decadent cocktail that is destined to conjure adventurous summer images. The coast of Provence calls to you as base notes of creamy Musk are entangled with Amber, allowing you to picture the shock of the cold ocean water on your toes, as you make your way down the shore. Perfect for everyday use, the perfume is like a mini French vacation in a bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratory Perfumes Samphire Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Aromatic Citrus: Juniper Berry, Black Pepper, Bergamot, Cedrat, Lemon, Lime. Citrus Herbal: Lavender, Grapefruit, Mandarin, Lemongrass, Basil, Ginger, Rosemary, Geranium. Sensual Woody: White Amber, Cistus, Iriswood, Oakmoss, Jasmine, Tonka Bean. Sunday afternoons kissed with salt air, Laboratory Perfumes’ Samphire Eau de Toilette is a cool breeze in a coastal town. It’s an artful blend of citrus Lemon and Lime oils melding with Juniper Berry’s clean spice. This seeps into aromatic Basil, herbaceous Rosemary and soothing Lavender while Verbena mingles with the depth of Oak Moss and Amber at the fragrance’s base. Fresh, green, and aquatic, the perfume breathes new life into your olfactory wardrobe.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratory Perfumes Tonka Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Pink Peppercorn Heart Notes: Mandarin Base Notes: Vanilla, Tobacco Inspired by nature and travel Laboratory’s genderless scent creations are designed to evolve on the skin throughout the day, to match the wearer’s mood and emotions. Created utilising environmentally-friendly and cruelty-free ingredients; each fragrance is skin-kind, free from parabens and phthalates. Tonka is a unisex fragrance that captures the energetic appeal of Mandarin and sparkling Pink Peppercorn, wrapped in a woody aromatics and creamy Peruvian Tonka bean. A sensual base of Vanilla and Tobacco provides a captivating earthiness, binding the fragrance together. Made in the UK using socially conscious, environmentally friendly ingredients. Vegan and Cruelty-free.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum Pen Spray 10ml
listings.description: A floral scent with a comforting character, Perfect Eau de Parfum is an olfactive tribute to self-love. The Marc Jacobs fragrance celebrates what makes you unique, inviting you to embrace your individuality. Pairing perfectly with every occasion, the irresistible floral scent opens with a juxtaposition of tangy rhubarb and rich daffodil, softened by a creamy almond milk accord. As the perfume wears on the skin, nuances of cashmeran and cedarwood begin to unfurl, leaving behind a sophisticated aroma that lasts for hours. Housed in a travel-friendly pen spray, the pastel pink fragrance radiates your essence throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Toilette - 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Tangerine, Bergamot, Lavender. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Absolu Jasmine, White Jasmine Tea. Base Notes: Musk, Vanilla, Ambergris. YSL’s Eau de Toilette takes the iconic Libre fragrance and reimagines it lighter and fresher than before. Staying true to the original, Lavender and Orange Blossom carry the scent while White Tea brings a softer accent to this light floral encapsulation of femininity and youth. Carrying the ‘Libre’ namesake, it characterises an untamed freedom of choice and expression. Presenting a shifting duality that lingers somewhere between coolness and warmth, the perfume celebrates YSL’s signature olfactory tension. It marries the Orange Blossom’s smouldering heat with the crispness of White Tea, an androgynous accord that adds a contemporary edge with a brighter, clearer presence. Expertly crafted by perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm, the fragrance is a masterful triumph from the surface to the trail. Housed in a bottle that reflects the power within, it pays homage to YSL’s role in designing the first tuxedo for women. Influenced by the original bottle, the Eau de Toilette’s vessel is similarly detailed with logo hardware in a new rose-gold tone finish to reflect a fresher, more sensual interpretation.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Oriental Fougere Top Notes: Tangerine, Neroli, Lavender. Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac, Orange Blossom. Base Notes: White Musks, Vanilla Extract. Key Notes: Orange Blossom, Lavender. Yves Saint Laurent’s Libre Eau de Parfum pays homage to the house’s most defining and enduring value: passionate and defiant freedom. Breaking from convention, the emblematic scent combines Aromatic French Lavender, found in classic Fougere perfumery, with luminous solar accords. This harmonious contradiction blurs masculine and feminine facets to create a distinctive, unisex appeal. Vibrant top notes of Tangerine, Neroli and aromatic Lavender exhilarate, revealing a sun-drenched heart of Jasmine and radiant Moroccan Orange Blossom. A creamy base of Madagascan Vanilla and White Musks wraps the composition in effortless sophistication. The sculpted bottle is entwined with a golden YSL Cassandra Logo, featuring a deep 'V' cut-out, with an, asymmetric black lacquer cap. Akin to the fashion house’s couture tailoring, the sensual fragrance offers a high-fashion amalgamation of menswear and womenswear, embodying signature YSL attitude. Unapologetically fierce, authentic and free.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Olympea Blossom Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fruity Floral Notes: Rose, Blackcurrant, Pear, Vanilla, Cashmere Wood. Paying homage to all women, Rabanne’s Olympea is reborn with a more floral twist. The Blossom Eau de Parfum combines floral and fresh notes to encapsulate feminine radiance and confidence, creating a delicate balance between power and romance. Opening with an expressive duality between petals and fruitiness, the perfume combines Rose with sparkling Blackcurrant. Spicy and tangy all at once, the fragrance melts into frosted Pear before swapping this light surface for a tender warmth. Cashmere Wood and Vanilla settle into a musky trail that marries perfectly with your skin for a long-lasting sensory experience.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Olympea Blossom Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: A fresh, floral scent for the contemporary goddess, Rabanne Olympéa Blossom Eau de Parfum offers a sweet, sparkling take on the original, best-selling Rabanne Olympéa. Opening with a peppery burst of velvet rose petals, the fruity-floral fragrance reveals a symphony of tangy blackcurrant and frosted pear, contrasting the delicate top notes. The chypre scent settles on the skin, with an enduring musky base of tender vanilla and sensual cashmere woods. The signature Rabanne Olympéa flacon is reimagined with a floral illustration.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral Top Notes: Redcurrant, Lychee. Heart Notes: Rose. Base Notes: Vetiver, Vanilla. Carolina Herrera’s Very Good Girl Eau De Parfum declares an exciting twist on the original Good Girl fragrance. It is a vivid and playful scent, marked by a mischievous redcurrant and exotic lychee opening. Seductive florals unfold from the heart, pursued by a vetiver and vanilla base. The fragrance is reflective of the modern, passionate woman – the one who is equal parts fun and fearless. Housed in the iconic Stiletto bottle, starring a red-lacquered exterior to mirror the daring scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Gorgeous Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Celebrating powerful femininity, Gorgeous! Eau de Parfum manipulates floral-woody accords to embody the vivacious spirit of the Michael Kors woman. Opening with enlivening notes of bergamot and mandarin, the scent offers a citrusy burst of tantalising zesty notes. A classic bouquet of jasmine, tuberose and orange flowers make up the heart with an optimistic and romantic twist. Tonka, guaiac and cedarwood settle at the base to add richness and depth to the fragrance, with a sensual but confident finish.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Beautiful Magnolia Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Live your very own love story with Estée Lauder’s Beautiful Magnolia Eau de Parfum. This fragrance is bright and passionate, powered by the thrill of a modern-day romance. Magnolia steals the show, gliding through every note like a jolt of electricity. It imparts a fresh, luminous aroma that scatters into a Solar Gardenia and Turkish Rose heart. At the base lies woody, musky accords, sparking the senses with sensual flare. Feminine, radiant, fearless: allow this floral EDP to sweep you off your feet at every turn.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa '40 Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Black Amber Plum, Crème de Cassis. Heart Notes: Jasmine Bloom, Brazilian Orchid. Base Notes: Vanilla Woods, Warm Musk. Immerse yourself in the aromas within the Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa '40 Hair & Body Fragrance Mist. Perfect for taking on the go, the mist imparts a burst of black amber plum and jasmine bloom, allowing you to daydream of smouldering, sun-kissed beaches. Scents of vanilla woods dance playfully with creamy warm musk, offering a hypnotic cocktail that lingers on the skin and in the air. Warm and sweet, the hair and body spray is ideal for people that want to express their sensual sides. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Intertwining light and dark fougère facets, Y Eau de Parfum is an expression of sensuality, sophistication and strength, echoing the multifaceted personality of the YSL man. This fragrance opens with a burst of powerful freshness, emanating from bergamot, ginger and juicy green apple. A heart of sage and juniper brings a masculine contrast to the elegance of geranium absolute and lavender, the two notes emblematic of the bold Y olfactive signature. In the base, a mysterious blend of sensual wood, frankincense and warm tonka bean creates a sensual warmth, intensified by smokey vetiver. Dare to follow your passions and create your own success with Y Eau de Parfum. Created by master perfumer Dominique Ropion, the Y fragrance is encased in a sleek, modern design, featuring an ombre hue that transitions from dark to light blue.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Belle Eau de Parfum 20ml Travel Spray
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fresh Floral Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Petit Grain, White Peppercorn. Heart Notes: White Freesia, Magnolia, Transparent Tuberose. Base Notes: Musks, Sandalwood, Golden Amber. Tocca’s fresh floral fragrance blends unknown adventures with untapped excitement, making for an optimistic aroma that’s overspilling with the joy of life. The light Eau de Parfum has a clean presence, opening with a touch of citrus before delicately mellowing into White Freesia. A base of Skin Musks helps the perfume to last while creating a natural feel that’s both gentle and enticing.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Belle Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fresh Floral Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Petit Grain, White Peppercorn. Heart Notes: White Freesia, Magnolia, Transparent Tuberose. Base Notes: Musks, Sandalwood, Golden Amber. Tocca’s fresh floral fragrance blends unknown adventures with untapped excitement, making for an optimistic aroma that’s overspilling with the joy of life. The light Eau de Parfum has a clean presence, opening with a touch of citrus before delicately mellowing into White Freesia. A base of Skin Musks helps the perfume to last while creating a natural feel that’s both gentle and enticing.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Belle Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fresh Floral Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Petit Grain, White Peppercorn. Heart Notes: White Freesia, Magnolia, Transparent Tuberose. Base Notes: Musks, Sandalwood, Golden Amber. Tocca’s fresh floral fragrance blends unknown adventures with untapped excitement, making for an optimistic aroma that’s overspilling with the joy of life.
