listings.rawTitle: Armani My Way Eau de Parfum - 30ml
listings.description: Escape the boredom of everyday life with the Armani My Way Eau de Parfum . Taking you on an olfactive journey through a flourishing garden, the perfume is a blossoming bouquet of floral notes. A fluid fusion of rich hues, the fragrance invites its wearer to broaden her horizons, become unapologetically herself and live in her own way. Opening with a citrus accord, the hopeful top notes uplift the senses. Making way for the potent heart, the fragrance dives into a floral collection. Jasmine, tuberose and white flowers are seamlessly blended, illuminating the perfume with delicate hues. Almost undetectably, the fragrance finds its final form, merging musky notes. Cedarwood and vanilla intertwine to create a bittersweet base, lingering on the skin to ignite the senses.   Refillable bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Fig & Lotus Flower Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Step into the tranquillity of a secret garden with the  Fig and Lotus Flower Cologne  from  Jo Malone . This light floral fragrance evokes the image of luscious lotus flowers skimming the surface of a shimmering pond with their delicate, water-splashed petals. Plump and juicy figs adorn the bountiful trees, while Neroli creates a radiant aura, capturing the essence of this fresh and abundant scene. The top note of Fig Leaf has been created using the molecule Stemone® to provide a leafy freshness, combines with lactonic tones to create the distinctive milky scent of fig leaves. A dewy and fresh heart of Lotus Flower reconnects the senses with the beauty of the natural world, creating a graceful, light floral accord. In the base, earthy and rich Vetiver gently grounds the fragrances with a fresh, grassy quality, its intensity harmonising with the delicate top notes. Luscious and elegant, this botanical-inspired cologne creates an enchanting scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Parfum Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Step into the night with Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum. Referred to as  “the perfect flower" by Tom Ford himself, the sensual scent rewrites the rules of florals with a mysterious, darkened aroma. Roasted black truffle and vibrant bergamot awaken the senses in the first seconds of contact, swirling into rich rum absolute and decadent patchouli. At its core, black orchid and juicy plum mingle to create an undeniably unforgettable trail that captivates passersby with an air of seduction and glamour.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Step into the hypnotic allure of a midnight garden with Tom Ford Black Orchid Parfum as it unveils the dark, sensual beauty of the black orchid in its most opulent form. Infused with precious essential oils, the parfum amplifies the iconic bloom with ylang-ylang drenched in golden rum, revealing a heightened signature of rich, intoxicating warmth. Luscious black plum swirls into deep floral and spicy accords, creating an alluring, genderless fragrance that celebrates seduction and sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Oud Wood Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Invite your senses along a journey of mystery and intrigue with the Oud Wood Eau de Parfum Spray. This exotic and unmistakably distinctive cologne features Tom Ford’s pioneering composition of exotic woods and spices to evoke visions of smoky, incense-filled temples. The earthy fragrance is underpinned by a rare, precious oud wood, enveloping the wearer in its rich and dark blend of sensuality and strength. Exotic spices and cardamom add further warmth to the eau de parfum, complemented by natural elements of sandalwood, rosewood and amber. Confident and seductive, this intoxicating and elusive scent embodies the Tom Ford man. Oud Wood is housed in a smoked grey private blend bottle, inspired by the architectural appeal of a chess piece.

Inspired by all things glamorous and lavish, the striking aroma holds passersby in its bewitching grip. Opening with clary sage and fresh lavender, the scent commands attention from the first spritz. Seducing the senses, tonka bean drives the fragrance into amber undertones, as blonde woods evoke a sunlit glow. From fragrance to bottle, Tom Ford gives you a truly luxurious experience with the label’s signature branded on a matte black bottle, in a shape inspired by the clean architectural lines of a chess piece.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD F***ing Fabulous Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Named in true Tom Ford fashion, this Eau de Parfum is ‘F***ing Fabulous’. Characterised by a distinct leathery scent, this fragrance is inspired by all things fabulous and decadent. With a name that says it all, the seductive nature of this fragrance is direct and explicit. While almond is blended with iris to create a rich heart, the floral accord provides depth, sweetening the perfume. Merging with the full-bodied note of cashmeran, this unorthodox fragrance is multifaceted, designed for a wearer that is impossible to define.   Warm, spicy, intense, intoxicating – this fragrance takes the mind on an olfactive journey, cloaking the body with a sense of contrast and complication. Housed in the label’s signature matte black bottle, in a shape inspired by the clean architectural lines of a chess piece. Presented in a matte black set-up box to give you a truly luxurious experience.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: 'Vibrant, effervescent and transportive’ is Tom Ford’s description of the Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum from the Private Blend collection. Inspired by the sensory delights of the Italian Riviera, the fragrance sparkles with the fresh zing of citrus fruit, evoking the perfumed breeze that sweeps from the verdant groves over the rugged cliffs. The fragrance introduces a floral heart of neroli, orange flower and lavender, before delving into a deep dry down of amber and aromatic rosemary. Capturing the cool breeze, sparkling turquoise coastlines and rich foliage of the Riviera, the Eau de Parfum is bottled in an aqua-blue flacon adorned with a gold plate.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Soleil Blanc Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A masterful blend of citrus and fruity notes, the freshness of Tom Ford’s Soleil Blanc evokes a sparkling sense of paradise. Deeply summery, the Eau de Parfum is rich in the essence of paradisiacal islands and filled with solar energy. Both seductive and addictive, the scent is brimming with long, languid days spent on the beach, encapsulating the reflection of the hot sun on a glassy sea. It’s a fragrance that’s decadent without feeling heavy, playing into the light vibrancy of escapist joy. Allow yourself to endlessly pursue this luxurious feeling of refined resplendence. Opening with crisp bergamot, the perfume evolves into a warmer, richer display of scent thanks to creamy pistachio at its heart. Relaxing onto a sumptuous base of coco de mer, the blend marries together a hint of floral with deep amber and tantalising gourmand accents.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Transporting the senses back in time, Tom Ford’s Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum takes you on an olfactive journey behind the closed doors of London's finest gentlemen's clubs. Opulent and smouldering, the rich aroma opens with warming tobacco flower and spiced ginger that imitates the smoky aromas of hidden rooms in English society. Vanilla takes a creamy twist, alongside cocoa and tonka bean, to tempt the senses with blissful indulgence. Stirred by modern influences, wood sap and dried fruit capture the decadent essence of the fashion house.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A taste of true luxury, Tom Ford’s Tobacco Vanille Eau De Parfum sparks a sensorial journey. Its warm, spiced facets are nothing short of opulent, smouldering in the air like the ghost of a firework. Centred around creamy vanilla, the fragrance is charged with a sweet, silky twist. Tobacco flower creates sensual smokes that tug at our senses, channelling the private, dusky glow of an English gentleman’s club. The scent is stirred by modern influences, succumbing to a rich, confident sillage. Wrapped in wood sap and cocoa, indulgence is mandatory in this maze of pure intoxication. Poised, powerful and justly proud: reinvent the wheel with Tom Ford’s iconic, spicy EDP.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Adorn your skin with the opulent scents within Tom Ford’s ‘Tuscan Leather’ Eau de Parfum. Prepare to give into your primal instincts as top notes of potent saffron, sweet, whimsical raspberries and herby thyme intoxicate your senses, encouraging you to express yourself honestly and authentically. Animalistic heart notes of olibanum and rich, luxurious jasmine evoke adventurous visions of journeys and pilgrimages, reminding you to surrender to your wanderlust and to never shy away from exploration. The fragrance finishes in a dramatic, dominant manner with earthy, smouldering aromas of suede, hypnotic amber and woods, rounding off the cocktail of scents to reveal possibility and excitement. Encase in a classically Tom Ford black bottle that is guaranteed to be an eye-catching addition to any room.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Noir De Noir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A dark and sensual fragrance, Tom Ford’s Noir De Noir Eau de Parfum Spray captures a compelling portrait of feminine-masculine duality. Combining gourmand florals with rich, earthy undertones, the yin and yang fragrance dares to be different, unravelling on the skin with a layered trail, lasting intensity and depth. Notes of black rose, crocus flower and saffron mingle with heady truffle and oud wood, creating olfactive intrigue in a blend like no other, as vanilla adds warmth to the dry down for an amber, musky allure.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Noir De Noir Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A dark and sensual fragrance, Tom Ford’s Noir De Noir Eau de Parfum Spray captures a compelling portrait of feminine-masculine duality. Combining gourmand florals with rich, earthy undertones, the yin and yang fragrance dares to be different, unravelling on the skin with a layered trail, lasting intensity and depth. Notes of black rose, crocus flower and saffron mingle with heady truffle and oud wood, creating olfactive intrigue in a blend like no other, as vanilla adds warmth to the dry down for an amber, musky allure.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Rose Prick Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Strike a daring balance between beauty and rebellion with the Tom Ford Rose Prick Eau de Parfum. Inspired by a garden of roses, this fragrance opens with a bouquet of Bulgarian rose and rose de mai that unfurls at its heart. Beneath patchouli exhales a woody, chypre depth, while roasted tonka bean smoulders with hints of caramel and vanilla, wrapping the scent in sensual warmth.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Lost Cherry Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the intoxicating scent of Lost Cherry from Tom Ford’s opulent Private Blend collection. The fragrance bursts open with sweet and sour notes of cherry, offset by creamy, nutty hues of almond. Boasting an eau de parfum concentration, the fragrance introduces a floral heart of rose, jasmine and plum before delving into a deep, balsamic dry down of sandalwood, cedar and cinnamon. An expertly blended concoction of fruity, spicy and gourmand elements, the deep crimson fragrance shines through its glass flacon, adorned with a gold plaque.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne 1 Million Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: The olfactory epitome of money, power and luxury, Rabanne 1Million beholds a character of flamboyant extravagance. A sprig of peppermint and mandarin give a crisp, juicy-cool tone to the introduction, the calm before an explosion of sweet, sun-drenched florals at the heart with an unexpected hint of spice. Notes of leather take centre stage, emulating the expensive smell of the plush leather seats on your private jet. Live your fantasy of excessive wealth and feel like a million dollars with this suave men's fragrance, bottled in a gleaming gold bar for an opulent touch.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Flash Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Get ready to shine all night with Jimmy Choo’s Flash Eau de Parfum, a fragrance designed with the glamorous party girl in mind.   Adorn yourself head to toe with a scent that sets the night alive, featuring notes of sparkling strawberry and tangerine, the fruity notes dazzle any crowd. White flowers take the stage as the star of the show, exuding femininity and passion - a bouquet that will captivate the audience. Alluring pink pepper dances with sensual tuberose all night long for an addictive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Man Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Exuding a relaxed confidence and unmistakable masculinity, the BOSS Orange for Men EDT Spray boasts an energising aroma that lasts. With top notes of Apple and Coriander sat upon heart notes of Frankincense and Szechuan Pepper, this unique fragrance is perfect for the carefree, optimistic man. Finished with base notes of Vanilla Bean and Bubinga Wood, this spray is presented in a bold bottle, made to resemble a man's defined torso. K.D.

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Alien Eau de Parfum Natural Spray Refillable - 60ml
listings.description: Mysterious and captivating, Thierry Mugler Alien EDP Refillable Spray (60ml) is an alluring fragrance that's out of this world. Opening with top notes of Indian jasmine, the fragrance moves into a woodsy heart before drying down to a base of warm white amber. Rich and feminine, the bottle is also refillable, meaning you save money in the long run. - L.M.

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Alien Eau de Parfum Natural Spray Refillable - 90ml
listings.description: An olfactive talisman, designed to reveal the light and creative force of its wearer, Mugler’s iconic Alien fragrance captivates all those who encounter it. The distinctive floral woody aroma centres around the powerful scent of jasmine. Alluring and intoxicating, the enigmatic eau de parfum combines warm cashmeran wood and white amber with jasmine sambac. An elixir that captures the essence of feminine sensuality. Housed in a refill bottle to support sustainable luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Capturing the powerful magnitudes of masculinity in all its glory, Rabanne Invictus for Him Eau de Toilette emits a magnetic clash of freshness and animalistic sensuality. Crisp nuances of grapefruit, mandarin and marine accords lead into a heart of bay leaf and jasmine, accompanied by a charismatic undertone of guaiac wood and patchouli. The fragrance arrives in a trophy-shaped bottle, representing the scent of victory.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Lady Million Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Centred around powdery-fresh notes of neroli, orange blossom and jasmine absolute, the carnal symphony of white florals that is Rabanne’s Lady Million exudes sensual, elegant femininity. A luminous opening of bitter orange and raspberry mellow to an indolic heart of soft floral nectars. Patchouli sweetened with honey emerge as the fragrance dries down, grounding the unforgettable scent with a warm depth of animalic undertones. Crafted with a rich eau de parfum concentration for a lasting trail, Lady Million cloaks you in a multifaceted veil that captures the essence of feminine luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Gold Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Indulge your senses with Viva La Juicy Gold Couture EDP 100ml. Boasting a floral fruity scent, the perfume is a decadent rendition of Viva la Juicy that has top notes of wild berries, that are supported with a kiss of honeysuckle and golden amber before melting to base notes of caramel and vanilla. Perfect for women, the addictive fragrance gives off the scent of ultimate glamour. -SA

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Be transported to the orient with this Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette. The “floriental” fragrance is very feminine and seductive whilst bearing a pleasantly intense undertone. Sandalwood, cashmeran, vanilla pod and heliotropine form the base notes that bring this pleasant heaviness. The top and middle notes blend fruitiness from blackcurrant, black fig and violet with the floral notes of tuberose, frangipani and jasmine. The garnet glass bottle is designed to represent the facets of a diamond. LB Notes: Top: Blackcurrant, Black Fig, Violet Middle: Tuberose, Frangipani, Jasmine Base: Sandalwood, Cashmeran, Vanilla Pod, Heliotropine

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Yuzu, Ice Accord, Pomegranate Heart Notes: Peony, Magnolia, Lotus Flower Base Notes: Acajou, Plant Amber, Musk The Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette features a fresh, floral fragrance inspired by the strong, confident, yet feminine woman. Sensual and vibrant, the perfume features a musky undertone adding an alluring edge. The perfume opens with refreshing notes of pomegranate, yuzu and ice accord before melting into a floral heart of peony, magnolia and lotus flower. At the base lies the warmth of amber and musk, harmonising this glamorous fragrance. Housed in a sleek, crystal-inspired bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Versace Bright Crystal is a very feminine floral scent making you feel utterly sophisticated and elegant. The fruity top notes of yuzu, ice accord and pomegranate perfectly complement the floral heart notes of peony, magnolia and lotus flower. Finally, the base notes finish with intense acajou, plant amber and musk. The perfect perfume for the summer months. LB Top notes: Yuzu, Ice Accord, Pomegranate Heart notes: Peony, Magnolia, Lotus Flower Base notes: Acajou, Plant Amber, Musk

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros for Men Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Mint Leaves, Lemon Zest, Green Apple. Heart Notes: Ambroxan, Geranium, Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Vanilla, Vetiver, Oak Moss Accord, Cedarwood. The Versace Eros Eau de Toilette offers a revitalising freshness to captivate the senses with a fragrance inspired by the Greek God of love. Beginning with a tangy burst, top notes of mint leaves, lemon zest and green apple offer a harmonious blend of crisp aromas. The earthy richness of ambroxan, geranium and tonka bean envelops the heart of the fragrance, melting into a masculine base of sweet vanilla, vetiver, oak moss accord and cedarwood. The EDT offers an enticing infusion, embodying the enthralling passion of romance.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Indulge your senses with the La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum, Lancôme's bestselling fragrance for her created by three of France's leading perfumers. Represented by Julia Roberts, the luminous perfume is a universal declaration to the beauty of life. A reimagining of a signature scent, it plays with the addition of magnolia essence to create a sparkling olfactory experience. The EDP opens with a ripe burst of pear and blackberry before capturing the romance of orange flower and jasmine sambac at the heart. It settles on a rich base of patchouli essence that has been sustainably sourced to create an opulent olfactive experience. Revamped in an eco-conscious, refillable bottle, the fragrance takes a step toward a brighter tomorrow, celebrating the timeless iconicity of the scent again and again.  Please note: This product does not include a refill.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Eau de Parfum For Her 30ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Freesia, Peony. Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley, Magnolia, Rose. Base Notes: Ambergris, Cedar. Playful and seductive, the Chloé Signature Eau de Parfum blooms with confidence and sophistication. Combining Freesia and Peony with Lily of the Valley, the intoxicating perfume blends Magnolia and bouquets of voluptuous Rose in the heart, laid on a woody base of Ambergris and Cedar. Housed in an elegant bottle, the refreshing EDP offers the perfect scent for everyday wear.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral. Top Notes: Wild Berries. Heart Notes: White Violet, Jasmine. Base Notes: Sandalwood. Instantly recognisable with oversized daisy embellishments on its cap, Marc Jacobs Daisy is a true icon in the world of fragrance. Sweet, tangy notes of wild berries pull you in, seducing the senses with a fresh, fruity opening that unfurls to reveal whimsical white flowers at the heart. Sandalwood grounds the fragrance with a warm earthiness and lends depth to the eau de toilette. Charming, youthful and feminine, this EDT is much-loved for daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Inspired by the original fragrance, Marc Jacobs' Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette exudes radiance and playful energy. Combining bright fruits and florals, the fragrance opens with ripe Raspberry and Pear, encompassed in a wild heart of Rose, Apple Blossom and Lychee. To finish, the fragrance settles on a warm Plum and Musk base to create a sophisticated but not too serious olfactory experience. Housed in a daisy topped bottle for a signature finish. Top Notes: Ruby Red Grapefruit, Raspberry, Green Leaves, Pear. Heart Notes: Violet, Wild Rose, Apple Blossom, Lychee, Jasmine Petals. Base Notes: Musks, Plum, Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 125ml

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Step into a dewy summer’s day with the Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum . This floral aquatic opens with notes of Lotus, Freesia and Rose, evoking the image of luscious blooms embellished with raindrops. A heart of Lily and Osmanthus adds a unique fresh twist to the fragrance, creating an outdoorsy wanderlust appeal. The sun-drenched florals emit a clean and enveloping scent. A base of Sandalwood Cedar and Ambrette creates a sensual warmth, like summers spent in a lakeside log cabin.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Toilette was Issey Miyake’s first venture into the world of perfumery. The Japanese designer was influenced by a blend of both artistic and natural elements, with his debut scent evoking the image of water on a woman’s skin. Embark on a luminous scent trail of wanderlust and adventure with this delightfully fresh fragrance, composed of delicate flowers, combined with Rose and Lotus. The dewy fragrance was created to evoke the smell springtime flowers, showered in waterfall spray in a rich forest. The Eau de Toilette features a heart of Lily to create a clean, white scent while a base of precious woods adds an earthy warmth to this aquatic floral fragrance. Perfect for both day and night-time wear, this radiant scent will transport your senses to a luscious paradise. The fragrance is housed in an elegant glass flacon, inspired by a view from Mikaye’s apartment depicting the moon suspended over the Eiffel tower.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Yuzu. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Nutmeg. Base Notes: Sandalwood. Bask in the glory of sophistication and class with Issey Miyake L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette. Opening notes of sharp Yuzu illuminate alongside spicy Coriander to capture the illusion of a pure, piquant paradise. Accentuating poise and prestige, sweet Cinnamon bridges the gap between fresh citrusy notes and dark, heady accords as it paves the way for the deep, passionate tones awaiting beneath. An alluring blend of subtle spices lends a sensual, spirited element to the luxurious sillage. Aromatic Nutmeg and Saffron simmer and sparkle at the heart of the smooth, seductive fragrance, dispersing to reveal warm, smouldering notes of Musk and Sandalwood below. Fusing light and heavy aromas, the cologne is enigmatic, elegant and modest.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Powerful, spicy and exotic, Hugo Boss BOSS Bottled Night Eau de Toilette will become the secret weapon in every man's arsenal of seduction. Intense and seductive, the compelling EDT pairs elegance with edgy, masculine character. Woody notes feature heavily, creating a deeply seductive and alluring fragrance. Birch Leaf and Cardamom combine before settling on a warm base of rich Louro Amarelo.   Top Notes: Birch Leaf. Heart Notes: Cardamom. Base Notes: Louro Amarelo Wood, Musky.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Intertwining light and dark fougère facets, Y Eau de Parfum is an expression of sensuality, sophistication and strength, echoing the multifaceted personality of the YSL man. This fragrance opens with a burst of powerful freshness, emanating from bergamot, ginger and juicy green apple. A heart of sage and juniper brings a masculine contrast to the elegance of geranium absolute and lavender, the two notes emblematic of the bold Y olfactive signature. In the base, a mysterious blend of sensual wood, frankincense and warm tonka bean creates a sensual warmth, intensified by smokey vetiver. Dare to follow your passions and create your own success with Y Eau de Parfum. Created by master perfumer Dominique Ropion, the Y fragrance is encased in a sleek, modern design, featuring an ombre hue that transitions from dark to light blue.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Encased within a sleek, glass flacon with new squared, graphic lines and a weighty, transparent base, Dolce & Gabbana’s newest fragrance for women, The Only One Eau de Parfum , encapsulates the essence of sophisticated and hypnotising femininity. Enticing and radiant, with a surprising melange of opposites, the enchanting floral perfume unleashes notes of Violet, combined with subtle touches of zingy Bergamot to create a lively and juicy bouquet with a magnetic pull that beckons the senses. At the heart, seductive notes of rich Coffee are blended with charming Iris. The warm base of Vanilla and Patchouli lends a tactile, comforting quality, enveloping the senses in an opulent embrace. Top Notes: Violet, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Coffee, Iris. Base Notes: Vanilla, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Designed for the modern woman, Dolce&Gabbanna’s The Only One Eau de Parfum encapsulates the essence of feminine allure. The Only One captures the complexities of womanhood within a scent, enticing the senses with a contrasting blend of enchanting violet and zesty bergamot. Smooth iris blends with sensual notes of coffee, continuing a melange of opposites, as a warm base of vanilla and patchouli creates a comforting scent trail. The fragrance arrives encased within a sleek glass bottle with a squared, transparent base.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Pour Homme Intenso Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Discover Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Intenso Eau de Parfum ; a woody aromatic fragrance defined by a new discovery in the olfactory world: the Moepel accord. The Moepel (Milkwood) is a South African tree with a unique odour obtained using Headspace technology, which captures the floral, balsamic and rich honey accents of the flowers and leaves. Fresh notes of Basil and Geranium are enhanced by aromatic Lavender and striking Tobacco, before finishing on a rich, warm base. Housed in a dark brown lacquered glass flacon with a curved silhouette and a cylindrical copper-toned cap. Top Notes: Basil, Marigold, Geranium. Heart Notes: Lavender, Tobacco, Bran. Base Notes: Labdanum, Sandalwood, Cypress.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Encapsulated in an elegant glass flacon with a sleek wooden top, Dolce & Gabbana’s The One For Men Eau de Toilette is a fragrance of elegance and sensuality. Classic with modern touches, vibrant and engaging, The One unleashes fresh, herby notes which develop into a spicy aroma before settling on woody undertones. Charismatic, elegant, seductive and a match for the modern man that never passes by unnoticed. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Coriander, Basil. Heart Notes: Ginger, Cardamom, Sweet Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Tobacco, Amber, Cedarwood.

listings.description: Reminiscent of exciting summer nights, the Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Eau de Toilette Spray captures the brand’s contemporary fougere character with warm woods and bold botanicals. Housed in a patent black bottle and stamped with the signature crocodile motif, the aromatic cologne makes a statement with its fresh yet powerful scent composition. Vibrant watermelon and basil invite the senses in with a charming cocktail, before lavender mellows the olfactive trail and leads us into the night with rich chocolate and cashmeran accords.

listings.rawTitle: Oui Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fresh Top Notes: Water Melon, Acai Tea, Pear Infusion. Heart Notes: Jasmine Absolute, Wild Tuberose, Dewy Honeysuckle. Base Notes: Woods, Amber Resins, Captive Musks. Flirty and fun, Oui Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum offers an explosion of vibrant florals and juicy fruits, capturing the vivacity of contemporary femininity. The fragrance opens with bright fruity notes of Water Melon, Acai Tea and Pear Infusion, creating an exhilarating freshness. The composition reveals a bouquet of florals including Jasmine Absolute, Wild Tuberose and Dewy Honeysuckle. A warm, inviting base of Woods, Amber Resins and Captive Musks adds a sensual depth to the fragrance. Oui Juicy Couture features a striking half red and half pink design, adorned with the brand’s signature crystal effect cap. The bottle is finished with gold-tone hardware and a bold golden logo to evoke a luxurious feel, embodying the brands playful glamour.

listings.rawTitle: I Love Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Notes: Red Currant, Red Apple, Patchouli, Mandarin Orange, Musk, Lily, Amber, Honeysuckle and Jasmine. Adorn yourself in the sumptuously fruity fragrance notes of I Love Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum. Conforming to the fun-loving, cutting-edge ideology of the brand, the perfume is bursting with refreshingly playful scents that linger in the air and on the skin. Sharp, juicy Red Currant dances joyously with Red Apple, Patchouli and invigorating Mandarin Orange, evoking visions of lively, colourful gardens brimming with fruit trees. Daring and adventurous, the fragrance encourages you to embrace your impulsive, adventurous side, tempting you to give into your wanderlust and explore. The fragrance melts into a smooth, rich blend of creamy Musk, powdery Lily and opulent Amber, exuding confidence and empowerment. Unapologetic and hard to ignore, the dominant aromas contrast pleasantly with the fruity scents, creating an enticing juxtaposition that reminds you of the exciting, hypnotic layers that make up the modern human.   Culminating with delicate Honeysuckle and Jasmine, the elaborate blend is destined to allow you to make a memorable statement wherever you go. The perfume is encased in a bottle adorned with whimsical leopard prints and topped with an elaborate, gold-toned, crystal encrusted lid. The fragrance bottle radiates the spirited, mischievous principles that the brand is known for, allowing it to be an eye-catching element of any room.

listings.rawTitle: I am Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Fruity Floral Top Notes: Raspberry, Pomelo, Passion Fruit. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Heliotrope, Rose de Mai, Sweet Pea. Base Notes: Musk, Cashmere Woods, Candied Amber. A fragrance that shines with unpredictability, this Juicy Couture eau de parfum combines a selection of luxurious scents for a truly enigmatic sillage. Sharp, refreshing top notes create a burst of clarity that scatters into perplexing layers of deep allure. Take a bite of the ripest fruit with the crisp opening of Raspberry and Passion Fruit. The delectable duo presents a tangy yet inviting sweetness, luring in the senses with its air of succulence. A private floral garden thrives from within: Gardenia, Heliotrope and Sweet Pea form a tangled trellis to thrill and intoxicate. At the base waits the bolder, warmer accords, ensuring unrivalled intensity. Musk and Cashmere Woods add instant depth for an indulgent, crackling effect. Rich Candied Amber marries the fragrance together, lending a sugary yet fiery passion to the EDP that encapsulates its core uniqueness. Housed in an elegant glass flacon, this Juicy Couture perfume is lively, seductive and always unconventional.

listings.rawTitle: Armani SI Passione Eau de Parfum - 30ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Pear, Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Rose, Jasmine, Heliotrope. Base Notes: Vanilla, Cedarwood, Patchouli. Seductive and sleek, the Armani SI Passione Eau de Parfum is destined to add a daring element to any outfit. As bold and classic as a slick of red lipstick, the fragrance opens with fiery pink pepper and blackcurrant, evoking visions of a crisp, fruity cocktail. A beating, entrancing heart of rose and heliotrope offers a more delicate element, highlighting the vulnerability that we carry within. The amalgamation reaches its crescendo with vanilla and cedarwood, rounding off the blend in a powerful, dominant manner. Encased in a striking, blood-red bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Eau de Toilette Spray 200ml
listings.description: Fresh-Fruity Top Notes:  Pineapple, Bergamot, Lavender, Lemon Verbena. Heart Notes:  Red Apple, Rose, Geranium, Dried Fruits, Oakmoss. Base Notes:  Tonka Bean, Sandalwood. Discover the Montblanc Legend Eau de Toilette Spray. Inspired by the brand’s hundred-year heritage, this luxurious fragrance exudes tradition, status and elegance. Unveiling lively top notes of fresh Pineapple, zesty Bergamot, aromatic French Lavender and citrus Lemon Verbena, the fragrance creates a bright and energetic opening. A heart of Red Apple and Dried Fruits creates a crisp, lightly spiced appeal with a bouquet of Rose, Geranium and Oakmoss. A luxurious Tonka Bean and Sandalwood base creates a sophisticated depth for a mysterious effect.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Fever Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Floral Gourmand Top Notes:  Black Plum Nectar. Heart Notes:  Heliotrope. Base Notes:  Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Sandalwood. Celebrate the glamourous yet mysterious aura of the Jimmy Choo woman with the  Jimmy Choo Fever Eau de Parfum . This alluring scent invites intrigue under the cover of darkness to hypnotise the senses. The sweet Toffee scent of the original EDP has been replaced by deeper Plum Nectar top notes to create a seductive and sophisticated appeal that’s perfect for a night out. A luxurious heart of purple Heliotrope exudes delectable undertones of cherry, vanilla and almond to sweeten a sultry, yet elegant base of Tonka Bean, Benzoin and Sandalwood. Captivating the true aura of luxury, this glamourous scent exudes a confident sensuality. The jewel-like magenta flacon is faceted to resemble the Venetian Murano chandeliers of the brand’s boutiques and is housed in a metallic satin-like python-print box, synonymous with the brand’s shoes and accessories.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Illicit Flower Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Showcasing its twist on classic floral scents, Jimmy Choo presents the Illicit Flower Eau de Toilette, a graceful, yet rule-bending fragrance for the free-spirited. Fresh facets of sparkling apricot and exhilarating mandarin zest awaken the senses with an invigorating, appealing air to introduce the olfactive adventure. Paired with a soft freesia, rose and jasmine heart, the eau de parfum weaves the nuances of elegant flowers with juicy fruits to strike the perfect balance between delicacy and vibrancy. Sandalwood and sensual musk add a creamy charm, closing the fragrance with a warm, long-lasting trail.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Men's Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Citrus, Pear Heart Notes: Cardamom, Coriander Base Notes: Vetiver, Suede, Ambergris Inspired by mavericks, rebels and radicals, the Men's Eau de Toilette from Coach takes you from the straight and narrow and onto the complex and twisted. Hop upon this train and dive into the gold of the Great Train Robbery, exhilarated by the fresh opening notes of Citrus and Pear. Things heat up as the spicy aroma of Cardamom creeps into the fragrance, and the Police quietly approach. Shots ring out, but you’re already well away, with the fresh, citrus scent of Coriander charging you into a sprint, as you succeed in your great escape. Finally, falling into the warm and comforting musks of Vetiver and Suede, you realise the chase is over. A cheer breaks out amongst your bandits, throwing gold into the air as laughter rings in the alley.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A sultry fantasy, inspired by the rarest of flowers. Tom Ford’s Black Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray laces dark and tempting accords together in a spiced floral fusion, with hints of the extraordinary orchid seeping through. Toasted black truffle collides with sparkling bergamot in an unsuspecting opening, while black orchid and plum mingle in the heart of the fragrance, emboldening the sensual composition. Patchouli grounds the parfum spray with a sweet musky aroma that will only leave you craving more. Housed in a fluted, black glass bottle that is a streamlined, modern interpretation of 1920s and 1930s architecture. The dark paradisial eau de parfum is a timeless fragrance and a homage to daring glamour and iconic style.

listings.description: Discover the earthy sweetness of Tom Ford’s Velvet Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray, an enveloping, floral-based fragrance. Bottled in a sleek purple vessel, the scent begins with the shimmering freshness of honey and rum, followed by the signature black orchid and velvet orchid accord. As the heart unfurls, sweet, creamy notes of vanilla are unveiled. Its deep profile makes it perfectly suited to evening events and formal occasions, wrapping you in sensorial warmth.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Noir Extreme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Alluring and amber-drenched, the Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau de Parfum is a must-have for those partial to woody accords. The scent opens with a citrusy spritz of mandarin oil and cardamom, coating your skin in zesty sweetness. This is closely followed by the creaminess of an Indian kulfi heart, combined with orange blossom, jasmine, and rose to lighten and brighten the fragrance. The dry-down settles into a warm base of amber and sandalwood, where you’ll be able to pick up sweet flecks of vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Noir Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A dark and sultry dream by Tom Ford. The Noir Eau de Parfum encapsulates the duality of feminine-masculine dynamism, where rich feminine florals mingle with a masculine earthiness for a fascinating, gourmand fragrance. Evoking the twin facets of the Tom Ford man, the eau de parfum emits a sophisticated, yet sexy scent. Italian bergamot and black pepper open with bold and invigorating accords, playing with warm vanilla to unlock an inner depth. Patchouli and oud wood awaken an animalistic sensuality, delving deeper into the hidden chambers of the fragrance. The parfum arrives housed in an ultra-black bottle, inspired by elegance and mystery.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Grey Vetiver Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tap into your dynamic side with Tom Ford’s Grey Vetiver Eau de Parfum, a woody-spicy elixir that elevates any scent collection. Said to be worn by Hugh Jackman, the fragrance embodies what the designer calls the essence of debonair, charismatic, and provocative masculinity. Vetiver makes up its core, that textured, earthy treasure revered by master perfumers for centuries. In Ford’s hands, this note is remixed and reborn: sharpened by crisp citrus and livened up by colourful nuances. Orange flower and grapefruit introduce an invigorating brightness, while nutmeg and pimento weave a subtle, seductive spice. Woody oakmoss adds a grounding element to the scent pyramid, forging a depth that lingers when you exit the room. The fragrance is housed in a clean, minimalist bottle with matte silver-tone accents and a debossed logo.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ombre Leather Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Summoning childhood memories of Texan life, Tom Ford's Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum evokes the rugged warmth of the Wild West through a sensual array of rich, velvety accords.  Spicy cardamom opens the scent with an energising warmth reminiscent of the desert landscape. Rustic accords of leather and cool spices reveal an untethered, driven scent, while sweet jasmine and amber heat up the aroma. Topped with white moss, the decadent fragrance ends with an earthy, grounding finish.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ombre Leather Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Embodying vast landscapes and sensual heat, Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum from Tom Ford is an androgynous floral-leather fragrance that guides the senses along the path to self-discovery. Rich and spicy warm notes of cardamom and black leather deliver a raw and passionate sensorial experience, reminiscent of the wild west. Unexpected notes of white floral and jasmine sambac caress the senses in a comforting sweetness, inviting you to embrace the open road ahead. Capturing the essence of adventuring into the unknown, the signature scent recalls humble beginnings and simple pleasures.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Stronger With You Intensely Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Powered by passion, the Armani Stronger with You Intensely Eau de Parfum Pour Homme pushes the boundaries of woody-amber scents in this addictive, concentrated blend. Playing on the contrast between spices and fresh florals in the opening, the fragrance stars pink pepper and lavender notes to capture the olfactive attention. Rich in chestnut accord and sage for depth, the eau de parfum creates a smooth, sensuous sillage on the skin, before giving way to a warm, confident base of amberwood and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co. Eau de Parfum for Her 30ml
listings.description: Floral - Musk  Top Note: Vert de Mandarine. Heart Note: Iris. Base Notes: Patchouli, Musk. Capture the luxury, glamour and romance of New York City with the Tiffany & Co. Eau de Parfum . The premier jeweller’s signature scent is a radiant, modern fragrance for the true city girl. Opening with vibrant top notes of Vert de Mandarine, the scent descends into a precious heart of Iris that exudes strength, refinement and sophistication. The elegant fragrance dries down to a sensual finish on the skin with warm nuances of Patchouli wrapped in gentle Musky notes. Sensual and radiant, the sparkling fragrance evokes the magical feeling of diamonds on bare skin. Master Perfumer Daniela Andrier was inspired by her love for gemstones and jewellery to create this contemporary take on the most precious ingredients of traditional haute perfumery. This feminine floral musk fragrance is designed around the noble Iris, a flower long associated with Tiffany as a recurring motif in its jewellery designs. Housed in a crystal bottle inspired by the Tiffany Lucida® and Tiffany Yellow Diamond cuts, the fragrance features a subtle blue tint to illuminate the precise cuts of the bottle and create a diamond-like finish. The neck of the bottle features the Tiffany’s logo and opulent silver detailing. Presented in the signature Tiffany Blue Box®, an internationally recognised symbol of style and sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu L’Eau de Muguet Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Miu Miu's L’Eau de Muguet Eau de Parfum is a sparkling floral fragrance that delivers a playful olfactory experience. Offering a contemporary take on the delicate woodland flower lily of the valley, perfumer Daniela Andrier takes inspiration from Miuccia Prada's vision to create an iconic, sensual fragrance. With soft damask rose, the French EDP plays with subtle florals but is built upon a deep, woody and peppery base – creating a vibrant yet natural blend that evokes life. To mirror the fragrance, the bottle itself is a contradiction. Soft blue-pillowed opaque glass (reminiscent of Miu Miu's signature matelassé) contrasts with a translucent red disk to lend the flacon a graphic quality. The warm tone complements the cool of the bottle.
